            '  static int _perceptualAlpha(Color color, int alpha) {\n'

            '\n'
            'class _AarishDiaryAppState extends State<AarishDiaryApp> {\n'
            '  late bool _booting;\n'
            '  late bool _darkMode;\n'
            '  String? _userId;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _readRootState();\n'
            '    widget.sync.addListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant AarishDiaryApp oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.sync == widget.sync) return;\n'
            '    oldWidget.sync.removeListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '    _readRootState();\n'
            '    widget.sync.addListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _readRootState() {\n'
            '    _booting = widget.sync.booting;\n'
            '    _darkMode = widget.sync.darkMode;\n'
            '    _userId = widget.sync.user?.uid;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handleSyncChange() {\n'
            '    final bool booting = widget.sync.booting;\n'
            '    final bool darkMode = widget.sync.darkMode;\n'
            '    final String? userId = widget.sync.user?.uid;\n'
            '    if (booting == _booting && darkMode == _darkMode && userId == _userId) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _booting = booting;\n'
            '      _darkMode = darkMode;\n'
            '      _userId = userId;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    widget.sync.removeListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(\n'
            '        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,\n'
            '        title: \'Aarish Dairy Pro\',\n'
            '        themeMode: _darkMode ? ThemeMode.dark : ThemeMode.light,\n'
            '        theme: _theme(Brightness.light),\n'
            '        darkTheme: _theme(Brightness.dark),\n'
            '        themeAnimationDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),\n'

            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) => _GlobalTapRippleLayer(\n'
            '          child: _AmbientBackground(child: child ?? const SizedBox.shrink()),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        home: _RootStage(booting: _booting, userId: _userId, sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _RootStage extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _RootStage({\n'
            '    required this.booting,\n'
            '    required this.userId,\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final bool booting;\n'
            '  final String? userId;\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '    final Widget stage;\n'
            '    final String stageKey;\n'
            '    if (booting) {\n'
            '      stage = const _LaunchScreen();\n'
            '      stageKey = \'launch\';\n'
            '    } else if (userId == null) {\n'
            '      stage = _LoginScreen(sync: sync);\n'
            '      stageKey = \'login\';\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      stage = AppShell(sync: sync);\n'
            '      stageKey = \'app\';\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    return AnimatedSwitcher(\n'
            '      duration:\n'
            '          reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : const Duration(milliseconds: 180),\n'
            '      reverseDuration:\n'
            '          reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : const Duration(milliseconds: 140),\n'
            '      switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,\n'
            '      switchOutCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,\n'
            '      transitionBuilder: (Widget child, Animation<double> animation) =>\n'
            '          FadeTransition(opacity: animation, child: child),\n'
            '      child: KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey<String>(stageKey), child: stage),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'ThemeData _theme(Brightness brightness) {\n'
            '  final bool dark = brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '  final Color surface = dark ? darkGlassTop : Colors.white;\n'
            '  final Color text = dark ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFF1C1C1E);\n'
            '  final Color outline =\n'
            '      dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(35) : Colors.black.withAlpha(11);\n'
            '  return ThemeData(\n'
            '    useMaterial3: true,\n'
            '    brightness: brightness,\n'
            '    scaffoldBackgroundColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '    canvasColor: dark ? const Color(0xFF1C2230) : Colors.white,\n'
            '    colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(\n'
            '      seedColor: appleBlue,\n'
            '      brightness: brightness,\n'
            '      surface: surface,\n'
            '      error: appleRed,\n'
            '    ).copyWith(\n'
            '      primary: appleBlue,\n'
            '      secondary: appleGreen,\n'
            '      surface: surface,\n'
            '      error: appleRed,\n'
            '      outline: outline,\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    textTheme: ThemeData(brightness: brightness)\n'
            '        .textTheme\n'
            '        .apply(bodyColor: text, displayColor: text),\n'
            '    iconTheme: IconThemeData(color: text),\n'
            '    splashFactory: NoSplash.splashFactory,\n'
            '    highlightColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '    dividerColor:\n'
            '        dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(23) : Colors.black.withAlpha(11),\n'
            '    textSelectionTheme: TextSelectionThemeData(\n'
            '      cursorColor: appleBlue,\n'
            '      selectionColor: appleBlue.withAlpha(54),\n'
            '      selectionHandleColor: appleBlue,\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationTheme(\n'
            '      filled: true,\n'
            '      fillColor: dark ? const Color(0x2EFFFFFF) : const Color(0xE8FFFFFF),\n'
            '      contentPadding: UIConstants.inputPadding,\n'
            '      hintStyle: const TextStyle(\n'
            '        color: systemGray,\n'
            '        fontSize: 16.5,\n'
            '        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      labelStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),\n'
            '      prefixIconColor: appleBlue,\n'
            '      border: OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '        borderSide: BorderSide(color: outline, width: UIConstants.borderWidth),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '        borderSide: BorderSide(\n'
            '          color: dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(34) : appleBlue.withAlpha(34),\n'
            '          width: UIConstants.borderWidth,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: appleBlue, width: 1.4),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    snackBarTheme: SnackBarThemeData(\n'
            '      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,\n'
            '      backgroundColor: dark ? const Color(0xFF2C2C2E) : const Color(0xFF1C1C1E),\n'
            '      contentTextStyle: const TextStyle(\n'
            '        color: Colors.white,\n'
            '        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.compactRadius),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    bottomSheetTheme: BottomSheetThemeData(\n'
            '      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '      modalBackgroundColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '      elevation: 0,\n'
            '      showDragHandle: false,\n'
            '      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(\n'
            '          top: Radius.circular(UIConstants.sheetRadius),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    dialogTheme: DialogThemeData(\n'
            '      backgroundColor: dark ? const Color(0xFF1C2230) : Colors.white,\n'
            '      elevation: 24,\n'
            '      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.cardRadius),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    pageTransitionsTheme: const PageTransitionsTheme(\n'
            '      builders: <TargetPlatform, PageTransitionsBuilder>{\n'
            '        TargetPlatform.android: _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder(),\n'
            '        TargetPlatform.iOS: _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder(),\n'
            '        TargetPlatform.macOS: _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder(),\n'
            '        TargetPlatform.windows: _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder(),\n'
            '        TargetPlatform.linux: _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder(),\n'
            '        TargetPlatform.fuchsia: _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder(),\n'
            '      },\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _GlobalTapRippleLayer extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _GlobalTapRippleLayer({required this.child});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_GlobalTapRippleLayer> createState() => _GlobalTapRippleLayerState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _RipplePulse {\n'
            '  _RipplePulse({\n'
            '    required this.pointer,\n'
            '    required this.origin,\n'
            '    required this.downPosition,\n'
            '    required TickerProvider vsync,\n'
            '  }) : controller = AnimationController(\n'
            '          vsync: vsync,\n'
            '          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),\n'
            '          reverseDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 65),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '\n'
            '  final int pointer;\n'
            '  final Offset origin;\n'
            '  final Offset downPosition;\n'
            '  final AnimationController controller;\n'
            '  bool cancelled = false;\n'
            '  bool disposed = false;\n'
            '\n'
            '  void start() => controller.forward(from: 0);\n'
            '\n'
            '  void cancel() {\n'
            '    if (cancelled || disposed) return;\n'
            '    cancelled = true;\n'
            '    controller.animateBack(\n'
            '      0,\n'
            '      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 65),\n'
            '      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    if (disposed) return;\n'
            '    disposed = true;\n'
            '    controller.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _GlobalTapRippleLayerState extends State<_GlobalTapRippleLayer>\n'
            '    with TickerProviderStateMixin {\n'
            '  static const double _scrollThreshold = 8;\n'
            '  static const int _maxActivePulses = 2;\n'
            '\n'
            '  final List<_RipplePulse> _pulses = <_RipplePulse>[];\n'
            '  final Map<int, _RipplePulse> _pointerPulses = <int, _RipplePulse>{};\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didChangeDependencies() {\n'
            '    super.didChangeDependencies();\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.enabled(context) || _pulses.isEmpty) return;\n'
            '    for (final _RipplePulse pulse in List<_RipplePulse>.of(_pulses)) {\n'
            '      _removePulse(pulse, rebuild: false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handlePointerDown(PointerDownEvent event) {\n'
            '    if (!AppMotion.enabled(context) || (event.buttons & kPrimaryButton) == 0) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    final _RipplePulse? existing = _pointerPulses.remove(event.pointer);\n'
            '    if (existing != null) _removePulse(existing, rebuild: false);\n'
            '\n'
            '    while (_pulses.length >= _maxActivePulses) {\n'
            '      _removePulse(_pulses.first, rebuild: false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    final _RipplePulse pulse = _RipplePulse(\n'
            '      pointer: event.pointer,\n'
            '      origin: event.localPosition,\n'
            '      downPosition: event.position,\n'
            '      vsync: this,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    pulse.controller.addStatusListener((AnimationStatus status) {\n'
            '      if (status == AnimationStatus.completed ||\n'
            '          (pulse.cancelled && status == AnimationStatus.dismissed)) {\n'
            '        _finishPulse(pulse);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    });\n'
            '\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _pulses.add(pulse);\n'
            '      _pointerPulses[event.pointer] = pulse;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    pulse.start();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handlePointerMove(PointerMoveEvent event) {\n'
            '    final _RipplePulse? pulse = _pointerPulses[event.pointer];\n'
            '    if (pulse == null || pulse.cancelled) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    if ((event.position - pulse.downPosition).distance > _scrollThreshold) {\n'
            '      _pointerPulses.remove(event.pointer);\n'
            '      pulse.cancel();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handlePointerUp(PointerUpEvent event) {\n'
            '    _pointerPulses.remove(event.pointer);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handlePointerCancel(PointerCancelEvent event) {\n'
            '    final _RipplePulse? pulse = _pointerPulses.remove(event.pointer);\n'
            '    pulse?.cancel();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _finishPulse(_RipplePulse pulse) {\n'
            '    if (!mounted || !_pulses.contains(pulse)) return;\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _pulses.remove(pulse);\n'
            '      if (_pointerPulses[pulse.pointer] == pulse) {\n'
            '        _pointerPulses.remove(pulse.pointer);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    scheduleMicrotask(pulse.dispose);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _removePulse(_RipplePulse pulse, {required bool rebuild}) {\n'
            '    if (!_pulses.contains(pulse)) return;\n'
            '    void remove() {\n'
            '      _pulses.remove(pulse);\n'
            '      if (_pointerPulses[pulse.pointer] == pulse) {\n'
            '        _pointerPulses.remove(pulse.pointer);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (rebuild && mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(remove);\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      remove();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    pulse.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    for (final _RipplePulse pulse in _pulses) {\n'
            '      pulse.dispose();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _pulses.clear();\n'
            '    _pointerPulses.clear();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    Widget surface = widget.child;\n'
            '    if (_pulses.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '      final List<_RipplePulse> snapshot = List<_RipplePulse>.unmodifiable(\n'
            '        _pulses,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      final Listenable repaint = Listenable.merge(\n'
            '        snapshot\n'
            '            .map<Listenable>((_RipplePulse pulse) => pulse.controller)\n'
            '            .toList(),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      surface = Stack(\n'
            '        fit: StackFit.expand,\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          widget.child,\n'
            '          IgnorePointer(\n'
            '            child: RepaintBoundary(\n'
            '              child: CustomPaint(\n'
            '                painter: _GlobalTapRipplePainter(\n'
            '                  pulses: snapshot,\n'
            '                  repaint: repaint,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    return Listener(\n'
            '      behavior: HitTestBehavior.translucent,\n'
            '      onPointerDown: _handlePointerDown,\n'
            '      onPointerMove: _handlePointerMove,\n'
            '      onPointerUp: _handlePointerUp,\n'
            '      onPointerCancel: _handlePointerCancel,\n'
            '      child: surface,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _GlobalTapRipplePainter extends CustomPainter {\n'
            '  _GlobalTapRipplePainter({required this.pulses, required Listenable repaint})\n'
            '      : super(repaint: repaint);\n'
            '\n'
            '  final List<_RipplePulse> pulses;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {\n'
            '    if (size.isEmpty) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    for (final _RipplePulse pulse in pulses) {\n'
            '      if (pulse.disposed) continue;\n'
            '      final double raw = pulse.controller.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '      if (raw <= 0 || raw >= 1) continue;\n'
            '\n'
            '      final double expansion = UIConstants.motionOut.transform(raw);\n'
            '      final double arrival = Curves.easeOutCubic.transform(\n'
            '        (raw / .16).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble(),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      final double fadeProgress =\n'
            '          ((raw - .58) / .42).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '      final double fade = 1 - Curves.easeInCubic.transform(fadeProgress);\n'
            '      final double opacity = (arrival * fade).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '      if (opacity <= 0) continue;\n'
            '\n'
            '      final double radius = 6 + 48 * expansion;\n'
            '      final Rect bounds = Rect.fromCircle(center: pulse.origin, radius: radius);\n'
            '      final int coreAlpha = (opacity * 31).round().clamp(0, 255).toInt();\n'
            '      final int haloAlpha = (opacity * 14).round().clamp(0, 255).toInt();\n'
            '      final int ringAlpha = (opacity * 112).round().clamp(0, 255).toInt();\n'
            '\n'
            '      canvas.drawCircle(\n'
            '        pulse.origin,\n'
            '        radius,\n'
            '        Paint()\n'
            '          ..shader = RadialGradient(\n'
            '            colors: <Color>[\n'
            '              appleBlue.withAlpha(coreAlpha),\n'
            '              appleBlue.withAlpha(haloAlpha),\n'
            '              Colors.transparent,\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            stops: const <double>[0, .54, 1],\n'
            '          ).createShader(bounds),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '\n'
            '      canvas.drawCircle(\n'
            '        pulse.origin,\n'
            '        radius * .86,\n'
            '        Paint()\n'
            '          ..color = appleBlue.withAlpha(ringAlpha)\n'
            '          ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\n'
            '          ..strokeWidth = 1.85 - expansion * .75,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '\n'
            '      if (!pulse.cancelled && raw > .18) {\n'
            '        final double echo = ((raw - .18) / .64).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '        if (echo < 1) {\n'
            '          final int echoAlpha =\n'
            '              (opacity * (1 - echo) * 58).round().clamp(0, 255).toInt();\n'
            '          canvas.drawCircle(\n'
            '            pulse.origin,\n'
            '            5 + 26 * UIConstants.motionOut.transform(echo),\n'
            '            Paint()\n'
            '              ..color = appleBlue.withAlpha(echoAlpha)\n'
            '              ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\n'
            '              ..strokeWidth = 1.2,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _GlobalTapRipplePainter oldDelegate) =>\n'
            '      !listEquals(oldDelegate.pulses, pulses);\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _AmbientBackground extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _AmbientBackground({required this.child});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final SystemUiOverlayStyle overlay = SystemUiOverlayStyle(\n'
            '      statusBarColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '      statusBarIconBrightness: dark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,\n'
            '      statusBarBrightness: dark ? Brightness.dark : Brightness.light,\n'
            '      systemNavigationBarColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '      systemNavigationBarIconBrightness:\n'
            '          dark ? Brightness.light : Brightness.dark,\n'
            '      systemNavigationBarDividerColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>(\n'
            '      value: overlay,\n'
            '      child: Stack(\n'
            '        fit: StackFit.expand,\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          RepaintBoundary(\n'
            '            child: CustomPaint(painter: _AmbientPainter(dark: dark)),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child,\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _AmbientPainter extends CustomPainter {\n'
            '  const _AmbientPainter({required this.dark});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final bool dark;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {\n'
            '    final Rect bounds = Offset.zero & size;\n'
            '    canvas.drawRect(bounds, Paint()..color = dark ? Colors.black : lightCanvas);\n'
            '    _paintGlow(\n'
            '      canvas,\n'
            '      bounds,\n'
            '      center: const Alignment(-1.15, -1.2),\n'
            '      radius: .88,\n'
            '      color: appleGreen.withAlpha(dark ? 47 : 28),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    _paintGlow(\n'
            '      canvas,\n'
            '      bounds,\n'
            '      center: const Alignment(1.15, 1.18),\n'
            '      radius: .96,\n'
            '      color: appleBlue2.withAlpha(dark ? 48 : 24),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    _paintGlow(\n'
            '      canvas,\n'
            '      bounds,\n'
            '      center: const Alignment(.08, 1.24),\n'
            '      radius: .68,\n'
            '      color: diaryOrange.withAlpha(dark ? 17 : 10),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _paintGlow(\n'
            '    Canvas canvas,\n'
            '    Rect bounds, {\n'
            '    required Alignment center,\n'
            '    required double radius,\n'
            '    required Color color,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    canvas.drawRect(\n'
            '      bounds,\n'
            '      Paint()\n'
            '        // Screen blending is additive enough for dark mode while srcOver keeps\n'
            '        // the light theme clean instead of washing white surfaces out.\n'
            '        ..blendMode = dark ? BlendMode.screen : BlendMode.srcOver\n'
            '        ..shader = RadialGradient(\n'
            '          center: center,\n'
            '          radius: radius,\n'
            '          colors: <Color>[\n'
            '            color,\n'
            '            color.withValues(alpha: color.a * .35),\n'
            '            Colors.transparent,\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '          stops: const <double>[0, .45, 1],\n'
            '        ).createShader(bounds),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _AmbientPainter oldDelegate) =>\n'
            '      oldDelegate.dark != dark;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder extends PageTransitionsBuilder {\n'
            '  const _OpaqueContentTransitionsBuilder();\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Duration get transitionDuration => UIConstants.directRouteIn;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Duration get reverseTransitionDuration => UIConstants.directRouteOut;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget buildTransitions<T>(\n'
            '    PageRoute<T> route,\n'
            '    BuildContext context,\n'
            '    Animation<double> animation,\n'
            '    Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,\n'
            '    Widget child,\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    // A route-local canvas stays fully opaque for the whole transition. Only\n'
            '    // the incoming content gets a near-instant opacity settle, so transparent\n'
            '    // Scaffolds can never blend two pages\' text together.\n'
            '    final Widget surface = _AmbientBackground(child: child);\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.reduce(context)) return surface;\n'
            '    final Animation<double> contentOpacity =\n'
            '        Tween<double>(begin: .96, end: 1).animate(\n'
            '      CurvedAnimation(\n'
            '        parent: animation,\n'
            '        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,\n'
            '        reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return _AmbientBackground(\n'
            '      child: FadeTransition(opacity: contentOpacity, child: child),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'PageRoute<T> _directRoute<T>({\n'
            '  required WidgetBuilder destinationBuilder,\n'
            '  required bool reduceMotion,\n'
            '}) =>\n'
            '    PageRouteBuilder<T>(\n'
            '      opaque: true,\n'
            '      allowSnapshotting: true,\n'
            '      transitionDuration:\n'
            '          reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : UIConstants.directRouteIn,\n'
            '      reverseTransitionDuration:\n'
            '          reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : UIConstants.directRouteOut,\n'
            '      pageBuilder: (\n'
            '        BuildContext context,\n'
            '        Animation<double> routeAnimation,\n'
            '        Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,\n'
            '      ) =>\n'
            '          destinationBuilder(context),\n'
            '      transitionsBuilder: (\n'
            '        BuildContext context,\n'
            '        Animation<double> animation,\n'
            '        Animation<double> secondaryAnimation,\n'
            '        Widget child,\n'
            '      ) =>\n'
            '          _DirectRouteTransition(animation: animation, child: child),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DirectRouteTransition extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _DirectRouteTransition({required this.animation, required this.child});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Animation<double> animation;\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.reduce(context)) {\n'
            '      return _AmbientBackground(child: child);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final Animation<double> contentOpacity =\n'
            '        Tween<double>(begin: .96, end: 1).animate(\n'
            '      CurvedAnimation(\n'
            '        parent: animation,\n'
            '        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,\n'
            '        reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return IgnorePointer(\n'
            '      ignoring: animation.status != AnimationStatus.completed,\n'
            '      child: _AmbientBackground(\n'
            '        child: FadeTransition(\n'
            '          opacity: contentOpacity,\n'
            '          child: RepaintBoundary(child: child),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _FastRouteLauncher extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _FastRouteLauncher({\n'
            '    required this.sourceBuilder,\n'
            '    required this.destinationBuilder,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Widget Function(VoidCallback openRoute) sourceBuilder;\n'
            '  final WidgetBuilder destinationBuilder;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_FastRouteLauncher> createState() => _FastRouteLauncherState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _FastRouteLauncherState extends State<_FastRouteLauncher> {\n'
            '  bool _routeOpen = false;\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _open() {\n'
            '    if (_routeOpen) return;\n'
            '    _routeOpen = true;\n'
            '    final NavigatorState navigator = Navigator.of(context);\n'
            '    final PageRoute<Object?> route = _directRoute<Object?>(\n'
            '      destinationBuilder: widget.destinationBuilder,\n'
            '      reduceMotion: AppMotion.reduce(context),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    unawaited(\n'
            '      navigator.push<Object?>(route).whenComplete(() => _routeOpen = false),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>\n'
            '      RepaintBoundary(child: widget.sourceBuilder(_open));\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LaunchScreen extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LaunchScreen();\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => const Scaffold(\n'

            'class _AppMark extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _AppMark({this.size = 60});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final double size;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Container(\n'
            '        width: size,\n'

            '        decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '          gradient: LinearGradient(\n'

            '          boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '            BoxShadow(color: appleBlue.withAlpha(76), blurRadius: 22),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.center,\n'
            '        child: SizedBox.square(\n'

            '          child: const CustomPaint(painter: _FontAwesomeLeafPainter()),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _FontAwesomeLeafPainter extends CustomPainter {\n'
            '  const _FontAwesomeLeafPainter();\n'
            '\n'
            '  // The reference website uses Font Awesome Free 6.6.0 `fa-solid fa-leaf`.\n'
            '  // This is its exact 512 x 512 vector path, kept local so the mark remains\n'
            '  // crisp and identical without adding a runtime font or package dependency.\n'
            '  // Source: https://fontawesome.com/icons/leaf (CC BY 4.0, Fonticons, Inc.).\n'
            '  static final Path _leaf = Path()\n'
            '    ..moveTo(272, 96)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(-78.6, 0, -145.1, 51.5, -167.7, 122.5)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(33.6, -17, 71.5, -26.5, 111.7, -26.5)\n'
            '    ..relativeLineTo(88, 0)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(8.8, 0, 16, 7.2, 16, 16)\n'
            '    ..cubicTo(320, 216.8, 312.8, 224, 304, 224)\n'
            '    ..relativeLineTo(-16, 0)\n'
            '    ..relativeLineTo(-72, 0)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(-16.6, 0, -32.7, 1.9, -48.3, 5.4)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(-25.9, 5.9, -49.9, 16.4, -71.4, 30.7)\n'
            '    ..cubicTo(38.3, 298.8, 0, 364.9, 0, 440)\n'
            '    ..relativeLineTo(0, 16)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(0, 13.3, 10.7, 24, 24, 24)\n'
            '    ..cubicTo(37.3, 480, 48, 469.3, 48, 456)\n'
            '    ..relativeLineTo(0, -16)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(0, -48.7, 20.7, -92.5, 53.8, -123.2)\n'
            '    ..cubicTo(121.6, 392.3, 190.3, 448, 272, 448)\n'
            '    ..relativeLineTo(1, 0)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(132.1, -.7, 239, -130.9, 239, -291.4)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(0, -42.6, -7.5, -83.1, -21.1, -119.6)\n'
            '    ..relativeCubicTo(-2.6, -6.9, -12.7, -6.6, -16.2, -.1)\n'
            '    ..cubicTo(455.9, 72.1, 418.7, 96, 376, 96)\n'
            '    ..lineTo(272, 96)\n'
            '    ..close();\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {\n'
            '    if (size.isEmpty) return;\n'
            '    canvas\n'
            '      ..save()\n'
            '      ..scale(size.width / 512, size.height / 512)\n'
            '      ..drawPath(_leaf, Paint()..color = appleBlue2)\n'
            '      ..restore();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _FontAwesomeLeafPainter oldDelegate) => false;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'

            'class _LoginScreenState extends State<_LoginScreen> {\n'
            '  bool _working = false;\n'

            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _signIn() async {\n'
            '    if (_working) return;\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _working = true;\n'
            '      _error = null;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      if (kIsWeb) {\n'
            '        await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInWithPopup(GoogleAuthProvider());\n'
            '      } else {\n'
            '        final GoogleSignInAccount? account = await GoogleSignIn(\n'
            '          scopes: const <String>[\'email\'],\n'
            '        ).signIn();\n'
            '        if (account == null) return;\n'
            '        final GoogleSignInAuthentication tokens = await account.authentication;\n'
            '        final OAuthCredential credential = GoogleAuthProvider.credential(\n'
            '          accessToken: tokens.accessToken,\n'
            '          idToken: tokens.idToken,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        await FirebaseAuth.instance.signInWithCredential(credential);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } on FirebaseAuthException catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = error.message ?? error.code);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _error = \'Sign-in failed. Please try again.\');\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _working = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'

            'class _TabSpec {\n'

            '    this.opticalScale = 1,\n'
            '  });\n'

            '  final IconData activeIcon;\n'
            '  final IconData inactiveIcon;\n'
            '  final double opticalScale;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'const List<_TabSpec> _tabs = <_TabSpec>[\n'
            '  _TabSpec(\'Home\', premiumHomeIcon, premiumHomeInactiveIcon),\n'
            '  _TabSpec(\'Milk\', Icons.water_drop_rounded, Icons.water_drop_outlined),\n'

            '\n'
            'class _LedgerPagePhysics extends PageScrollPhysics {\n'
            '  const _LedgerPagePhysics({super.parent});\n'
            '\n'
            '  static const SpringDescription _pageSettleSpring = SpringDescription(\n'
            '    mass: .78,\n'
            '    stiffness: 300,\n'
            '    damping: 30,\n'
            '  );\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  _LedgerPagePhysics applyTo(ScrollPhysics? ancestor) =>\n'
            '      _LedgerPagePhysics(parent: buildParent(ancestor));\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  SpringDescription get spring => _pageSettleSpring;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class AppShell extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const AppShell({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<AppShell> createState() => _AppShellState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _AppShellState extends State<AppShell> with WidgetsBindingObserver {\n'
            '  int _tab = 0;\n'
            '  int _settledPage = 0;\n'
            '  int? _programmaticPageTarget;\n'
            '  int _pageMotionGeneration = 0;\n'
            '  bool _userPageDragActive = false;\n'
            '  final Set<int> _dragHapticPages = <int>{};\n'
            '  final ScrollController _navController = ScrollController();\n'
            '  final PageController _pageController = PageController();\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);\n'
            '    _navController.dispose();\n'
            '    _pageController.dispose();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {\n'
            '    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {\n'
            '      unawaited(widget.sync.integrityCheck());\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Duration _adaptivePageDuration(double originPage, int targetPage) {\n'
            '    final double remainingPages =\n'
            '        (targetPage - originPage).abs().clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '    if (remainingPages <= .001) return Duration.zero;\n'
            '\n'
            '    // Distance-aware timing keeps a mid-swipe retarget responsive while a\n'
            '    // complete one-page transition preserves the established motion cadence.\n'
            '    final double travelFactor = math.sqrt(remainingPages);\n'
            '    final int micros = (UIConstants.motion.inMicroseconds * travelFactor)\n'
            '        .round()\n'
            '        .clamp(\n'
            '          const Duration(milliseconds: 90).inMicroseconds,\n'
            '          UIConstants.motion.inMicroseconds,\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        .toInt();\n'
            '    return Duration(microseconds: micros);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _selectTab(int index) {\n'
            '    if (index < 0 || index >= _tabs.length) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final bool alreadySettled = _tab == index &&\n'
            '        _settledPage == index &&\n'
            '        _programmaticPageTarget == null;\n'
            '    if (alreadySettled || _programmaticPageTarget == index) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '    final int generation = ++_pageMotionGeneration;\n'
            '    _userPageDragActive = false;\n'
            '    _dragHapticPages.clear();\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (reduceMotion) {\n'
            '      _programmaticPageTarget = null;\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _tab = index;\n'
            '        _settledPage = index;\n'
            '      });\n'
            '      _scrollNavigation(index);\n'
            '      if (_pageController.hasClients) _pageController.jumpToPage(index);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (_tab != index) setState(() => _tab = index);\n'
            '    _scrollNavigation(index);\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (!_pageController.hasClients) {\n'
            '      _programmaticPageTarget = null;\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _programmaticPageTarget = index;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final double livePage = _pageController.page ?? _settledPage.toDouble();\n'
            '    final int currentPage = livePage.round().clamp(0, _tabs.length - 1).toInt();\n'
            '    final int pageDistance = (index - currentPage).abs();\n'
            '\n'
            '    double animationOrigin = livePage;\n'
            '    if (pageDistance > 1) {\n'
            '      final int stagingPage = index > currentPage ? index - 1 : index + 1;\n'
            '      _pageController.jumpToPage(stagingPage);\n'
            '      animationOrigin = stagingPage.toDouble();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    final Duration pageDuration = _adaptivePageDuration(animationOrigin, index);\n'
            '    if (pageDuration == Duration.zero) {\n'
            '      _pageController.jumpToPage(index);\n'
            '      _finishProgrammaticPageMotion(index, generation);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    unawaited(\n'
            '      _pageController\n'
            '          .animateToPage(\n'
            '            index,\n'
            '            duration: pageDuration,\n'
            '            curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '          )\n'
            '          .whenComplete(() => _finishProgrammaticPageMotion(index, generation)),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _finishProgrammaticPageMotion(int target, int generation) {\n'
            '    if (!mounted ||\n'
            '        _pageMotionGeneration != generation ||\n'
            '        _programmaticPageTarget != target) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _programmaticPageTarget = null;\n'
            '    if (!_pageController.hasClients) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final double? page = _pageController.page;\n'
            '    if (page == null) return;\n'
            '    final int settledIndex = page.round().clamp(0, _tabs.length - 1).toInt();\n'
            '    final bool selectionChanged = settledIndex != _tab;\n'
            '    final bool pageChanged = settledIndex != _settledPage;\n'
            '    if (!selectionChanged && !pageChanged) return;\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _tab = settledIndex;\n'
            '      _settledPage = settledIndex;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    if (selectionChanged) _scrollNavigation(settledIndex);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  bool _handlePageScrollNotification(ScrollNotification notification) {\n'
            '    if (notification is ScrollStartNotification &&\n'
            '        notification.dragDetails != null) {\n'
            '      _userPageDragActive = true;\n'
            '      _dragHapticPages\n'
            '        ..clear()\n'
            '        ..add(_tab);\n'
            '      if (_programmaticPageTarget != null) {\n'
            '        _pageMotionGeneration++;\n'
            '        _programmaticPageTarget = null;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } else if (notification is ScrollEndNotification && _userPageDragActive) {\n'
            '      _userPageDragActive = false;\n'
            '      _finishUserPageMotion();\n'
            '      _dragHapticPages.clear();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return false;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _finishUserPageMotion() {\n'
            '    if (!mounted || !_pageController.hasClients) return;\n'
            '    final double? page = _pageController.page;\n'
            '    if (page == null) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final int settledIndex = page.round().clamp(0, _tabs.length - 1).toInt();\n'
            '    if (_tab == settledIndex && _settledPage == settledIndex) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final bool selectionChanged = _tab != settledIndex;\n'
            '    if (selectionChanged && _dragHapticPages.add(settledIndex)) {\n'
            '      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _tab = settledIndex;\n'
            '      _settledPage = settledIndex;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    if (selectionChanged) _scrollNavigation(settledIndex);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handlePageChanged(int index) {\n'
            '    // Driven tab motion owns selection while active. During a live user swipe,\n'
            '    // preview only the navigation selection and defer the expensive active-sync\n'
            '    // listener handoff until ScrollEnd settles on the final page.\n'
            '    if (_programmaticPageTarget != null) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final bool selectionChanged = _tab != index;\n'
            '    if (_userPageDragActive) {\n'
            '      if (!selectionChanged) return;\n'
            '      if (_dragHapticPages.add(index)) HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '      setState(() => _tab = index);\n'
            '      _scrollNavigation(index);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (!selectionChanged && _settledPage == index) return;\n'
            '    if (selectionChanged) HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _tab = index;\n'
            '      _settledPage = index;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    if (selectionChanged) _scrollNavigation(index);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _scrollNavigation(int index) {\n'
            '    if (!_navController.hasClients) return;\n'
            '    final ScrollPosition position = _navController.position;\n'
            '    if (!position.hasContentDimensions) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    // Existing geometry is 84 wide + 4 margin on each side. Keep those exact\n'
            '    // dimensions, but center the selected destination in the visible viewport.\n'
            '    const double itemExtent = 92;\n'
            '    const double outerPadding = 4;\n'
            '    final double target = (outerPadding +\n'
            '            index * itemExtent +\n'
            '            itemExtent / 2 -\n'
            '            position.viewportDimension / 2)\n'
            '        .clamp(position.minScrollExtent, position.maxScrollExtent)\n'
            '        .toDouble();\n'
            '    final double navTravel = (position.pixels - target).abs();\n'
            '    if (navTravel < .5) return;\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.reduce(context) || navTravel < 3) {\n'
            '      position.jumpTo(target);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final double normalizedTravel =\n'
            '        (navTravel / itemExtent).clamp(.12, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '    final int adaptiveMicros =\n'
            '        (UIConstants.motion.inMicroseconds * math.sqrt(normalizedTravel))\n'
            '            .round()\n'
            '            .clamp(\n'
            '              const Duration(milliseconds: 90).inMicroseconds,\n'
            '              UIConstants.motion.inMicroseconds,\n'
            '            )\n'
            '            .toInt();\n'
            '    _navController.animateTo(\n'
            '      target,\n'
            '      duration: Duration(microseconds: adaptiveMicros),\n'
            '      curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final List<Widget> screens = <Widget>[\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 0,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => DashboardScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 1,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => MilkScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 2,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => CreditScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 3,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => ExpenseScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 4,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => SalaryScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 5,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => DiaryScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      _KeepAlivePage(\n'
            '        child: _ActiveSyncView(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          active: _settledPage == 6,\n'
            '          builder: (BuildContext context) => BusinessScreen(sync: widget.sync),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ];\n'
            '    return Scaffold(\n'
            '      body: Column(\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '            animation: widget.sync,\n'
            '            builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) =>\n'
            '                widget.sync.isConnected\n'
            '                    ? const SizedBox.shrink()\n'
            '                    : const _OfflineBanner(),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            child: RepaintBoundary(\n'
            '              child: NotificationListener<ScrollNotification>(\n'
            '                onNotification: _handlePageScrollNotification,\n'
            '                child: PageView(\n'
            '                  controller: _pageController,\n'
            '                  physics: const _LedgerPagePhysics(\n'
            '                    parent: BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  allowImplicitScrolling: true,\n'
            '                  onPageChanged: _handlePageChanged,\n'
            '                  children: screens,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      bottomNavigationBar: _BottomLedgerNav(\n'
            '        sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '        selected: _tab,\n'
            '        controller: _navController,\n'
            '        onSelected: _selectTab,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _KeepAlivePage extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _KeepAlivePage({required this.child});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_KeepAlivePage> createState() => _KeepAlivePageState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _KeepAlivePageState extends State<_KeepAlivePage>\n'
            '    with AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin<_KeepAlivePage> {\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  bool get wantKeepAlive => true;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    super.build(context);\n'
            '    return widget.child;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ActiveSyncView extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _ActiveSyncView({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.active,\n'
            '    required this.builder,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final bool active;\n'
            '  final WidgetBuilder builder;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_ActiveSyncView> createState() => _ActiveSyncViewState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ActiveSyncViewState extends State<_ActiveSyncView> {\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    if (widget.active) widget.sync.addListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _ActiveSyncView oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.sync == widget.sync && oldWidget.active == widget.active) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.active) oldWidget.sync.removeListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '    if (widget.active) widget.sync.addListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handleSyncChange() {\n'
            '    if (mounted && widget.active) setState(() {});\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    if (widget.active) widget.sync.removeListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>\n'
            '      RepaintBoundary(child: widget.builder(context));\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _OfflineBanner extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _OfflineBanner();\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Semantics(\n'
            '        container: true,\n'
            '        liveRegion: true,\n'
            '        label: \'Offline. Changes will sync automatically.\',\n'
            '        child: ExcludeSemantics(\n'
            '          child: SafeArea(\n'
            '            bottom: false,\n'
            '            child: Container(\n'
            '              width: double.infinity,\n'
            '              color: appleOrange,\n'
            '              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),\n'
            '              child: const Text(\n'
            '                \'OFFLINE • Changes will sync automatically\',\n'
            '                textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '                style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                  color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                  fontSize: 10,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                  letterSpacing: .6,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _BottomLedgerNav extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _BottomLedgerNav({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.selected,\n'
            '    required this.controller,\n'
            '    required this.onSelected,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final int selected;\n'
            '  final ScrollController controller;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<int> onSelected;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_BottomLedgerNav> createState() => _BottomLedgerNavState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _BottomLedgerNavState extends State<_BottomLedgerNav> {\n'
            '  late List<Color> _colors;\n'
            '\n'
            '  LedgerSyncService get sync => widget.sync;\n'
            '  int get selected => widget.selected;\n'
            '  ScrollController get controller => widget.controller;\n'
            '  ValueChanged<int> get onSelected => widget.onSelected;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _colors = _moduleTabColors(sync.currentProjection);\n'
            '    sync.addListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _BottomLedgerNav oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.sync == widget.sync) return;\n'
            '    oldWidget.sync.removeListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '    _colors = _moduleTabColors(sync.currentProjection);\n'
            '    sync.addListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _handleSyncChange() {\n'
            '    final List<Color> colors = _moduleTabColors(sync.currentProjection);\n'
            '    if (!mounted || listEquals(_colors, colors)) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _colors = colors);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    sync.removeListener(_handleSyncChange);\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _buildNavigation(context);\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _buildNavigation(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final Duration navMotion =\n'
            '        AppMotion.reduce(context) ? Duration.zero : UIConstants.motion;\n'
            '    final List<Color> colors = _colors;\n'
            '    return DecoratedBox(\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '          BoxShadow(\n'
            '            color: Colors.black.withAlpha(dark ? 108 : 16),\n'
            '            blurRadius: dark ? 42 : 34,\n'
            '            spreadRadius: -12,\n'
            '            offset: const Offset(0, -10),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: ClipRect(\n'
            '        child: BackdropFilter(\n'
            '          filter: ui.ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 22, sigmaY: 22),\n'
            '          child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '            decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '              gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '                begin: Alignment.topCenter,\n'
            '                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,\n'
            '                colors: dark\n'
            '                    ? const <Color>[Color(0xE0121928), Color(0xD0080D18)]\n'
            '                    : const <Color>[Color(0xF3FFFFFF), Color(0xE4FFFFFF)],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              border: Border(\n'
            '                top: BorderSide(\n'
            '                  color: dark\n'
            '                      ? Colors.white.withAlpha(22)\n'
            '                      : Colors.white.withAlpha(210),\n'
            '                  width: .8,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            child: SafeArea(\n'
            '              top: false,\n'
            '              child: SizedBox(\n'
            '                height: 88,\n'
            '                child: SingleChildScrollView(\n'
            '                  controller: controller,\n'
            '                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,\n'
            '                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                  child: Padding(\n'
            '                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),\n'
            '                    child: Row(\n'
            '                      children: List<Widget>.generate(_tabs.length, (\n'
            '                        int index,\n'
            '                      ) {\n'
            '                        final _TabSpec spec = _tabs[index];\n'
            '                        final bool active = index == selected;\n'
            '                        final Color color = colors[index];\n'
            '                        return _Pressable(\n'
            '                          onTap: () => onSelected(index),\n'
            '                          semanticLabel: \'${spec.label} tab\',\n'
            '                          selected: active,\n'
            '                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(\n'
            '                            UIConstants.actionRadius,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          child: AnimatedSlide(\n'
            '                            offset:\n'
            '                                active ? const Offset(0, -.025) : Offset.zero,\n'
            '                            duration: navMotion,\n'
            '                            curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '                            child: AnimatedContainer(\n'
            '                              duration: navMotion,\n'
            '                              curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '                              width: 84,\n'
            '                              height: 70,\n'
            '                              margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),\n'
            '                              decoration: const BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                                color: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                              child: Column(\n'
            '                                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '                                children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                  AnimatedScale(\n'
            '                                    scale: active ? 1.045 : 1,\n'
            '                                    duration: navMotion,\n'
            '                                    curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '                                    child: _PremiumNavIconFrame(\n'
            '                                      color: color,\n'
            '                                      active: active,\n'
            '                                      dark: dark,\n'
            '                                      child: _BottomNavGlyph(\n'
            '                                        icon: active\n'
            '                                            ? spec.activeIcon\n'
            '                                            : spec.inactiveIcon,\n'
            '                                        size: (active ? 24 : 22.5) *\n'
            '                                            spec.opticalScale,\n'
            '                                        color: active\n'
            '                                            ? color\n'
            '                                            : color.withAlpha(dark ? 164 : 160),\n'
            '                                        active: active,\n'
            '                                        dark: dark,\n'
            '                                      ),\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                  const SizedBox(height: 3),\n'
            '                                  AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(\n'
            '                                    duration: navMotion,\n'
            '                                    curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '                                    style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                                      color: active\n'
            '                                          ? color\n'
            '                                          : color.withAlpha(dark ? 176 : 188),\n'
            '                                      fontSize: active ? 12.5 : 12,\n'
            '                                      fontWeight: active\n'
            '                                          ? FontWeight.w800\n'
            '                                          : FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '                                      letterSpacing: active ? -.12 : 0,\n'
            '                                      shadows: active\n'
            '                                          ? AppStyles.inkGlow(color)\n'
            '                                          : null,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                    child: Text(spec.label),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                  const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                                  AnimatedContainer(\n'
            '                                    duration: navMotion,\n'
            '                                    curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '                                    width: active ? 24 : 0,\n'
            '                                    height: 2.5,\n'
            '                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                                      color: color.withAlpha(active ? 188 : 0),\n'
            '                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),\n'
            '                                      boxShadow: active\n'
            '                                          ? <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '                                              BoxShadow(\n'
            '                                                color: color.withAlpha(82),\n'
            '                                                blurRadius: 11,\n'
            '                                                spreadRadius: -2,\n'
            '                                                offset: Offset.zero,\n'
            '                                              ),\n'
            '                                            ]\n'
            '                                          : null,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                ],\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        );\n'
            '                      }),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            '// PREMIUM_NAV_V2\n'
            'class _PremiumNavIconFrame extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _PremiumNavIconFrame({\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.active,\n'
            '    required this.dark,\n'
            '    required this.child,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final bool active;\n'
            '  final bool dark;\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedContainer(\n'
            '        duration:\n'
            '            AppMotion.reduce(context) ? Duration.zero : UIConstants.motion,\n'
            '        curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '        width: active ? 46 : 39,\n'
