            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(active ? 15 : 13),\n'
            '          gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '            begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '            end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '            colors: <Color>[\n'
            '              color.withAlpha(active ? (dark ? 34 : 26) : (dark ? 16 : 11)),\n'
            '              color.withAlpha(active ? (dark ? 14 : 9) : 0),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          border: Border.all(\n'
            '            color:\n'
            '                color.withAlpha(active ? (dark ? 70 : 54) : (dark ? 24 : 18)),\n'
            '            width: active ? .9 : .7,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          boxShadow: active\n'
            '              ? <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '                  BoxShadow(\n'
            '                    color: color.withAlpha(dark ? 48 : 34),\n'
            '                    blurRadius: 16,\n'
            '                    spreadRadius: -5,\n'
            '                    offset: const Offset(0, 5),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  BoxShadow(\n'
            '                    color: Colors.white.withAlpha(dark ? 12 : 88),\n'
            '                    blurRadius: 1,\n'
            '                    offset: const Offset(0, -1),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ]\n'
            '              : null,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        child: child,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _BottomNavGlyph extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _BottomNavGlyph({\n'
            '    required this.icon,\n'
            '    required this.size,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.active,\n'
            '    required this.dark,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final double size;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final bool active;\n'
            '  final bool dark;\n'
            '\n'
            '  List<Shadow> get _shadows => active\n'
            '      ? <Shadow>[\n'
            '          Shadow(\n'
            '            color: color.withAlpha(dark ? 86 : 62),\n'
            '            blurRadius: 8,\n'
            '            offset: Offset.zero,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ]\n'
            '      : <Shadow>[Shadow(color: color.withAlpha(dark ? 40 : 28), blurRadius: 5)];\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>\n'
            '      Icon(icon, size: size, color: color, shadows: _shadows);\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _Pressable extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _Pressable({\n'
            '    required this.child,\n'
            '    required this.onTap,\n'
            '    this.borderRadius,\n'
            '    this.feedbackColor,\n'
            '    this.semanticLabel,\n'
            '    this.selected,\n'
            '    this.animatePress = true,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onTap;\n'
            '  final BorderRadius? borderRadius;\n'
            '  final Color? feedbackColor;\n'
            '  final String? semanticLabel;\n'
            '  final bool? selected;\n'
            '  final bool animatePress;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_Pressable> createState() => _PressableState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _PressableState extends State<_Pressable>\n'
            '    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {\n'
            '  static const double _touchAlignmentEpsilonSquared = .0004;\n'
            '\n'
            '  late final AnimationController _pressController;\n'
            '  late final Stopwatch _gestureClock;\n'
            '  Alignment _touchAlignment = Alignment.center;\n'
            '  Alignment? _releaseAlignment;\n'
            '  Offset? _lastTouchPosition;\n'
            '  int _lastTouchSampleMicros = 0;\n'
            '  Offset _gestureVelocity = Offset.zero;\n'
            '  int _pressMotionGeneration = 0;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _gestureClock = Stopwatch()..start();\n'
            '    _pressController = AnimationController(\n'
            '      vsync: this,\n'
            '      value: 0,\n'
            '      lowerBound: -.18,\n'
            '      upperBound: 1,\n'
            '      duration: UIConstants.pressIn,\n'
            '      reverseDuration: UIConstants.pressOut,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _Pressable oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    final bool interactionDisabled =\n'
            '        (oldWidget.onTap != null && widget.onTap == null) ||\n'
            '            (oldWidget.animatePress && !widget.animatePress);\n'
            '    if (interactionDisabled) _resetPressFeedback();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didChangeDependencies() {\n'
            '    super.didChangeDependencies();\n'
            '    if (_pressController.value == 0 || AppMotion.enabled(context)) return;\n'
            '    _resetPressFeedback();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _resetPressFeedback() {\n'
            '    _pressMotionGeneration++;\n'
            '    _pressController.stop();\n'
            '    if (_pressController.value != 0) _pressController.value = 0;\n'
            '    _clearTouchState();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _clearTouchState() {\n'
            '    _touchAlignment = Alignment.center;\n'
            '    _releaseAlignment = null;\n'
            '    _lastTouchPosition = null;\n'
            '    _lastTouchSampleMicros = 0;\n'
            '    _gestureVelocity = Offset.zero;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  bool _updateTouchAlignment(Offset localPosition) {\n'
            '    final RenderBox? box = context.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;\n'
            '    if (box == null || !box.hasSize || box.size.isEmpty) return false;\n'
            '    final double x =\n'
            '        (localPosition.dx / box.size.width * 2 - 1).clamp(-.72, .72).toDouble();\n'
            '    final double y = (localPosition.dy / box.size.height * 2 - 1)\n'
            '        .clamp(-.72, .72)\n'
            '        .toDouble();\n'
            '    final Alignment nextAlignment = Alignment(x, y);\n'
            '    final double deltaX = nextAlignment.x - _touchAlignment.x;\n'
            '    final double deltaY = nextAlignment.y - _touchAlignment.y;\n'
            '    if (deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY < _touchAlignmentEpsilonSquared) {\n'
            '      return false;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _touchAlignment = nextAlignment;\n'
            '    return true;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _captureTouch(TapDownDetails details) {\n'
            '    _pressMotionGeneration++;\n'
            '    _releaseAlignment = null;\n'
            '    _lastTouchPosition = details.localPosition;\n'
            '    _lastTouchSampleMicros = _gestureClock.elapsedMicroseconds;\n'
            '    _gestureVelocity = Offset.zero;\n'
            '    _updateTouchAlignment(details.localPosition);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _sampleGestureVelocity(Offset localPosition) {\n'
            '    final int nowMicros = _gestureClock.elapsedMicroseconds;\n'
            '    final Offset? previousPosition = _lastTouchPosition;\n'
            '    final int previousMicros = _lastTouchSampleMicros;\n'
            '    _lastTouchPosition = localPosition;\n'
            '    _lastTouchSampleMicros = nowMicros;\n'
            '    if (previousPosition == null || previousMicros == 0) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final int elapsedMicros = nowMicros - previousMicros;\n'
            '    if (elapsedMicros <= 0) return;\n'
            '    final double elapsedSeconds =\n'
            '        elapsedMicros / Duration.microsecondsPerSecond;\n'
            '    final double samplesPerSecond = 1 / elapsedSeconds;\n'
            '    Offset sample = (localPosition - previousPosition) * samplesPerSecond;\n'
            '    const double maxTrackedSpeed = 7000;\n'
            '    final double sampleSpeed = sample.distance;\n'
            '    if (sampleSpeed > maxTrackedSpeed) {\n'
            '      sample = sample * (maxTrackedSpeed / sampleSpeed);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    // A fixed per-event blend changes its effective response at 60 Hz versus\n'
            '    // 120 Hz. Convert the same response into continuous time so touch tracking\n'
            '    // feels identical across refresh rates and irregular pointer sampling.\n'
            '    const double velocityResponsePerSecond = 32;\n'
            '    final double blend =\n'
            '        (1 - math.exp(-velocityResponsePerSecond * elapsedSeconds))\n'
            '            .clamp(.12, .72)\n'
            '            .toDouble();\n'
            '    _gestureVelocity = Offset.lerp(_gestureVelocity, sample, blend)!;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Offset _freshGestureVelocity() {\n'
            '    if (_lastTouchSampleMicros == 0) return Offset.zero;\n'
            '    final int ageMicros =\n'
            '        _gestureClock.elapsedMicroseconds - _lastTouchSampleMicros;\n'
            '    const int freshnessWindowMicros = 160000;\n'
            '    if (ageMicros <= 0) return _gestureVelocity;\n'
            '    if (ageMicros >= freshnessWindowMicros) return Offset.zero;\n'
            '    final double freshness = 1 - (ageMicros / freshnessWindowMicros);\n'
            '    final double easedFreshness = freshness * freshness;\n'
            '    return _gestureVelocity * easedFreshness;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Alignment _projectReleaseAlignment(Offset velocity) {\n'
            '    final RenderBox? box = context.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;\n'
            '    if (box == null || !box.hasSize || box.size.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      return _touchAlignment;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final double xLead = (velocity.dx / math.max(box.size.width, 1) * .018)\n'
            '        .clamp(-.18, .18)\n'
            '        .toDouble();\n'
            '    final double yLead = (velocity.dy / math.max(box.size.height, 1) * .018)\n'
            '        .clamp(-.18, .18)\n'
            '        .toDouble();\n'
            '    return Alignment(\n'
            '      (_touchAlignment.x + xLead).clamp(-.72, .72).toDouble(),\n'
            '      (_touchAlignment.y + yLead).clamp(-.72, .72).toDouble(),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  double _releaseDepthVelocity(Offset velocity, {required bool cancelled}) {\n'
            '    final RenderBox? box = context.findRenderObject() as RenderBox?;\n'
            '    final double referenceExtent =\n'
            '        box != null && box.hasSize && !box.size.isEmpty\n'
            '            ? math.max(48, math.min(box.size.width, box.size.height)).toDouble()\n'
            '            : 64;\n'
            '    final double normalizedSpeed = velocity.distance / referenceExtent;\n'
            '    final double gain = cancelled ? .24 : .18;\n'
            '    return -(normalizedSpeed * gain).clamp(0.0, 2.2).toDouble();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _trackTouch(TapMoveDetails details) {\n'
            '    if (widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress) return;\n'
            '    _releaseAlignment = null;\n'
            '    _sampleGestureVelocity(details.localPosition);\n'
            '    final bool changed = _updateTouchAlignment(details.localPosition);\n'
            '    if (changed && !_pressController.isAnimating && mounted) setState(() {});\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _press([TapDownDetails? details]) {\n'
            '    if (widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress) return;\n'
            '    if (details != null) _captureTouch(details);\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.reduce(context)) {\n'
            '      _pressController.stop();\n'
            '      if (_pressController.value != 1) _pressController.value = 1;\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final double remainingTravel =\n'
            '        (1 - _pressController.value).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '    final int adaptiveMicros = math.max(\n'
            '      UIConstants.pressReengageFloor.inMicroseconds,\n'
            '      (UIConstants.pressIn.inMicroseconds * remainingTravel).round(),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    _pressController.animateTo(\n'
            '      1,\n'
            '      duration: Duration(microseconds: adaptiveMicros),\n'
            '      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _release({bool cancelled = false}) {\n'
            '    if (widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress) return;\n'
            '    final Offset gestureVelocity = _freshGestureVelocity();\n'
            '    _releaseAlignment = _projectReleaseAlignment(gestureVelocity);\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.reduce(context)) {\n'
            '      _pressMotionGeneration++;\n'
            '      _pressController.stop();\n'
            '      if (_pressController.value != 0) _pressController.value = 0;\n'
            '      _clearTouchState();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    // A released surface must never keep travelling deeper because the short\n'
            '    // press-in tween still has positive velocity. Couple the return spring to\n'
            '    // the user\'s actual finger speed and force its initial direction outward.\n'
            '    final double controllerVelocity = math.min(_pressController.velocity, 0.0);\n'
            '    final double pressDepth = _pressController.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '    final double depthCoupling = math.sqrt(pressDepth);\n'
            '    final double gestureReleaseVelocity = _releaseDepthVelocity(\n'
            '          gestureVelocity,\n'
            '          cancelled: cancelled,\n'
            '        ) *\n'
            '        depthCoupling;\n'
            '    final double releaseVelocity = math\n'
            '        .min(controllerVelocity, gestureReleaseVelocity)\n'
            '        .clamp(-2.5, 0.0)\n'
            '        .toDouble();\n'
            '    if (_pressController.value.abs() <= .0001 &&\n'
            '        releaseVelocity.abs() <= .0001) {\n'
            '      _pressMotionGeneration++;\n'
            '      if (_pressController.value != 0) _pressController.value = 0;\n'
            '      _clearTouchState();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final int motionGeneration = ++_pressMotionGeneration;\n'
            '    _pressController\n'
            '        .animateWith(\n'
            '      SpringSimulation(\n'
            '        UIConstants.pressSpring,\n'
            '        _pressController.value,\n'
            '        0,\n'
            '        releaseVelocity,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    )\n'
            '        .whenCompleteOrCancel(() {\n'
            '      if (!mounted || motionGeneration != _pressMotionGeneration) return;\n'
            '      if (_pressController.value.abs() <= .002 && _pressController.value != 0) {\n'
            '        _pressController.value = 0;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      _clearTouchState();\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _activate() {\n'
            '    if (widget.onTap == null) return;\n'
            '    if (widget.feedbackColor == null) {\n'
            '      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    widget.onTap!();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    _gestureClock.stop();\n'
            '    _pressController.dispose();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Semantics(\n'
            '        button: widget.onTap != null,\n'
            '        enabled: widget.onTap != null,\n'
            '        label: widget.semanticLabel,\n'
            '        selected: widget.selected,\n'
            '        onTap: widget.onTap == null ? null : _activate,\n'
            '        child: GestureDetector(\n'
            '          excludeFromSemantics: true,\n'
            '          behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,\n'
            '          onTapDown:\n'
            '              widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress ? null : _press,\n'
            '          onTapMove:\n'
            '              widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress ? null : _trackTouch,\n'
            '          onTapCancel: widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress\n'
            '              ? null\n'
            '              : () => _release(cancelled: true),\n'
            '          onTapUp: widget.onTap == null || !widget.animatePress\n'
            '              ? null\n'
            '              : (_) => _release(),\n'
            '          onTap: widget.onTap == null ? null : _activate,\n'
            '          child: AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '            animation: _pressController,\n'
            '            child: widget.child,\n'
            '            builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '              final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '              final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '              final double feedback = _pressController.value;\n'
            '              final double pressed = feedback.clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();\n'
            '              final double motion = reduceMotion ? 0 : feedback;\n'
            '              final double cardTilt =\n'
            '                  reduceMotion || widget.feedbackColor == null\n'
            '                      ? 0\n'
            '                      : pressed * .0145;\n'
            '              final Alignment spatialAlignment =\n'
            '                  _releaseAlignment ?? _touchAlignment;\n'
            '              final Matrix4 perspective = Matrix4.identity()\n'
            '                ..setEntry(3, 2, .0013)\n'
            '                ..rotateX(-spatialAlignment.y * cardTilt)\n'
            '                ..rotateY(spatialAlignment.x * cardTilt);\n'
            '              final Widget compressed = Transform.translate(\n'
            '                transformHitTests: false,\n'
            '                offset: Offset(0, motion * 1.30),\n'
            '                child: Transform.scale(\n'
            '                  transformHitTests: false,\n'
            '                  scale: 1 - (motion * .017),\n'
            '                  child: Stack(\n'
            '                    clipBehavior: Clip.none,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      if (widget.feedbackColor != null)\n'
            '                        Positioned.fill(\n'
            '                          child: IgnorePointer(\n'
            '                            child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '                              decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                                borderRadius:\n'
            '                                    widget.borderRadius ?? BorderRadius.zero,\n'
            '                                boxShadow: AppStyles.pressGlow(\n'
            '                                  context,\n'
            '                                  widget.feedbackColor!,\n'
            '                                  pressed,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      child!,\n'
            '                      Positioned.fill(\n'
            '                        child: IgnorePointer(\n'
            '                          child: ClipRRect(\n'
            '                            borderRadius:\n'
            '                                widget.borderRadius ?? BorderRadius.zero,\n'
            '                            child: Stack(\n'
            '                              fit: StackFit.expand,\n'
            '                              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                DecoratedBox(\n'
            '                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                                    gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '                                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,\n'
            '                                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,\n'
            '                                      colors: <Color>[\n'
            '                                        Colors.white.withAlpha(\n'
            '                                          (pressed * (dark ? 12 : 20)).round(),\n'
            '                                        ),\n'
            '                                        Colors.black.withAlpha(\n'
            '                                          (pressed * (dark ? 7 : 10)).round(),\n'
            '                                        ),\n'
            '                                      ],\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                                if (widget.feedbackColor != null)\n'
            '                                  DecoratedBox(\n'
            '                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                                      borderRadius: widget.borderRadius ??\n'
            '                                          BorderRadius.zero,\n'
            '                                      border: Border.all(\n'
            '                                        color: widget.feedbackColor!.withAlpha(\n'
            '                                          (pressed * (dark ? 54 : 38)).round(),\n'
            '                                        ),\n'
            '                                        width: .8,\n'
            '                                      ),\n'
            '                                      gradient: RadialGradient(\n'
            '                                        center: _touchAlignment,\n'
            '                                        radius: 1.05,\n'
            '                                        colors: <Color>[\n'
            '                                          Colors.white.withAlpha(\n'
            '                                            (pressed * (dark ? 15 : 26))\n'
            '                                                .round(),\n'
            '                                          ),\n'
            '                                          Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                                        ],\n'
            '                                        stops: const <double>[0, 1],\n'
            '                                      ),\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                              ],\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              );\n'
            '              if (cardTilt == 0) return compressed;\n'
            '              return Transform(\n'
            '                alignment: Alignment.center,\n'
            '                transform: perspective,\n'
            '                transformHitTests: false,\n'
            '                child: compressed,\n'
            '              );\n'
            '            },\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _GlassCard extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _GlassCard({\n'
            '    required this.child,\n'
            '    this.padding = UIConstants.cardPadding,\n'
            '    this.accentColor,\n'
            '    this.borderColor,\n'
            '    this.shadowColor,\n'
            '    this.tintColor,\n'
            '    this.borderRadius = UIConstants.cardRadius,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '  final EdgeInsets padding;\n'
            '  final Color? accentColor;\n'
            '  final Color? borderColor;\n'
            '  final Color? shadowColor;\n'
            '  final Color? tintColor;\n'
            '  final double borderRadius;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final List<Color> surfaceColors;\n'
            '    if (tintColor == null) {\n'
            '      surfaceColors = dark\n'
            '          ? const <Color>[Color(0xF0121826), Color(0xE3080C18)]\n'
            '          : const <Color>[Color(0xFAFFFFFF), Color(0xF2FFFFFF)];\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      surfaceColors = dark\n'
            '          ? <Color>[\n'
            '              Color.lerp(darkGlassTop, tintColor, .12)!.withAlpha(240),\n'
            '              Color.lerp(darkGlassBottom, tintColor, .06)!.withAlpha(224),\n'
            '            ]\n'
            '          : <Color>[\n'
            '              Color.lerp(Colors.white, tintColor, .055)!.withAlpha(248),\n'
            '              Color.lerp(Colors.white, tintColor, .028)!.withAlpha(236),\n'
            '            ];\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final Border border = borderColor != null\n'
            '        ? Border.all(color: borderColor!, width: UIConstants.borderWidth)\n'
            '        : AppStyles.glassBorder(context, accent: accentColor);\n'
            '    final Color? resolvedGlowColor = shadowColor ?? tintColor ?? accentColor;\n'
            '    final List<BoxShadow> shadows = resolvedGlowColor != null\n'
            '        ? accentColor != null\n'
            '            ? AppStyles.railDepth(context, resolvedGlowColor)\n'
            '            : AppStyles.glow(\n'
            '                context,\n'
            '                resolvedGlowColor,\n'
            '                strong: tintColor != null,\n'
            '              )\n'
            '        : AppStyles.surfaceDepth(context);\n'
            '    final BorderRadius radius = BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius);\n'
            '    return DecoratedBox(\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(borderRadius: radius, boxShadow: shadows),\n'
            '      child: ClipRRect(\n'
            '        borderRadius: radius,\n'
            '        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,\n'
            '        child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '          decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '            gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '              begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '              end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '              colors: surfaceColors,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            borderRadius: radius,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '            position: DecorationPosition.foreground,\n'
            '            decoration: BoxDecoration(borderRadius: radius, border: border),\n'
            '            child: Stack(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                // One continuous lighting field replaces the short straight\n'
            '                // edge strips that terminated before the rounded corners.\n'
            '                Positioned.fill(\n'
            '                  child: IgnorePointer(\n'
            '                    child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '                      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                        gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '                          begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '                          end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '                          stops: const <double>[0, .32, .68, 1],\n'
            '                          colors: <Color>[\n'
            '                            Colors.white.withAlpha(dark ? 15 : 31),\n'
            '                            Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                            Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                            Colors.black.withAlpha(dark ? 22 : 7),\n'
            '                          ],\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                if (accentColor != null)\n'
            '                  Positioned.fill(\n'
            '                    child: IgnorePointer(\n'
            '                      child: CustomPaint(\n'
            '                        painter: _CardAccentPainter(\n'
            '                          color: accentColor!,\n'
            '                          radius: borderRadius,\n'
            '                          dark: dark,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                Padding(padding: padding, child: child),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _CardAccentPainter extends CustomPainter {\n'
            '  const _CardAccentPainter({\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.radius,\n'
            '    required this.dark,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final double radius;\n'
            '  final bool dark;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Path _rail(Size size) {\n'
            '    final double r = math.min(radius, size.height / 2);\n'
            '\n'
            '    // Keep the whole stroke inside the rounded clip and away from the avatar.\n'
            '    // Drawing on x=0 clips half of a stroked path and can make the rail look\n'
            '    // broken at the rounded turns on some pixel ratios.\n'
            '    final double inset = UIConstants.accentStroke / 2 + 3;\n'
            '    final double reach = math.min(6.5, math.max(4.5, r * .28));\n'
            '    final double top = inset;\n'
            '    final double bottom = math.max(top, size.height - inset);\n'
            '    final double upperTurn = math.min(bottom, math.max(top, r));\n'
            '    final double lowerTurn = math.max(\n'
            '      upperTurn,\n'
            '      math.min(bottom, size.height - r),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    return Path()\n'
            '      ..moveTo(inset + reach, top)\n'
            '      ..quadraticBezierTo(inset, top, inset, upperTurn)\n'
            '      ..lineTo(inset, lowerTurn)\n'
            '      ..quadraticBezierTo(inset, bottom, inset + reach, bottom);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {\n'
            '    if (size.isEmpty) return;\n'
            '    final Path path = _rail(size);\n'
            '    canvas.drawPath(\n'
            '      path,\n'
            '      Paint()\n'
            '        ..color = color.withAlpha(dark ? 48 : 32)\n'
            '        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\n'
            '        ..strokeWidth = UIConstants.accentStroke + 4\n'
            '        ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round\n'
            '        ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    canvas.drawPath(\n'
            '      path,\n'
            '      Paint()\n'
            '        ..color = color\n'
            '        ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke\n'
            '        ..strokeWidth = UIConstants.accentStroke\n'
            '        ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round\n'
            '        ..strokeJoin = StrokeJoin.round,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _CardAccentPainter oldDelegate) =>\n'
            '      oldDelegate.color != color ||\n'
            '      oldDelegate.radius != radius ||\n'
            '      oldDelegate.dark != dark;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ScreenHeader extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _ScreenHeader({\n'
            '    required this.title,\n'
            '    this.subtitle,\n'
            '    this.subtitleTrailing,\n'
            '    this.leading,\n'
            '    this.actions = const <Widget>[],\n'
            '    this.color,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String title;\n'
            '  final String? subtitle;\n'
            '  final Widget? subtitleTrailing;\n'
            '  final Widget? leading;\n'
            '  final List<Widget> actions;\n'
            '  final Color? color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    return DecoratedBox(\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '          BoxShadow(\n'
            '            color: Colors.black.withAlpha(dark ? 82 : 9),\n'
            '            blurRadius: dark ? 30 : 24,\n'
            '            spreadRadius: -12,\n'
            '            offset: const Offset(0, 8),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: ClipRect(\n'
            '        child: BackdropFilter(\n'
            '          filter: ui.ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 18, sigmaY: 18),\n'
            '          child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '            decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '              gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '                begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '                end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '                colors: dark\n'
            '                    ? const <Color>[Color(0xD8101726), Color(0xCC060A12)]\n'
            '                    : const <Color>[Color(0xE8FFFFFF), Color(0xD5FFFFFF)],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              // Soft elevation replaces a hard separator line.\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            child: SafeArea(\n'
            '              bottom: false,\n'
            '              child: Padding(\n'
            '                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),\n'
            '                child: Row(\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    if (leading != null) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                      leading!,\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      child: Column(\n'
            '                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          Text(\n'
            '                            title,\n'
            '                            maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: color,\n'
            '                              fontSize: leading == null ? 28 : 24,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,\n'
            '                              letterSpacing: -.4,\n'
            '                              shadows: color == null\n'
            '                                  ? null\n'
            '                                  : AppStyles.inkGlow(color!),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          if (subtitle != null) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                            const SizedBox(height: 2),\n'
            '                            Row(\n'
            '                              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                Flexible(\n'
            '                                  child: Text(\n'
            '                                    subtitle!,\n'
            '                                    maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                                    style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                                      color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                                      fontSize: 10,\n'
            '                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                                      letterSpacing: 1.0,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                                if (subtitleTrailing != null) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                                  const SizedBox(width: 9),\n'
            '                                  subtitleTrailing!,\n'
            '                                ],\n'
            '                              ],\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ],\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    if (actions.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                      ...actions,\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'

            '\n'
            'class _SearchBox extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _SearchBox({\n'
            '    required this.hint,\n'
            '    required this.onChanged,\n'
            '    this.color = appleBlue,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String hint;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<String> onChanged;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_SearchBox> createState() => _SearchBoxState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SearchBoxState extends State<_SearchBox> {\n'
            '  Timer? _debounce;\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _onChanged(String value) {\n'
            '    _debounce?.cancel();\n'
            '    _debounce = Timer(\n'
            '      const Duration(milliseconds: 140),\n'
            '      () => widget.onChanged(value),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _onSubmitted(String value) {\n'
            '    _debounce?.cancel();\n'
            '    widget.onChanged(value);\n'
            '    FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    _debounce?.cancel();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final OutlineInputBorder idleBorder = OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '      borderSide: AppStyles.hairline(context, accent: widget.color),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return TextField(\n'
            '      onChanged: _onChanged,\n'
            '      onSubmitted: _onSubmitted,\n'
            '      onTapOutside: (_) => FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus(),\n'
            '      cursorColor: widget.color,\n'
            '      textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,\n'
            '      style: TextStyle(\n'
            '        color: widget.color,\n'
            '        fontSize: 16,\n'
            '        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '        shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(widget.color),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      decoration: InputDecoration(\n'
            '        hintText: widget.hint,\n'
            '        filled: true,\n'
            '        fillColor: widget.color.withAlpha(dark ? 12 : 8),\n'
            '        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(\n'
            '          horizontal: 20,\n'
            '          vertical: 16,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        hintStyle: TextStyle(\n'
            '          color: widget.color.withAlpha(160),\n'
            '          fontSize: 16,\n'
            '          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        prefixIcon: Icon(\n'
            '          Icons.search_rounded,\n'
            '          color: widget.color,\n'
            '          shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(widget.color),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        prefixIconConstraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 48),\n'
            '        enabledBorder: idleBorder,\n'
            '        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '          borderSide: BorderSide(color: widget.color, width: 1.4),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DateField extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _DateField({required this.controller});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final TextEditingController controller;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _pickDate(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();\n'
            '    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();\n'
            '    final DateTime firstDate = DateTime(1900);\n'
            '    final DateTime lastDate = DateTime(now.year + 100, 12, 31);\n'
            '    final DateTime parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(controller.text) ?? now;\n'
            '    final DateTime initial = parsed.isBefore(firstDate)\n'
            '        ? firstDate\n'
            '        : parsed.isAfter(lastDate)\n'
            '            ? lastDate\n'
            '            : parsed;\n'
            '    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      initialDate: initial,\n'
            '      firstDate: firstDate,\n'
            '      lastDate: lastDate,\n'
            '      helpText: \'SELECT DATE\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (picked != null) {\n'
            '      controller.text = DateFormat(\'yyyy-MM-dd\').format(picked);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextField(\n'
            '        controller: controller,\n'
            '        readOnly: true,\n'
            '        enableInteractiveSelection: false,\n'
            '        onTap: () => unawaited(_pickDate(context)),\n'
            '        decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '          labelText: \'Date (YYYY-MM-DD)\',\n'
            '          prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_today_rounded),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'

            '              AppStyles.hairline(context, accent: color, active: true),\n'

            '                  shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(foregroundColor),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'

            'class _AmountHero extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _AmountHero({\n'
            '    required this.label,\n'
            '    required this.value,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final String value;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final Color textColor = dark\n'
            '        ? Color.lerp(Colors.white, color, .72)!\n'
            '        : Color.lerp(const Color(0xFF06111F), color, .60)!;\n'
            '    final List<Color> background = dark\n'
            '        ? <Color>[\n'
            '            Color.lerp(darkGlassTop, color, .21)!.withAlpha(232),\n'
            '            Color.lerp(\n'
            '              darkGlassBottom,\n'
            '              _toneCompanion(color),\n'
            '              .16,\n'
            '            )!\n'
            '                .withAlpha(218),\n'
            '            Color.lerp(Colors.black, color, .18)!.withAlpha(204),\n'
            '          ]\n'
            '        : <Color>[\n'
            '            Color.lerp(Colors.white, color, .11)!.withAlpha(240),\n'
            '            Color.lerp(\n'
            '              Colors.white,\n'
            '              _toneCompanion(color),\n'
            '              .08,\n'
            '            )!\n'
            '                .withAlpha(218),\n'
            '            Color.lerp(Colors.white, color, .13)!.withAlpha(194),\n'
            '          ];\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      width: double.infinity,\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '          begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '          end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '          colors: background,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.heroRadius),\n'
            '        border: AppStyles.glassBorder(context),\n'
            '        boxShadow: AppStyles.glow(context, color, strong: true),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: _HeroValue(\n'
            '        label: label,\n'
            '        value: value,\n'
            '        color: textColor,\n'
            '        glow: color,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _HeroValue extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _HeroValue({\n'
            '    required this.label,\n'
            '    required this.value,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.glow,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final String value;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final Color glow;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            label.toUpperCase(),\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              fontSize: 11,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '              letterSpacing: .8,\n'
            '              shadows: <Shadow>[\n'
            '                Shadow(color: glow.withAlpha(78), blurRadius: 12)\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '          FittedBox(\n'
            '            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'
            '            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '            child: Text(\n'
            '              value,\n'
            '              maxLines: 1,\n'
            '              softWrap: false,\n'
            '              style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                color: color,\n'
            '                fontSize: 32,\n'
            '                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                fontFeatures: AppStyles.tabularFigures,\n'
            '                letterSpacing: -.8,\n'
            '                shadows: <Shadow>[\n'
            '                  Shadow(color: glow.withAlpha(94), blurRadius: 16),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ListCard extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _ListCard({\n'
            '    required this.title,\n'
            '    required this.subtitle,\n'
            '    required this.icon,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    this.onTap,\n'
            '    this.destinationBuilder,\n'
            '    this.trailing,\n'
            '    this.onDelete,\n'
            '    this.avatarText,\n'
            '  }) : assert(\n'
            '          onTap == null || destinationBuilder == null,\n'
            '          \'Provide at most one of onTap or destinationBuilder.\',\n'
            '        );\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String title;\n'
            '  final String subtitle;\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onTap;\n'
            '  final WidgetBuilder? destinationBuilder;\n'
            '  final String? trailing;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onDelete;\n'
            '  final String? avatarText;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    Widget buildCard(VoidCallback? action) => _Pressable(\n'
            '          onTap: action,\n'
            '          animatePress: destinationBuilder == null,\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.cardRadius),\n'
            '          feedbackColor: color,\n'
            '          child: _GlassCard(\n'
            '            borderRadius: UIConstants.cardRadius,\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.compactCardPadding,\n'
            '            accentColor: color,\n'
            '            shadowColor: color,\n'
            '            child: Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Container(\n'
            '                  width: 44,\n'
            '                  height: 44,\n'
            '                  decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                    gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '                      end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '                      colors: <Color>[color.withAlpha(34), color.withAlpha(16)],\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    borderRadius:\n'
            '                        BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.compactRadius),\n'
            '                    border: Border.fromBorderSide(\n'
            '                      AppStyles.hairline(context, accent: color, active: true),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    boxShadow: AppStyles.jewelDepth(context, color),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  child: avatarText == null\n'
            '                      ? Icon(\n'
            '                          icon,\n'
            '                          color: color,\n'
            '                          size: 20,\n'
            '                          shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      : Center(\n'
            '                          child: Text(\n'
            '                            avatarText!,\n'
            '                            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: color,\n'
            '                              fontSize: 18,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                              shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 16),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: Column(\n'
            '                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        title,\n'
            '                        maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                        style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                          color: color,\n'
            '                          fontSize: 16,\n'
            '                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                          shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        subtitle,\n'
            '                        maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                        style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                          color: color.withAlpha(190),\n'
            '                          fontSize: 13,\n'
            '                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                if (trailing != null) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    trailing!,\n'
            '                    style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                      color: color,\n'
            '                      fontSize: 16,\n'
            '                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                      fontFeatures: AppStyles.tabularFigures,\n'
            '                      shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '                if (onDelete != null)\n'
            '                  Padding(\n'
            '                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 9),\n'
            '                    child: _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      onTap: onDelete!,\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete $title\',\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  )\n'
            '                else if (action != null)\n'
            '                  Icon(\n'
            '                    Icons.chevron_right_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: color.withAlpha(150),\n'
            '                    shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '\n'
            '    final Widget card = destinationBuilder == null\n'
            '        ? buildCard(onTap)\n'
            '        : _FastRouteLauncher(\n'
            '            destinationBuilder: destinationBuilder!,\n'
            '            sourceBuilder: (VoidCallback action) => buildCard(action),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '    return Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12), child: card);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SectionTitle extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _SectionTitle(\n'
            '    this.title, {\n'
            '    this.actions = const <Widget>[],\n'
            '    this.color,\n'
            '  });\n'

            '              child: Text(\n'
            '                title,\n'

            '                  color: color,\n'
            '                  fontSize: 18,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,\n'
            '                  letterSpacing: -.2,\n'
            '                  shadows: color == null\n'
            '                      ? null\n'
            '                      : <Shadow>[\n'
            '                          Shadow(color: color!.withAlpha(68), blurRadius: 10),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
