            '            ),\n'
            '            ...actions,\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MonthYearPicker extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MonthYearPicker({\n'
            '    required this.month,\n'
            '    required this.year,\n'
            '    required this.availablePeriods,\n'
            '    required this.onChanged,\n'
            '    this.color = appleBlue,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final int month;\n'
            '  final int year;\n'
            '  final List<DateTime> availablePeriods;\n'
            '  final void Function(int month, int year) onChanged;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final List<int> years = availablePeriods\n'
            '        .map((DateTime period) => period.year)\n'
            '        .toSet()\n'
            '        .toList()\n'
            '      ..sort((int a, int b) => b.compareTo(a));\n'
            '    final int? selectedYear =\n'
            '        years.contains(year) ? year : (years.isEmpty ? null : years.first);\n'
            '    final List<int> months = selectedYear == null\n'
            '        ? <int>[]\n'
            '        : (availablePeriods\n'
            '            .where((DateTime period) => period.year == selectedYear)\n'
            '            .map((DateTime period) => period.month)\n'
            '            .toSet()\n'
            '            .toList()\n'
            '          ..sort());\n'
            '    final int? selectedMonth =\n'
            '        months.contains(month) ? month : (months.isEmpty ? null : months.last);\n'
            '    return Row(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: DropdownButtonFormField<int>(\n'
            '            key: ValueKey<String>(\'month-$selectedYear-$selectedMonth\'),\n'
            '            initialValue: selectedMonth,\n'
            '            hint: const Text(\'No month\'),\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(color: color, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),\n'
            '            iconEnabledColor: color,\n'
            '            decoration: _pickerDecoration(color),\n'
            '            items: months\n'
            '                .map(\n'
            '                  (int item) => DropdownMenuItem<int>(\n'
            '                    value: item,\n'
            '                    child: Text(\n'
            '                      DateFormat.MMMM().format(DateTime(2024, item)),\n'
            '                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                )\n'
            '                .toList(),\n'
            '            onChanged: selectedYear == null\n'
            '                ? null\n'
            '                : (int? value) {\n'
            '                    if (value != null) {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '                      onChanged(value, selectedYear);\n'
            '                    }\n'
            '                  },\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '        SizedBox(\n'
            '          width: 118,\n'
            '          child: DropdownButtonFormField<int>(\n'
            '            key: ValueKey<String>(\'year-$selectedYear\'),\n'
            '            initialValue: selectedYear,\n'
            '            hint: const Text(\'No year\'),\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(color: color, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),\n'
            '            iconEnabledColor: color,\n'
            '            decoration: _pickerDecoration(color),\n'
            '            items: years\n'
            '                .map(\n'
            '                  (int item) =>\n'
            '                      DropdownMenuItem<int>(value: item, child: Text(\'$item\')),\n'
            '                )\n'
            '                .toList(),\n'
            '            onChanged: years.isEmpty\n'
            '                ? null\n'
            '                : (int? value) {\n'
            '                    if (value == null) return;\n'
            '                    final DateTime? target = LedgerMath.resolveRecordPeriod(\n'
            '                      availablePeriods,\n'
            '                      month: month,\n'
            '                      year: value,\n'
            '                    );\n'
            '                    if (target == null || target.year != value) return;\n'
            '                    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '                    onChanged(target.month, target.year);\n'
            '                  },\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'InputDecoration _pickerDecoration([Color color = appleBlue]) => InputDecoration(\n'
            '      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 16),\n'
            '      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '        borderSide: BorderSide(\n'
            '          color: color.withAlpha(55),\n'
            '          width: UIConstants.borderWidth,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.inputRadius),\n'
            '        borderSide: BorderSide(color: color, width: 1.4),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SheetFrame extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _SheetFrame({\n'
            '    required this.title,\n'
            '    required this.children,\n'
            '    this.centerTitle = false,\n'
            '    this.beforeTitle,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String title;\n'
            '  final List<Widget> children;\n'
            '  final bool centerTitle;\n'
            '  final Widget? beforeTitle;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    return DecoratedBox(\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '          begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '          end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '          colors: dark\n'
            '              ? const <Color>[Color(0xF51C2230), Color(0xF00A0F1C)]\n'
            '              : const <Color>[Color(0xFAFFFFFF), Color(0xF4FFFFFF)],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(\n'
            '          top: Radius.circular(UIConstants.sheetRadius),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        border: Border(top: AppStyles.hairline(context)),\n'
            '        boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '          BoxShadow(\n'
            '            color: Colors.black.withAlpha(dark ? 154 : 34),\n'
            '            blurRadius: dark ? 70 : 58,\n'
            '            spreadRadius: -5,\n'
            '            offset: Offset.zero,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: SafeArea(\n'
            '        top: false,\n'
            '        child: SingleChildScrollView(\n'
            '          padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(\n'
            '            24,\n'
            '            12,\n'
            '            24,\n'
            '            MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom + 24,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Column(\n'
            '            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              Align(\n'
            '                child: Container(\n'
            '                  width: 40,\n'
            '                  height: 4,\n'
            '                  decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                    color: dark\n'
            '                        ? Colors.white.withAlpha(55)\n'
            '                        : Colors.black.withAlpha(34),\n'
            '                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '              if (beforeTitle != null) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                beforeTitle!,\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '              Text(\n'
            '                title,\n'
            '                textAlign: centerTitle ? TextAlign.center : TextAlign.start,\n'
            '                style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                  fontSize: 24,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,\n'
            '                  letterSpacing: -.4,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '              ...children,\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<T?> _openSheet<T>(BuildContext context, Widget child) {\n'
            '  final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '  return showModalBottomSheet<T>(\n'
            '    context: context,\n'
            '    isScrollControlled: true,\n'
            '    useSafeArea: true,\n'
            '    requestFocus: true,\n'
            '    backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '    barrierColor: Colors.black.withAlpha(105),\n'
            '    elevation: 0,\n'
            '    sheetAnimationStyle: reduceMotion\n'
            '        ? AnimationStyle.noAnimation\n'
            '        : const AnimationStyle(\n'
            '            duration: UIConstants.routeIn,\n'
            '            reverseDuration: UIConstants.routeOut,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '    builder: (BuildContext context) => child,\n'
            '  );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<bool> _confirm(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  String title,\n'
            '  String message, {\n'
            '  bool dangerous = true,\n'
            '}) async {\n'
            '  final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '  final bool? result = await showDialog<bool>(\n'
            '    context: context,\n'
            '    requestFocus: true,\n'
            '    animationStyle: reduceMotion\n'
            '        ? AnimationStyle.noAnimation\n'
            '        : const AnimationStyle(\n'
            '            duration: Duration(milliseconds: 240),\n'
            '            reverseDuration: Duration(milliseconds: 180),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '    builder: (BuildContext context) => AlertDialog(\n'
            '      title: Text(title, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)),\n'
            '      content: Text(message),\n'
            '      actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '        TextButton(\n'
            '          autofocus: dangerous,\n'
            '          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),\n'
            '          child: const Text(\'Cancel\'),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        TextButton(\n'
            '          autofocus: !dangerous,\n'
            '          onPressed: () {\n'
            '            if (dangerous) HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();\n'
            '            Navigator.pop(context, true);\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          child: Text(\n'
            '            dangerous ? \'Delete\' : \'Continue\',\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(color: dangerous ? appleRed : appleBlue),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '  return result ?? false;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'void _toast(BuildContext context, String message, {bool error = false}) {\n'
            '  if (error) HapticFeedback.errorNotification();\n'
            '  final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '  final ScaffoldMessengerState messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);\n'
            '  messenger.hideCurrentSnackBar();\n'
            '  messenger.showSnackBar(\n'
            '    SnackBar(\n'
            '      content: Row(\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          Icon(\n'
            '            error ? Icons.error_rounded : Icons.check_circle_rounded,\n'
            '            color: error ? appleRed : appleGreen,\n'
            '            size: 20,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '          Expanded(child: Text(message)),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    snackBarAnimationStyle: reduceMotion\n'
            '        ? AnimationStyle.noAnimation\n'
            '        : const AnimationStyle(\n'
            '            duration: Duration(milliseconds: 180),\n'
            '            reverseDuration: Duration(milliseconds: 140),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<void> _runMutation(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  Future<void> Function() mutation,\n'
            '  String success,\n'
            ') async {\n'
            '  try {\n'
            '    await mutation();\n'
            '    HapticFeedback.successNotification();\n'
            '    if (context.mounted) _toast(context, success);\n'
            '  } catch (error) {\n'
            '    if (context.mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'String _newId(String prefix) =>\n'
            '    \'${prefix}_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_${_ids.v4().replaceAll(\'-\', \'\').substring(0, 8)}\';\n'
            '\n'
            'String _today() => DateFormat(\'yyyy-MM-dd\').format(DateTime.now());\n'
            '\n'
            'String _displayDate(dynamic value) {\n'
            '  final DateTime? date = LedgerMath.date(value);\n'
            '  return date == null\n'
            '      ? \'${value ?? \'—\'}\'\n'
            '      : DateFormat(\'dd MMM yyyy\').format(date);\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'String _money(dynamic value) {\n'
            '  final double number = LedgerMath.number(value).abs();\n'
            '  return \'₹${NumberFormat(\'#,##,##0\', \'en_IN\').format(number.round())}\';\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'String _signedMoney(dynamic value) {\n'
            '  final double number = LedgerMath.number(value);\n'
            '  if (number > 0) return \'+${_money(number)}\';\n'
            '  if (number < 0) return \'-${_money(number)}\';\n'
            '  return \'₹0\';\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'String _cleanKey(dynamic value) => LedgerMath.cleanKey(value);\n'
            '\n'
            'Map<String, dynamic> _map(dynamic value) => LedgerCodec.objectMap(value);\n'
            '\n'
            'List<Map<String, dynamic>> _rows(dynamic value) =>\n'
            '    LedgerCodec.canonicalList(value);\n'
            '\n'
            'Color _tone(double value, {Color neutral = appleBlue}) {\n'
            '  if (value > .000001) return appleGreen;\n'
            '  if (value < -.000001) return semanticRed;\n'
            '  return neutral;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Color _toneCompanion(Color color) {\n'
            '  if (color == appleBlue) return appleBlue2;\n'
            '  if (color == appleGreen) return appleGreen2;\n'
            '  if (color == salaryGreen) return const Color(0xFF059669);\n'
            '  if (color == appleRed || color == semanticRed) return appleRed2;\n'
            '  if (color == diaryOrange || color == appleOrange) return diaryOrange2;\n'
            '  return Color.lerp(color, Colors.black, .22)!;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Color _expenseToneForTotal(double total) =>\n'
            '    total > .000001 ? semanticRed : appleBlue;\n'
            '\n'
            'List<Color> _moduleTabColors(LedgerProjection projection) => <Color>[\n'
            '      appleBlue,\n'
            '      _tone(projection.milkLifetimeNet),\n'
            '      _tone(projection.creditLifetimeNet),\n'
            '      _expenseToneForTotal(projection.expenseMonthTotal),\n'
            '      _tone(projection.salaryMonthNet),\n'
            '      diaryOrange,\n'
            '      appleBlue,\n'
            '    ];\n'
            '\n'
            'class _AiHubButton extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _AiHubButton({required this.onTap});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    const BorderRadius radius = BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(20));\n'
            '    return _Pressable(\n'
            '      onTap: onTap,\n'
            '      animatePress: false,\n'
            '      semanticLabel: \'Open AI Hub\',\n'
            '      borderRadius: radius,\n'
            '      child: Container(\n'
            '        width: 68,\n'
            '        height: 40,\n'
            '        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,\n'
            '        decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '          gradient: const LinearGradient(\n'
            '            begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '            end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '            colors: <Color>[\n'
            '              Color(0xFF397BFF),\n'
            '              Color(0xFF7957E8),\n'
            '              Color(0xFFB64FD2),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          borderRadius: radius,\n'
            '          border: Border.all(\n'
            '            color: Colors.white.withAlpha(dark ? 48 : 124),\n'
            '            width: .8,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '            BoxShadow(\n'
            '              color: const Color(0xFF7957E8).withAlpha(dark ? 76 : 54),\n'
            '              blurRadius: 18,\n'
            '              spreadRadius: -5,\n'
            '              offset: const Offset(0, 6),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            BoxShadow(\n'
            '              color: Colors.black.withAlpha(dark ? 34 : 12),\n'
            '              blurRadius: 6,\n'
            '              spreadRadius: -2,\n'
            '              offset: const Offset(0, 2),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        child: Stack(\n'
            '          fit: StackFit.expand,\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            Positioned(\n'
            '              left: 16,\n'
            '              right: 16,\n'
            '              top: 0,\n'
            '              height: 1,\n'
            '              child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '                decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                  color: Colors.white.withAlpha(150),\n'
            '                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const Row(\n'
            '              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, color: Colors.white, size: 15),\n'
            '                SizedBox(width: 5),\n'
            '                Text(\n'
            '                  \'AI HUB\',\n'
            '                  style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                    color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                    fontSize: 9.5,\n'
            '                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                    letterSpacing: .35,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class DashboardScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const DashboardScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<DashboardScreen> createState() => _DashboardScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DashboardScreenState extends State<DashboardScreen>\n'
            '    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {\n'
            '  late final AnimationController _revealController;\n'
            '  bool _revealScheduled = false;\n'
            '\n'
            '  LedgerSyncService get sync => widget.sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _revealController = AnimationController(\n'
            '      vsync: this,\n'
            '      duration: UIConstants.dashboardReveal,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didChangeDependencies() {\n'
            '    super.didChangeDependencies();\n'
            '    if (AppMotion.reduce(context)) {\n'
            '      _revealController.value = 1;\n'
            '      _revealScheduled = true;\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (_revealScheduled || !AppMotion.enabled(context)) return;\n'
            '    _revealScheduled = true;\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '      if (AppMotion.reduce(context)) {\n'
            '        _revealController.value = 1;\n'
            '      } else if (TickerMode.valuesOf(context).enabled) {\n'
            '        _revealController.forward();\n'
            '      } else {\n'
            '        // The dashboard became off-screen before its first frame. Let the\n'
            '        // next enabled TickerMode dependency change schedule it once.\n'
            '        _revealScheduled = false;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    _revealController.dispose();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _logout(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    if (sync.pendingWrites > 0) {\n'
            '      final bool continueLogout = await _confirm(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Sync before logout\',\n'
            '        \'${sync.pendingWrites} change(s) are waiting for Firebase. The app will try to sync now; logout will be blocked if the connection is unavailable.\',\n'
            '        dangerous: false,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (!continueLogout || !context.mounted) return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final bool safe = await sync.drainBeforeLogout();\n'
            '    if (!context.mounted) return;\n'
            '    if (!safe) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Logout blocked: pending changes are still offline. Connect once, then retry.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      if (!kIsWeb) await GoogleSignIn().signOut();\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\n'
            '    await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final DashboardTotals totals = sync.currentProjection.dashboard;\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Dashboard\',\n'
            '          subtitle: \'AARISH DAIRY\',\n'
            '          subtitleTrailing: _FastRouteLauncher(\n'
            '            destinationBuilder: (_) => AiHubScreen(sync: sync),\n'
            '            sourceBuilder: (VoidCallback openRoute) =>\n'
            '                _AiHubButton(onTap: openRoute),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _CircleAction(\n'
            '              icon: Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded,\n'
            '              color: exportIndigo,\n'
            '              semanticLabel: \'Export reports\',\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_showExportCenter(context, sync)),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            _CircleAction(\n'
            '              icon: sync.darkMode\n'
            '                  ? Icons.light_mode_rounded\n'
            '                  : Icons.dark_mode_rounded,\n'
            '              color: sync.darkMode ? themeAmber : themeIndigo,\n'
            '              semanticLabel: sync.darkMode\n'
            '                  ? \'Switch to light theme\'\n'
            '                  : \'Switch to dark theme\',\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(sync.setDarkMode(!sync.darkMode)),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            _CircleAction(\n'
            '              icon: Icons.logout_rounded,\n'
            '              color: sessionSlate,\n'
            '              semanticLabel: \'Logout\',\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_logout(context)),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: RefreshIndicator.adaptive(\n'
            '            onRefresh: () async {\n'
            '              HapticFeedback.lightImpact();\n'
            '              await sync.reconcile(reason: \'pull-to-refresh\');\n'
            '              if (context.mounted) HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '            },\n'
            '            child: ListView(\n'
            '              key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'dashboard-scroll\'),\n'
            '              physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(\n'
            '                parent: BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                if (sync.pendingWrites > 0 || sync.syncing)\n'
            '                  Padding(\n'
            '                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),\n'
            '                    child: _SyncPill(sync: sync),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                GridView.count(\n'
            '                  crossAxisCount: 2,\n'
            '                  crossAxisSpacing: 13,\n'
            '                  mainAxisSpacing: 13,\n'
            '                  shrinkWrap: true,\n'
            '                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                  clipBehavior: Clip.none,\n'
            '                  childAspectRatio: 1.0,\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _DashboardCardReveal(\n'
            '                      animation: _revealController,\n'
            '                      order: 0,\n'
            '                      child: _MetricCard(\n'
            '                        icon: Icons.handshake_rounded,\n'
            '                        label: \'To Receive (+)\',\n'
            '                        value: _money(totals.toReceive),\n'
            '                        color: appleGreen,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    _DashboardCardReveal(\n'
            '                      animation: _revealController,\n'
            '                      order: 1,\n'
            '                      child: _MetricCard(\n'
            '                        icon: Icons.request_quote_rounded,\n'
            '                        label: \'To Pay (-)\',\n'
            '                        value: _money(totals.toPay),\n'
            '                        color: appleRed,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    _DashboardCardReveal(\n'
            '                      animation: _revealController,\n'
            '                      order: 2,\n'
            '                      child: _MetricCard(\n'
            '                        icon: premiumExpenseIcon,\n'
            '                        label: \'Month Expense\',\n'
            '                        value: _money(totals.monthExpense),\n'
            '                        color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    _DashboardCardReveal(\n'
            '                      animation: _revealController,\n'
            '                      order: 3,\n'
            '                      child: _MetricCard(\n'
            '                        icon: Icons.trending_up_rounded,\n'
            '                        label: \'Month Profit\',\n'
            '                        value: _signedMoney(totals.monthProfit),\n'
            '                        color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                _DashboardCardReveal(\n'
            '                  animation: _revealController,\n'
            '                  order: 4,\n'
            '                  child: _FastRouteLauncher(\n'
            '                    destinationBuilder: (_) => PartyLedgerScreen(sync: sync),\n'
            '                    sourceBuilder: (VoidCallback openRoute) => _Pressable(\n'
            '                      onTap: openRoute,\n'
            '                      animatePress: false,\n'
            '                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),\n'
            '                      feedbackColor: const Color(0xFF9333EA),\n'
            '                      child: const _GlassCard(\n'
            '                        shadowColor: Color(0xFF9333EA),\n'
            '                        child: Row(\n'
            '                          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                            _LedgerIcon(\n'
            '                              icon: Icons.contact_page_rounded,\n'
            '                              color: Color(0xFF9333EA),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                            SizedBox(width: 15),\n'
            '                            Expanded(\n'
            '                              child: Column(\n'
            '                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                                children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                  Text(\n'
            '                                    \'Party Ledger\',\n'
            '                                    style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                                      fontSize: 18,\n'
            '                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                  SizedBox(height: 3),\n'
            '                                  Text(\n'
