            '\n'
            'class _DashboardCardReveal extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _DashboardCardReveal({\n'
            '    required this.animation,\n'
            '    required this.order,\n'
            '    required this.child,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Animation<double> animation;\n'
            '  final int order;\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final double start = math.min(order * .06, .30).toDouble();\n'
            '    final Animation<double> reveal = CurvedAnimation(\n'
            '      parent: animation,\n'
            '      curve: Interval(\n'
            '        start,\n'
            '        math.min(start + .58, 1.0),\n'
            '        curve: UIConstants.motionOut,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return FadeTransition(\n'
            '      opacity: reveal,\n'
            '      child: SlideTransition(\n'
            '        position: Tween<Offset>(\n'
            '          begin: const Offset(0, .045),\n'
            '          end: Offset.zero,\n'
            '        ).animate(reveal),\n'
            '        child: RepaintBoundary(child: child),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SyncPill extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _SyncPill({required this.sync});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: Container(\n'
            '          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 7),\n'
            '          decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '            color: appleBlue.withAlpha(20),\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),\n'
            '            border: Border.all(color: appleBlue.withAlpha(40)),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Row(\n'
            '            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              if (sync.syncing)\n'
            '                const SizedBox(\n'
            '                  width: 13,\n'
            '                  height: 13,\n'
            '                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.8),\n'
            '                )\n'
            '              else\n'
            '                const Icon(Icons.cloud_upload_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleBlue, size: 15),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(width: 7),\n'
            '              Text(\n'
            '                sync.syncing\n'
            '                    ? \'Syncing safely…\'\n'
            '                    : \'${sync.pendingWrites} change(s) queued\',\n'
            '                style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                  color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                  fontSize: 11,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MetricCard extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MetricCard({\n'
            '    required this.icon,\n'
            '    required this.label,\n'
            '    required this.value,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final String value;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _GlassCard(\n'
            '        padding: UIConstants.compactCardPadding,\n'
            '        borderRadius: UIConstants.cardRadius,\n'
            '        tintColor: color,\n'
            '        shadowColor: color,\n'
            '        child: Column(\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _LedgerIcon(icon: icon, color: color, size: 46),\n'
            '            const Spacer(),\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              label.toUpperCase(),\n'
            '              maxLines: 1,\n'
            '              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '              style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                color: systemGray,\n'
            '                fontSize: 10,\n'
            '                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '                letterSpacing: .65,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '            FittedBox(\n'
            '              fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'
            '              alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '              child: Text(\n'
            '                value,\n'
            '                style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                  color: color,\n'
            '                  fontSize: 24,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                  fontFeatures: AppStyles.tabularFigures,\n'
            '                  letterSpacing: -.7,\n'
            '                  shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color, strong: true),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerIcon extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerIcon({required this.icon, required this.color, this.size = 48});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final double size;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final double radius = size * .32;\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      width: size,\n'
            '      height: size,\n'
            '      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '          begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '          end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '          colors: <Color>[\n'
            '            color.withAlpha(dark ? 48 : 34),\n'
            '            color.withAlpha(dark ? 26 : 16),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),\n'
            '        border: Border.all(\n'
            '          color: color.withAlpha(dark ? 88 : 72),\n'
            '          width: UIConstants.borderWidth,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        boxShadow: AppStyles.jewelDepth(context, color),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: Stack(\n'
            '        fit: StackFit.expand,\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          Positioned(\n'
            '            left: radius * .55,\n'
            '            right: radius * .55,\n'
            '            top: 0,\n'
            '            height: 1,\n'
            '            child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '              decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '                  colors: <Color>[\n'
            '                    Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                    Colors.white.withAlpha(dark ? 68 : 178),\n'
            '                    Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Center(\n'
            '            child: Icon(\n'
            '              icon,\n'
            '              size: size * .43,\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color, strong: true),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class PartyLedgerScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const PartyLedgerScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<PartyLedgerScreen> createState() => _PartyLedgerScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _PartyLedgerScreenState extends State<PartyLedgerScreen> {\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final List<PartyBalance> balances =\n'
            '        widget.sync.currentProjection.partyBalances\n'
            '            .where(\n'
            '              (PartyBalance item) =>\n'
            '                  item.name.toLowerCase().contains(_query.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '            )\n'
            '            .toList();\n'
            '    return Scaffold(\n'
            '      body: Column(\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '            leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '            title: \'Party Ledger\',\n'
            '            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '            actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '              _CircleAction(\n'
            '                icon: Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded,\n'
            '                color: exportIndigo,\n'
            '                semanticLabel: \'Share Party Ledger PDF\',\n'
            '                onTap: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                  _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '                    \'Party Ledger\',\n'
            '                    <String>[\'Party\', \'Milk\', \'Credit\', \'Net\'],\n'
            '                    balances\n'
            '                        .map(\n'
            '                          (PartyBalance item) => <String>[\n'
            '                            item.name,\n'
            '                            _plainMoney(item.milk),\n'
            '                            _plainMoney(item.credit),\n'
            '                            _plainMoney(item.net),\n'
            '                          ],\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                        .toList(),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            child: ListView(\n'
            '              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '              padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _SearchBox(\n'
            '                  hint: \'Search party name…\',\n'
            '                  onChanged: (String value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                if (balances.isEmpty)\n'
            '                  const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                    Icons.contact_page_rounded,\n'
            '                    \'No party balances found\',\n'
            '                  )\n'
            '                else\n'
            '                  ...balances.map((PartyBalance item) {\n'
            '                    final Color color = _tone(item.net);\n'
            '                    final String label =\n'
            '                        item.net >= 0 ? \'TO RECEIVE\' : \'TO PAY\';\n'
            '                    return _ListCard(\n'
            '                      title: item.name,\n'
            '                      subtitle:\n'
            '                          \'$label • Milk ${_signedMoney(item.milk)} • Credit ${_signedMoney(item.credit)}\',\n'
            '                      icon: Icons.person_rounded,\n'
            '                      color: color,\n'
            '                      avatarText: item.name.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '                          ? \'P\'\n'
            '                          : item.name.trim()[0].toUpperCase(),\n'
            '                      trailing: _signedMoney(item.net),\n'
            '                    );\n'
            '                  }),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class MilkScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const MilkScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<MilkScreen> createState() => _MilkScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MilkScreenState extends State<MilkScreen> {\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addCustomer() async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController name = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final TextEditingController rate = TextEditingController(\n'
            '      text: LedgerMath.defaultMilkRate.toStringAsFixed(0),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final String? type = await _openSheet<String>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      Builder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext) => _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'New Milk Customer\',\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: name,\n'
            '              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                hintText: \'Customer Name\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_rounded),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: rate,\n'
            '              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(\n'
            '                decimal: true,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '                FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                hintText: \'Rate per KG (₹)\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.currency_rupee_rounded),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Seller\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleGreen,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Create seller milk customer\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'lene_wala\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Buyer\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.remove_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleRed,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Create buyer milk customer\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'dene_wala\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (type == null || !mounted) {\n'
            '      name.dispose();\n'
            '      rate.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String customerName = _cleanKey(name.text);\n'
            '    final double customerRate =\n'
            '        double.tryParse(rate.text) ?? LedgerMath.defaultMilkRate;\n'
            '    name.dispose();\n'
            '    rate.dispose();\n'
            '    if (customerName.isEmpty || customerRate <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a valid name and rate.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(widget.sync.state[\'milkDB\']);\n'
            '    final bool duplicate = database.keys.any(\n'
            '      (String key) => key.toLowerCase() == customerName.toLowerCase(),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (duplicate) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Customer already exists — duplicate not created.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'milkDB/$customerName\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'rate\': customerRate,\n'
            '            \'type\': type,\n'
            '            \'records\': <dynamic>[],\n'
            '            \'canonicalNameV18\': customerName.toLowerCase(),\n'
            '            \'createdAtV18\': DateTime.now().toIso8601String(),\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'milk-profile-create\'),\n'
            '      \'Customer added safely!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(widget.sync.state[\'milkDB\']);\n'
            '    final LedgerProjection projection = widget.sync.currentProjection;\n'
            '    final Color moduleColor = _tone(projection.milkLifetimeNet);\n'
            '    final List<String> names = database.keys\n'
            '        .where(\n'
            '          (String name) => name.toLowerCase().contains(_query.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        .toList()\n'
            '      ..sort(\n'
            '        (String a, String b) => a.toLowerCase().compareTo(b.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Milk Record\',\n'
            '          color: moduleColor,\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'New\',\n'
            '              compact: true,\n'
            '              color: moduleColor,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_addCustomer()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: ListView(\n'
            '            key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'milk-scroll\'),\n'
            '            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              _SearchBox(\n'
            '                hint: \'Search customer…\',\n'
            '                color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                onChanged: (String value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '              if (names.isEmpty)\n'
            '                const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.water_drop_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'No customers found\',\n'
            '                  color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                  prominent: true,\n'
            '                )\n'
            '              else\n'
            '                ...names.map((String name) {\n'
            '                  final Map<String, dynamic> profile = _map(database[name]);\n'
            '                  final MilkTotals totals =\n'
            '                      projection.milkTotalsByProfile[name]!;\n'
            '                  final Color color = _tone(totals.netAmount);\n'
            '                  return _ListCard(\n'
            '                    title: name,\n'
            '                    subtitle:\n'
            '                        \'${totals.netKg >= 0 ? \'Given\' : \'Taken\'} ${totals.netKg.abs().toStringAsFixed(2)} KG • ${profile[\'rate\'] ?? LedgerMath.defaultMilkRate}/KG\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.water_drop_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: color,\n'
            '                    avatarText: name.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '                        ? \'M\'\n'
            '                        : name.trim()[0].toUpperCase(),\n'
            '                    trailing: _signedMoney(totals.netAmount),\n'
            '                    destinationBuilder: (_) =>\n'
            '                        MilkDetailScreen(sync: widget.sync, customerName: name),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _TransactionPairButton extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _TransactionPairButton({\n'
            '    required this.label,\n'
            '    required this.icon,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.onTap,\n'
            '    this.semanticLabel,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '  final String? semanticLabel;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final Color companion = Color.lerp(color, Colors.black, .10)!;\n'
            '    final bool negative = icon == Icons.remove_rounded;\n'
            '\n'
            '    return _Pressable(\n'
            '      onTap: onTap,\n'
            '      semanticLabel: semanticLabel ?? label,\n'
            '      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.actionRadius),\n'
            '      child: SizedBox(\n'
            '        width: double.infinity,\n'
            '        height: UIConstants.standardButtonHeight,\n'
            '        child: DecoratedBox(\n'
            '          decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '            gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '              begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '              end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '              colors: <Color>[color, companion],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.actionRadius),\n'
            '            border: Border.all(\n'
            '              color: dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(34) : color.withAlpha(95),\n'
            '              width: .8,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            boxShadow: AppStyles.glow(context, color, strong: true),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Padding(\n'
            '            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),\n'
            '            child: Row(\n'
            '              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.max,\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _TransactionPolarityGlyph(\n'
            '                  negative: negative,\n'
            '                  color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '                Flexible(\n'
            '                  child: FittedBox(\n'
            '                    fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'
            '                    child: Text(\n'
            '                      label,\n'
            '                      maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                      style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                        color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                        fontSize: 16.5,\n'
            '                        height: 1,\n'
            '                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,\n'
            '                        letterSpacing: -.2,\n'
            '                        shadows: <Shadow>[\n'
            '                          Shadow(color: Colors.black26, blurRadius: 8),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _TransactionPolarityGlyph extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _TransactionPolarityGlyph({\n'
            '    required this.negative,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final bool negative;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    const double lineLength = 20;\n'
            '    const double stroke = 2.6;\n'
            '    final BorderRadius round = BorderRadius.circular(99);\n'
            '\n'
            '    return SizedBox.square(\n'
            '      dimension: 26,\n'
            '      child: Stack(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.center,\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          Container(\n'
            '            width: lineLength,\n'
            '            height: stroke,\n'
            '            decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              borderRadius: round,\n'
            '              boxShadow: const <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '                BoxShadow(color: Colors.black26, blurRadius: 6),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          if (!negative)\n'
            '            Container(\n'
            '              width: stroke,\n'
            '              height: lineLength,\n'
            '              decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                color: color,\n'
            '                borderRadius: round,\n'
            '                boxShadow: const <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '                  BoxShadow(color: Colors.black26, blurRadius: 6),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class MilkDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const MilkDetailScreen({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.customerName,\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final String customerName;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<MilkDetailScreen> createState() => _MilkDetailScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MilkDetailScreenState extends State<MilkDetailScreen> {\n'
            '  int _month = DateTime.now().month;\n'
            '  int _year = DateTime.now().year;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addEntry(Map<String, dynamic> profile) async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController morning = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final TextEditingController evening = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final String? flow = await _openSheet<String>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      Builder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext) => _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'Daily Milk Entry\',\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: TextField(\n'
            '                    controller: morning,\n'
            '                    keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(\n'
            '                      decimal: true,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '                      FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: \'Morning KG\'),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: TextField(\n'
            '                    controller: evening,\n'
            '                    keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(\n'
            '                      decimal: true,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '                      FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: \'Evening KG\'),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Given\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleGreen,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Save milk as given\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'given\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Taken\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.remove_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleRed,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Save milk as taken\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'taken\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (flow == null || !mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      morning.dispose();\n'
            '      evening.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final double morningKg = double.tryParse(morning.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    final double eveningKg = double.tryParse(evening.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    morning.dispose();\n'
            '    evening.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null ||\n'
            '        morningKg < 0 ||\n'
            '        eveningKg < 0 ||\n'
            '        morningKg + eveningKg <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a valid date and positive quantity.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final bool duplicate = _rows(profile[\'records\']).any(\n'
            '      (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '          \'${row[\'date\']}\' == entryDate &&\n'
            '          LedgerMath.milkFlow(row, profile) == flow,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (duplicate) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'${flow == \'taken\' ? \'Taken\' : \'Given\'} entry already exists for this date.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'mlk\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'milkDB/${widget.customerName}/records/$id\',\n'
            '        <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '          \'id\': id,\n'
            '          \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '          \'morning\': morningKg,\n'
            '          \'evening\': eveningKg,\n'
            '          \'flow\': flow,\n'
            '          \'type\': flow,\n'
            '        },\n'
            '        reason: \'milk-entry-save\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      flow == \'taken\' ? \'Taken milk saved!\' : \'Given milk saved!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final DateTime parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate)!;\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _month = parsed.month;\n'
            '        _year = parsed.year;\n'
            '      });\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteEntry(String id) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete entry?\',\n'
            '      \'This milk entry will be deleted permanently.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'milkDB/${widget.customerName}/records/$id\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'milk-entry-delete\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      \'Entry deleted!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteProfile() async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete ${widget.customerName}?\',\n'
            '      \'The customer and every milk record will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'milkDB/${widget.customerName}\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'milk-profile-delete\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '        animation: widget.sync,\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic> database =\n'
            '              _map(widget.sync.state[\'milkDB\']);\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic>? profile =\n'
            '              database[widget.customerName] is Map\n'
            '                  ? _map(database[widget.customerName])\n'
            '                  : null;\n'
            '          if (profile == null) {\n'
            '            return const Scaffold(\n'
            '              body: Center(\n'
            '                child: _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.water_drop_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'Customer no longer exists\',\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allRecords =\n'
            '              _rows(profile[\'records\']);\n'
            '          final List<DateTime> availablePeriods = LedgerMath.recordPeriods(\n'
            '            allRecords,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final DateTime? selectedPeriod = LedgerMath.resolveRecordPeriod(\n'
            '            availablePeriods,\n'
            '            month: _month,\n'
            '            year: _year,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final int selectedMonth = selectedPeriod?.month ?? _month;\n'
            '          final int selectedYear = selectedPeriod?.year ?? _year;\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = allRecords\n'
            '              .where(\n'
            '                (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                    LedgerMath.inMonth(row, selectedMonth, selectedYear),\n'
            '              )\n'
            '              .toList()\n'
            '            ..sort(\n'
            '              (Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>\n'
            '                  \'${b[\'date\']}\'.compareTo(\'${a[\'date\']}\'),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          final MilkTotals totals = LedgerMath.milkTotals(\n'
            '            profile,\n'
            '            month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '            year: selectedYear,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final Color color = _tone(totals.netAmount);\n'
            '          return Scaffold(\n'
            '            body: Column(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '                  leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '                  title: widget.customerName,\n'
            '                  color: color,\n'
            '                  actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete customer and milk records\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_deleteProfile()),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: ListView(\n'
            '                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                    padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      _MonthYearPicker(\n'
            '                        month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '                        year: selectedYear,\n'
            '                        availablePeriods: availablePeriods,\n'
            '                        onChanged: (int month, int year) => setState(() {\n'
            '                          _month = month;\n'
            '                          _year = year;\n'
            '                        }),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                      _MilkDetailHero(\n'
            '                        amount: _signedMoney(totals.netAmount),\n'
            '                        totalKg: \'${totals.netKg.abs().toStringAsFixed(2)} KG\',\n'
            '                        color: color,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '                      _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                        \'Daily Entries\',\n'
            '                        color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                        actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          _SoftShareButton(\n'
            '                            label: \'Share\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                            semanticLabel: \'Share this section as PDF\',\n'
            '                            compact: false,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                              _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '                                \'${widget.customerName} Milk Bill\',\n'
            '                                <String>[\n'
            '                                  \'Date\',\n'
            '                                  \'Flow\',\n'
            '                                  \'Morning\',\n'
            '                                  \'Evening\',\n'
            '                                  \'Total\',\n'
            '                                ],\n'
            '                                records.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) {\n'
            '                                  final double quantity =\n'
            '                                      LedgerMath.milkQuantity(\n'
            '                                    row,\n'
            '                                  );\n'
            '                                  final String flow = LedgerMath.milkFlow(\n'
            '                                    row,\n'
            '                                    profile,\n'
            '                                  );\n'
            '                                  return <String>[\n'
            '                                    _displayDate(row[\'date\']),\n'
            '                                    flow,\n'
            '                                    \'${LedgerMath.number(row[\'morning\']).toStringAsFixed(2)} KG\',\n'
            '                                    \'${LedgerMath.number(row[\'evening\']).toStringAsFixed(2)} KG\',\n'
            '                                    \'${quantity.toStringAsFixed(2)} KG\',\n'
            '                                  ];\n'
            '                                }).toList(),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                          _MiniAction(\n'
            '                            label: \'Add\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: color,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(_addEntry(profile)),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      if (records.isEmpty)\n'
            '                        const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                          Icons.water_drop_outlined,\n'
            '                          \'No milk entries yet\',\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      else\n'
            '                        _MilkRecordsTable(\n'
            '                          records: records,\n'
            '                          profile: profile,\n'
            '                          onDelete: (String id) => unawaited(_deleteEntry(id)),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'

            '\n'
            'class _SoftShareButton extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _SoftShareButton({\n'
            '    required this.onTap,\n'
            '    this.label = \'Share\',\n'
            '    this.icon = Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '    this.color = appleBlue,\n'
            '    this.semanticLabel,\n'
            '    this.compact = false,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '  final String? semanticLabel;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final double viewportWidth = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width;\n'
            '    final bool micro = compact && viewportWidth < 350;\n'
            '    final double height = micro ? 46 : (compact ? 48 : 52);\n'
            '    final double width = micro ? 96 : (compact ? 108 : 118);\n'
            '    final double radius = compact ? 17 : 19;\n'
            '\n'
            '    final Color fill = dark\n'
            '        ? Color.alphaBlend(color.withAlpha(24), const Color(0xFF1B2230))\n'
            '        : Color.alphaBlend(color.withAlpha(13), Colors.white);\n'
            '    final Color border = color.withAlpha(dark ? 92 : 62);\n'
            '\n'
            '    return _Pressable(\n'
            '      onTap: onTap,\n'
            '      semanticLabel: semanticLabel ?? label,\n'
            '      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),\n'
            '      child: Container(\n'
            '        width: width,\n'
            '        height: height,\n'
            '        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: micro ? 10 : 13),\n'
            '        decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '          color: fill,\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),\n'
            '          border: Border.all(color: border, width: 1),\n'
            '          boxShadow: AppStyles.jewelDepth(context, color),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        child: Row(\n'
            '          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            Icon(\n'
            '              icon,\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              size: micro ? 19 : 21.5,\n'
            '              shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            SizedBox(width: micro ? 5 : 7),\n'
            '            Flexible(\n'
            '              child: FittedBox(\n'
            '                fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'
            '                child: Text(\n'
            '                  label,\n'
            '                  maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                  style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                    color: color,\n'
            '                    fontSize: compact ? 15.5 : 16.5,\n'
            '                    height: 1,\n'
            '                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,\n'
            '                    letterSpacing: -.2,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MilkRecordsTable extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MilkRecordsTable({\n'
            '    required this.records,\n'
            '    required this.profile,\n'
            '    required this.onDelete,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records;\n'
            '  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<String> onDelete;\n'
            '\n'
            '  String _quantityCell(dynamic value) {\n'
            '    final double number = LedgerMath.number(value);\n'
            '    if (number == 0) return \'-\';\n'
            '    return NumberFormat(\'0.##\').format(number);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        color: dark ? const Color(0xFF12161D) : Colors.white,\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.cardRadius),\n'
            '        border: Border.all(\n'
            '          color: dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(18) : appleBlue.withAlpha(16),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        boxShadow: dark\n'
            '            ? const <BoxShadow>[]\n'
            '            : <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '                BoxShadow(\n'
            '                  color: const Color(0xFF183960).withAlpha(16),\n'
            '                  blurRadius: 30,\n'
            '                  offset: const Offset(0, 13),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: LayoutBuilder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, BoxConstraints constraints) {\n'
            '          final bool compact = constraints.maxWidth < 350;\n'
            '          return Column(\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              Container(\n'
            '                height: 48,\n'
            '                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: compact ? 8 : 12),\n'
            '                color:\n'
            '                    dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(7) : const Color(0xFFF9FBFE),\n'
            '                child: Row(\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      flex: 22,\n'
            '                      child: _MilkTableHeader(\n'
            '                        \'DATE\',\n'
            '                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '                        compact: compact,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      flex: 20,\n'
            '                      child: _MilkTableHeader(\'MORNING\', compact: compact),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      flex: 20,\n'
            '                      child: _MilkTableHeader(\'EVENING\', compact: compact),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      flex: 21,\n'
            '                      child: _MilkTableHeader(\'TOTAL\', compact: compact),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(width: UIConstants.minTapTarget),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              for (int i = 0; i < records.length; i++)\n'
            '                _MilkTableRow(\n'
            '                  row: records[i],\n'
            '                  profile: profile,\n'
            '                  compact: compact,\n'
            '                  showDivider: i != records.length - 1,\n'
            '                  quantityCell: _quantityCell,\n'
            '                  onDelete: onDelete,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MilkTableHeader extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MilkTableHeader(\n'
            '    this.label, {\n'
            '    required this.compact,\n'
            '    this.alignment = Alignment.center,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '  final Alignment alignment;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Align(\n'
            '        alignment: alignment,\n'
            '        child: Text(\n'
            '          label,\n'
            '          maxLines: 1,\n'
            '          style: TextStyle(\n'
            '            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '            fontSize: compact ? 9.2 : 10.5,\n'
            '            height: 1,\n'
            '            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '            letterSpacing: compact ? .15 : .45,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MilkTableRow extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MilkTableRow({\n'
            '    required this.row,\n'
            '    required this.profile,\n'
            '    required this.compact,\n'
            '    required this.showDivider,\n'
            '    required this.quantityCell,\n'
            '    required this.onDelete,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Map<String, dynamic> row;\n'
            '  final Map<String, dynamic> profile;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '  final bool showDivider;\n'
            '  final String Function(dynamic value) quantityCell;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<String> onDelete;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final String flow = LedgerMath.milkFlow(row, profile);\n'
            '    final double quantity = LedgerMath.milkQuantity(row);\n'
            '    final Color rowColor = flow == \'taken\' ? semanticRed : appleGreen;\n'
            '    final DateTime? parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(\'${row[\'date\']}\');\n'
            '    final String day = parsed == null\n'
            '        ? _displayDate(row[\'date\'])\n'
            '        : DateFormat(\'dd\').format(parsed);\n'
            '    final String month = parsed == null ? \'\' : DateFormat(\'MMM\').format(parsed);\n'
            '    final String total =\n'
            '        \'${flow == \'taken\' ? \'-\' : \'+\'}${quantity.toStringAsFixed(2)}\';\n'
            '\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 72),\n'
            '      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: compact ? 8 : 12, vertical: 10),\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        border: showDivider\n'
            '            ? Border(\n'
            '                bottom: BorderSide(\n'
            '                  color: dark\n'
            '                      ? Colors.white.withAlpha(15)\n'
            '                      : const Color(0xFF183960).withAlpha(15),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              )\n'
            '            : null,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: Row(\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            flex: 22,\n'
            '            child: Align(\n'
            '              alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '              child: Container(\n'
            '                constraints: BoxConstraints(minWidth: compact ? 48 : 54),\n'
            '                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 7),\n'
            '                decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                  color: rowColor.withAlpha(dark ? 29 : 18),\n'
            '                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                child: Column(\n'
            '                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    Text(\n'
            '                      day,\n'
            '                      maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                      style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                        color: rowColor,\n'
            '                        fontSize: compact ? 15 : 17,\n'
            '                        height: 1,\n'
            '                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    if (month.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        month,\n'
            '                        style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                          color: rowColor,\n'
            '                          fontSize: compact ? 10.5 : 11.5,\n'
            '                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            flex: 20,\n'
            '            child: _MilkValueCell(\n'
            '              quantityCell(row[\'morning\']),\n'
            '              color: rowColor,\n'
            '              compact: compact,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            flex: 20,\n'
            '            child: _MilkValueCell(\n'
            '              quantityCell(row[\'evening\']),\n'
            '              color: rowColor,\n'
            '              compact: compact,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            flex: 21,\n'
            '            child: _MilkValueCell(\n'
            '              total,\n'
            '              color: rowColor,\n'
            '              compact: compact,\n'
            '              strong: true,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          SizedBox(\n'
            '            width: UIConstants.minTapTarget,\n'
            '            child: Align(\n'
            '              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,\n'
            '              child: _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                onTap: () => onDelete(\'${row[\'id\']}\'),\n'
            '                semanticLabel: \'Delete ${_displayDate(row[\'date\'])} milk entry\',\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MilkValueCell extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MilkValueCell(\n'
            '    this.value, {\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.compact,\n'
            '    this.strong = false,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String value;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '  final bool strong;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Center(\n'
            '        child: FittedBox(\n'
            '          fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'
            '          child: Text(\n'
            '            value,\n'
            '            maxLines: 1,\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              fontSize: compact ? 13 : (strong ? 16 : 15),\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              fontFeatures: AppStyles.tabularFigures,\n'
            '              letterSpacing: strong ? -.25 : 0,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MiniAction extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _MiniAction({\n'
            '    required this.label,\n'
            '    required this.icon,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    required this.onTap,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _Pressable(\n'
            '        onTap: onTap,\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.compactRadius),\n'
            '        child: Container(\n'
            '          constraints:\n'
            '              const BoxConstraints(minHeight: UIConstants.minTapTarget),\n'
            '          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),\n'
            '          decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '            gradient: LinearGradient(\n'
            '              begin: Alignment.topLeft,\n'
            '              end: Alignment.bottomRight,\n'
            '              colors: <Color>[color.withAlpha(35), color.withAlpha(17)],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.compactRadius),\n'
            '            border: Border.fromBorderSide(\n'
            '              AppStyles.hairline(context, accent: color, active: true),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            boxShadow: AppStyles.glow(context, color),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Row(\n'
            '            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'

            '            children: <Widget>[\n'

            '                  size: 17, color: color, shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color)),\n'

            '              Text(\n'
            '                label,\n'
            '                style: TextStyle(\n'

            '                  fontSize: 12,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                  shadows: AppStyles.inkGlow(color),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerTableRowData {\n'
            '  const _LedgerTableRowData({\n'
            '    required this.cells,\n'
            '    required this.onDelete,\n'
            '    required this.semanticLabel,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final List<Widget> cells;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onDelete;\n'
            '  final String semanticLabel;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerTableCard extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerTableCard({\n'
            '    required this.headers,\n'
            '    required this.flexes,\n'
            '    required this.rows,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final List<String> headers;\n'
            '  final List<int> flexes;\n'
            '  final List<_LedgerTableRowData> rows;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    assert(headers.length == flexes.length);\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final Color divider = dark\n'
            '        ? Colors.white.withAlpha(15)\n'
            '        : const Color(0xFF183960).withAlpha(15);\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        color: dark ? const Color(0xFF12161D) : Colors.white,\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(UIConstants.cardRadius),\n'
            '        border: Border.all(\n'
            '          color: dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(18) : appleBlue.withAlpha(16),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        boxShadow: dark\n'
            '            ? const <BoxShadow>[]\n'
            '            : <BoxShadow>[\n'
            '                BoxShadow(\n'
            '                  color: const Color(0xFF183960).withAlpha(16),\n'
            '                  blurRadius: 30,\n'
            '                  offset: const Offset(0, 13),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: LayoutBuilder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, BoxConstraints constraints) {\n'
            '          final bool compact = constraints.maxWidth < 350;\n'
            '          return Column(\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              Container(\n'
            '                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 48),\n'
            '                padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: compact ? 10 : 14),\n'
            '                color:\n'
            '                    dark ? Colors.white.withAlpha(7) : const Color(0xFFF9FBFE),\n'
            '                child: Row(\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++)\n'
            '                      Expanded(\n'
            '                        flex: flexes[i],\n'
            '                        child: Align(\n'
            '                          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '                          child: Text(\n'
            '                            headers[i],\n'
            '                            maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                              fontSize: compact ? 9.6 : 10.7,\n'
            '                              height: 1,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                              letterSpacing: compact ? .15 : .55,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(width: UIConstants.minTapTarget),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              for (int rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < rows.length; rowIndex++)\n'
            '                Container(\n'
            '                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 72),\n'
            '                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(\n'
            '                    horizontal: compact ? 10 : 14,\n'
            '                    vertical: 10,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                    border: rowIndex == rows.length - 1\n'
            '                        ? null\n'
            '                        : Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: divider)),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  child: Row(\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++)\n'
            '                        Expanded(\n'
            '                          flex: flexes[i],\n'
            '                          child: rows[rowIndex].cells[i],\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      SizedBox(\n'
            '                        width: UIConstants.minTapTarget,\n'
            '                        child: Align(\n'
            '                          alignment: Alignment.centerRight,\n'
            '                          child: _LedgerDeleteAction(\n'
            '                            onTap: rows[rowIndex].onDelete,\n'
            '                            semanticLabel: rows[rowIndex].semanticLabel,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerDeleteAction extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerDeleteAction({required this.onTap, required this.semanticLabel});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '  final String semanticLabel;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) =>\n'
            '      _DeleteActionButton(onTap: onTap, semanticLabel: semanticLabel);\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerDateCell extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerDateCell({\n'
            '    required this.date,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '    this.stacked = false,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final dynamic date;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final bool stacked;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final DateTime? parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(\'$date\');\n'
            '    if (parsed == null) {\n'
            '      return Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: Text(\n'
            '          _displayDate(date),\n'
            '          maxLines: stacked ? 2 : 1,\n'
            '          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '          style: TextStyle(\n'
            '            color: color,\n'
            '            fontSize: 14,\n'
            '            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (stacked) {\n'
            '      return Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: Column(\n'
            '          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              DateFormat(\'dd\').format(parsed),\n'
            '              style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                color: color,\n'
            '                fontSize: 15,\n'
            '                height: 1,\n'
            '                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              DateFormat(\'MMM\').format(parsed),\n'
            '              style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                color: color,\n'
            '                fontSize: 12.5,\n'
            '                height: 1,\n'
            '                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return Align(\n'
            '      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '      child: FittedBox(\n'
            '        fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: Text(\n'
            '          DateFormat(\'dd MMM\').format(parsed),\n'
            '          maxLines: 1,\n'
            '          style: TextStyle(\n'
            '            color: color,\n'
            '            fontSize: 14.5,\n'
            '            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '            letterSpacing: -.15,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerAmountCell extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerAmountCell({required this.value, required this.color});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String value;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: FittedBox(\n'
            '          fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,\n'

            '          child: Text(\n'
            '            value,\n'
            '            maxLines: 1,\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              fontSize: 15.5,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              fontFeatures: AppStyles.tabularFigures,\n'
            '              letterSpacing: -.25,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerBadgeCell extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerBadgeCell({required this.label, required this.color});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'

            '          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 6),\n'

            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),\n'
            '            border: Border.all(color: color.withAlpha(52)),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Text(\n'
            '            label,\n'
            '            maxLines: 1,\n'
            '            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '              color: color,\n'
            '              fontSize: 9.8,\n'
            '              height: 1,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              letterSpacing: .2,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _LedgerDetailCell extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _LedgerDetailCell({\n'
            '    required this.title,\n'
            '    required this.badge,\n'
            '    required this.color,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String title;\n'
            '  final String badge;\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: Column(\n'
            '          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
