            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              title,\n'
            '              maxLines: 1,\n'
            '              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '              style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                color: color,\n'
            '                fontSize: 13.5,\n'
            '                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '            _LedgerBadgeCell(label: badge, color: color),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class SalaryScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const SalaryScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<SalaryScreen> createState() => _SalaryScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SalaryScreenState extends State<SalaryScreen> {\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addPerson() async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController name = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final TextEditingController company = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final String? type = await _openSheet<String>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      Builder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext) => _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'New Employee\',\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: name,\n'
            '              autofocus: true,\n'
            '              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Employee Name\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_rounded),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: company,\n'
            '              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Company / Details\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.business_rounded),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Receives\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: salaryGreen,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Create employee who receives salary\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'lene_wala\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Pays\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.remove_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleRed,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Create employee whose salary I pay\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'dene_wala\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (type == null || !mounted) {\n'
            '      name.dispose();\n'
            '      company.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String personName = _cleanKey(name.text);\n'
            '    final String companyName =\n'
            '        company.text.trim().isEmpty ? \'—\' : company.text.trim();\n'
            '    name.dispose();\n'
            '    company.dispose();\n'
            '    if (personName.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a name.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(widget.sync.state[\'salaryDB\']);\n'
            '    if (database.keys.any(\n'
            '      (String key) => key.toLowerCase() == personName.toLowerCase(),\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Person already exists.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'salaryDB/$personName\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'company\': companyName,\n'
            '            \'type\': type,\n'
            '            \'records\': <dynamic>[],\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'salary-profile-create\'),\n'
            '      type == \'lene_wala\'\n'
            '          ? \'Receiving salary profile added!\'\n'
            '          : \'Paying salary profile added!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(widget.sync.state[\'salaryDB\']);\n'
            '    final LedgerProjection projection = widget.sync.currentProjection;\n'
            '    final Color moduleColor = _tone(projection.salaryMonthNet);\n'
            '    final List<String> names = database.keys\n'
            '        .where(\n'
            '          (String name) => name.toLowerCase().contains(_query.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        .toList()\n'
            '      ..sort(\n'
            '        (String a, String b) => a.toLowerCase().compareTo(b.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Salary Record\',\n'
            '          color: moduleColor,\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'New\',\n'
            '              color: moduleColor,\n'
            '              compact: true,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_addPerson()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: ListView(\n'
            '            key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'salary-scroll\'),\n'
            '            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              _SearchBox(\n'
            '                hint: \'Search name…\',\n'
            '                color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                onChanged: (String value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '              if (names.isEmpty)\n'
            '                const _EmptyState(Icons.groups_rounded, \'No employees found\')\n'
            '              else\n'
            '                ...names.map((String name) {\n'
            '                  final Map<String, dynamic> profile = _map(database[name]);\n'
            '                  final double net = projection.salaryNetByProfile[name]!;\n'
            '                  final Color color = _tone(net);\n'
            '                  return _ListCard(\n'
            '                    title: name,\n'
            '                    subtitle:\n'
            '                        \'${profile[\'company\'] ?? \'—\'} • ${net >= 0 ? \'To Receive\' : \'To Pay\'}\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.currency_rupee_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: color,\n'
            '                    avatarText: name.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '                        ? \'S\'\n'
            '                        : name.trim()[0].toUpperCase(),\n'
            '                    trailing: _signedMoney(net),\n'
            '                    destinationBuilder: (_) =>\n'
            '                        SalaryDetailScreen(sync: widget.sync, personName: name),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class SalaryDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const SalaryDetailScreen({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.personName,\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final String personName;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<SalaryDetailScreen> createState() => _SalaryDetailScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SalaryDetailScreenState extends State<SalaryDetailScreen> {\n'
            '  int _month = DateTime.now().month;\n'
            '  int _year = DateTime.now().year;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addEntry(Map<String, dynamic> profile, Color tone) async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController amount = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      _SheetFrame(\n'
            '        title: \'Add Salary Entry\',\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: amount,\n'
            '            autofocus: true,\n'
            '            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),\n'
            '            inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '              FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Amount\',\n'
            '              prefixText: \'₹ \',\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '          _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '            label: \'Save Salary\',\n'
            '            color: tone,\n'
            '            onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save != true || !mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      amount.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final double entryAmount = double.tryParse(amount.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    amount.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null || entryAmount <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a valid date and positive amount.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (_rows(profile[\'records\'])\n'
            '        .any((Map<String, dynamic> row) => \'${row[\'date\']}\' == entryDate)) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Salary for this date is already added.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'sal\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'salaryDB/${widget.personName}/records/$id\',\n'
            '        <String, dynamic>{\'id\': id, \'date\': entryDate, \'amount\': entryAmount},\n'
            '        reason: \'salary-entry-save\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      \'Salary saved safely!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final DateTime parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate)!;\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _month = parsed.month;\n'
            '        _year = parsed.year;\n'
            '      });\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteEntry(String id) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete salary?\',\n'
            '      \'This salary entry will be deleted permanently.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'salaryDB/${widget.personName}/records/$id\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'salary-entry-delete\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      \'Salary entry deleted!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteProfile() async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete ${widget.personName}?\',\n'
            '      \'The salary profile and all entries will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'salaryDB/${widget.personName}\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'salary-profile-delete\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '        animation: widget.sync,\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic> database =\n'
            '              _map(widget.sync.state[\'salaryDB\']);\n'
            '          if (database[widget.personName] is! Map) {\n'
            '            return const Scaffold(\n'
            '              body: Center(\n'
            '                child: _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.groups_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'Profile no longer exists\',\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic> profile =\n'
            '              _map(database[widget.personName]);\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allRecords =\n'
            '              _rows(profile[\'records\']);\n'
            '          final List<DateTime> availablePeriods = LedgerMath.recordPeriods(\n'
            '            allRecords,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final DateTime? selectedPeriod = LedgerMath.resolveRecordPeriod(\n'
            '            availablePeriods,\n'
            '            month: _month,\n'
            '            year: _year,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final int selectedMonth = selectedPeriod?.month ?? _month;\n'
            '          final int selectedYear = selectedPeriod?.year ?? _year;\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = allRecords\n'
            '              .where(\n'
            '                (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                    LedgerMath.inMonth(row, selectedMonth, selectedYear),\n'
            '              )\n'
            '              .toList()\n'
            '            ..sort(\n'
            '              (Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>\n'
            '                  \'${b[\'date\']}\'.compareTo(\'${a[\'date\']}\'),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          final double total = records.fold<double>(\n'
            '            0,\n'
            '            (double sum, Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                sum + LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final double signed = profile[\'type\'] == \'lene_wala\' ? total : -total;\n'
            '          final Color color = _tone(signed);\n'
            '          return Scaffold(\n'
            '            body: Column(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '                  leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '                  title: widget.personName,\n'
            '                  color: color,\n'
            '                  actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete salary profile\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_deleteProfile()),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: ListView(\n'
            '                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                    padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      _MonthYearPicker(\n'
            '                        month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '                        year: selectedYear,\n'
            '                        availablePeriods: availablePeriods,\n'
            '                        onChanged: (int month, int year) => setState(() {\n'
            '                          _month = month;\n'
            '                          _year = year;\n'
            '                        }),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                      _AmountHero(\n'
            '                        label: \'Total Salary (This Month)\',\n'
            '                        value: _signedMoney(signed),\n'
            '                        color: color,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '                      _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                        \'Daily Entries\',\n'
            '                        color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                        actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          _SoftShareButton(\n'
            '                            label: \'Share\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                            semanticLabel: \'Share this section as PDF\',\n'
            '                            compact: false,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                              _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '                                \'${widget.personName} Salary\',\n'
            '                                <String>[\'Date\', \'Amount\'],\n'
            '                                records\n'
            '                                    .map(\n'
            '                                      (Map<String, dynamic> row) => <String>[\n'
            '                                        _displayDate(row[\'date\']),\n'
            '                                        _plainMoney(\n'
            '                                          (profile[\'type\'] == \'lene_wala\'\n'
            '                                                  ? 1\n'
            '                                                  : -1) *\n'
            '                                              LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']),\n'
            '                                        ),\n'
            '                                      ],\n'
            '                                    )\n'
            '                                    .toList(),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                          _MiniAction(\n'
            '                            label: \'Add\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: color,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(_addEntry(profile, color)),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      if (records.isEmpty)\n'
            '                        const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                          Icons.currency_rupee_rounded,\n'
            '                          \'No salary entries yet\',\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      else\n'
            '                        _LedgerTableCard(\n'
            '                          headers: const <String>[\'DATE\', \'AMOUNT\'],\n'
            '                          flexes: const <int>[42, 42],\n'
            '                          rows: records.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) {\n'
            '                            final double rowSigned =\n'
            '                                (profile[\'type\'] == \'lene_wala\' ? 1 : -1) *\n'
            '                                    LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']);\n'
            '                            final Color rowColor = _tone(rowSigned);\n'
            '                            return _LedgerTableRowData(\n'
            '                              cells: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                _LedgerDateCell(\n'
            '                                    date: row[\'date\'], color: rowColor),\n'
            '                                _LedgerAmountCell(\n'
            '                                  value: _signedMoney(rowSigned),\n'
            '                                  color: rowColor,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              ],\n'
            '                              onDelete: () =>\n'
            '                                  unawaited(_deleteEntry(\'${row[\'id\']}\')),\n'
            '                              semanticLabel:\n'
            '                                  \'Delete ${_displayDate(row[\'date\'])} salary entry\',\n'
            '                            );\n'
            '                          }).toList(),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class CreditScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const CreditScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<CreditScreen> createState() => _CreditScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _CreditScreenState extends State<CreditScreen> {\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addEntry({String? fixedName}) async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController name = TextEditingController(\n'
            '      text: fixedName ?? \'\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final TextEditingController amount = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    String type = \'credit\';\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      StatefulBuilder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext, StateSetter setSheetState) =>\n'
            '            _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'Credit / Loan Entry\',\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: name,\n'
            '              readOnly: fixedName != null,\n'
            '              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Person name\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_rounded),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: amount,\n'
            '              autofocus: fixedName != null,\n'
            '              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(\n'
            '                decimal: true,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '                FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Amount\',\n'
            '                prefixText: \'₹ \',\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Given\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleGreen,\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      type = \'credit\';\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, true);\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Taken\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.remove_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleRed,\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      type = \'debit\';\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, true);\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save != true || !mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      name.dispose();\n'
            '      amount.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final String person = _cleanKey(name.text);\n'
            '    final double entryAmount = double.tryParse(amount.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    name.dispose();\n'
            '    amount.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null ||\n'
            '        person.isEmpty ||\n'
            '        entryAmount <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Fill the complete form with a valid amount.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'udh\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'udharDB/$id\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'id\': id,\n'
            '            \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '            \'name\': person,\n'
            '            \'amount\': entryAmount,\n'
            '            \'type\': type,\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'credit-entry-save\'),\n'
            '      \'Credit entry saved safely!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final LedgerProjection projection = widget.sync.currentProjection;\n'
            '    final double net = projection.creditLifetimeNet;\n'
            '    final Color moduleColor = _tone(net);\n'
            '    final Color balanceColor = moduleColor;\n'
            '    final List<CreditPartySummary> groups = projection.creditParties\n'
            '        .where(\n'
            '          (CreditPartySummary group) =>\n'
            '              group.name.toLowerCase().contains(_query.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        .toList();\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Credit Book\',\n'
            '          color: moduleColor,\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'Entry\',\n'
            '              color: moduleColor,\n'
            '              compact: true,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_addEntry()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: ListView(\n'
            '            key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'credit-scroll\'),\n'
            '            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              _AmountHero(\n'
            '                label: net > 0\n'
            '                    ? \'Net Balance / Profit\'\n'
            '                    : net < 0\n'
            '                        ? \'Net Balance / Loss\'\n'
            '                        : \'Net Balance\',\n'
            '                value: _signedMoney(net),\n'
            '                color: balanceColor,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '              _SearchBox(\n'
            '                hint: \'Search name…\',\n'
            '                onChanged: (String value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '              if (groups.isEmpty)\n'
            '                const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'No credit records found\',\n'
            '                )\n'
            '              else\n'
            '                ...groups.map((CreditPartySummary group) {\n'
            '                  final Color color = _tone(group.net);\n'
            '                  return _ListCard(\n'
            '                    title: group.name,\n'
            '                    subtitle:\n'
            '                        \'${group.net > 0 ? \'To Receive\' : group.net < 0 ? \'To Pay\' : \'Settled\'} • Last ${_displayDate(group.lastDate)}\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.person_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: color,\n'
            '                    avatarText: group.name.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '                        ? \'C\'\n'
            '                        : group.name.trim()[0].toUpperCase(),\n'
            '                    trailing: _signedMoney(group.net),\n'
            '                    destinationBuilder: (_) => CreditDetailScreen(\n'
            '                      sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '                      personName: group.name,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class CreditDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const CreditDetailScreen({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.personName,\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final String personName;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<CreditDetailScreen> createState() => _CreditDetailScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _CreditDetailScreenState extends State<CreditDetailScreen> {\n'
            '  int _month = DateTime.now().month;\n'
            '  int _year = DateTime.now().year;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addEntry() async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController amount = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final String? type = await _openSheet<String>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      Builder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext) => _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'${widget.personName} Credit Entry\',\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: amount,\n'
            '              autofocus: true,\n'
            '              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(\n'
            '                decimal: true,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '                FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Amount\',\n'
            '                prefixText: \'₹ \',\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Given\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleGreen,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Save credit as given\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'credit\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: _TransactionPairButton(\n'
            '                    label: \'Taken\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.remove_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleRed,\n'
            '                    semanticLabel: \'Save credit as taken\',\n'
            '                    onTap: () {\n'
            '                      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();\n'
            '                      Navigator.pop(sheetContext, \'debit\');\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (type == null || !mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      amount.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final double entryAmount = double.tryParse(amount.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    amount.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null || entryAmount <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a valid date and positive amount.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'udh\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'udharDB/$id\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'id\': id,\n'
            '            \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '            \'name\': widget.personName,\n'
            '            \'amount\': entryAmount,\n'
            '            \'type\': type,\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'credit-entry-save\'),\n'
            '      type == \'credit\' ? \'Given entry saved!\' : \'Taken entry saved!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final DateTime parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate)!;\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _month = parsed.month;\n'
            '        _year = parsed.year;\n'
            '      });\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteEntry(String id) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete credit entry?\',\n'
            '      \'This record will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () =>\n'
            '          widget.sync.write(\'udharDB/$id\', null, reason: \'credit-entry-delete\'),\n'
            '      \'Entry deleted!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteProfile(List<Map<String, dynamic>> records) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete ${widget.personName}?\',\n'
            '      \'Every credit entry for this person will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> deletes = <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '      for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in records)\n'
            '        \'udharDB/${row[\'id\']}\': null,\n'
            '    };\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      if (deletes.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '        await widget.sync.writeBatch(deletes, reason: \'credit-profile-delete\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '        animation: widget.sync,\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allRecords =\n'
            '              _rows(widget.sync.state[\'udharDB\'])\n'
            '                  .where(\n'
            '                    (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                        LedgerMath.cleanName(row[\'name\']) == widget.personName,\n'
            '                  )\n'
            '                  .toList();\n'
            '          final List<DateTime> availablePeriods = LedgerMath.recordPeriods(\n'
            '            allRecords,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final DateTime? selectedPeriod = LedgerMath.resolveRecordPeriod(\n'
            '            availablePeriods,\n'
            '            month: _month,\n'
            '            year: _year,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final int selectedMonth = selectedPeriod?.month ?? _month;\n'
            '          final int selectedYear = selectedPeriod?.year ?? _year;\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = allRecords\n'
            '              .where(\n'
            '                (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                    LedgerMath.inMonth(row, selectedMonth, selectedYear),\n'
            '              )\n'
            '              .toList()\n'
            '            ..sort(\n'
            '              (Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>\n'
            '                  \'${b[\'date\']}\'.compareTo(\'${a[\'date\']}\'),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          final double net = records.fold<double>(\n'
            '            0,\n'
            '            (double sum, Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                sum + LedgerMath.creditSigned(row),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final Color color = _tone(net);\n'
            '          return Scaffold(\n'
            '            body: Column(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '                  leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '                  title: widget.personName,\n'
            '                  color: color,\n'
            '                  actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete credit profile\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_deleteProfile(allRecords)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: ListView(\n'
            '                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                    padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      _MonthYearPicker(\n'
            '                        month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '                        year: selectedYear,\n'
            '                        availablePeriods: availablePeriods,\n'
            '                        onChanged: (int month, int year) => setState(() {\n'
            '                          _month = month;\n'
            '                          _year = year;\n'
            '                        }),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                      _AmountHero(\n'
            '                        label: net > 0\n'
            '                            ? \'To Receive\'\n'
            '                            : net < 0\n'
            '                                ? \'To Pay\'\n'
            '                                : \'Net Balance\',\n'
            '                        value: _signedMoney(net),\n'
            '                        color: color,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '                      _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                        \'Credit Entries\',\n'
            '                        color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                        actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          _SoftShareButton(\n'
            '                            label: \'Share\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                            semanticLabel: \'Share this section as PDF\',\n'
            '                            compact: false,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                              _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '                                \'${widget.personName} Credit Ledger\',\n'
            '                                <String>[\'Date\', \'Type\', \'Amount\'],\n'
            '                                records\n'
            '                                    .map(\n'
            '                                      (Map<String, dynamic> row) => <String>[\n'
            '                                        _displayDate(row[\'date\']),\n'
            '                                        LedgerMath.creditSigned(row) >= 0\n'
            '                                            ? \'Given\'\n'
            '                                            : \'Taken\',\n'
            '                                        _plainMoney(\n'
            '                                            LedgerMath.creditSigned(row)),\n'
            '                                      ],\n'
            '                                    )\n'
            '                                    .toList(),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                          _MiniAction(\n'
            '                            label: \'Add\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleGreen,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(_addEntry()),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      if (records.isEmpty)\n'
            '                        const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                          Icons.account_balance_wallet_outlined,\n'
            '                          \'No credit entries yet\',\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      else\n'
            '                        _LedgerTableCard(\n'
            '                          headers: const <String>[\'DATE\', \'DETAIL\', \'AMOUNT\'],\n'
            '                          flexes: const <int>[29, 28, 31],\n'
            '                          rows: records.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) {\n'
            '                            final double signed = LedgerMath.creditSigned(row);\n'
            '                            final Color rowColor = _tone(signed);\n'
            '                            return _LedgerTableRowData(\n'
            '                              cells: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                _LedgerDateCell(\n'
            '                                    date: row[\'date\'], color: rowColor),\n'
            '                                _LedgerBadgeCell(\n'
            '                                  label: signed >= 0 ? \'GIVEN\' : \'TAKEN\',\n'
            '                                  color: rowColor,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                                _LedgerAmountCell(\n'
            '                                  value: _signedMoney(signed),\n'
            '                                  color: rowColor,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              ],\n'
            '                              onDelete: () =>\n'
            '                                  unawaited(_deleteEntry(\'${row[\'id\']}\')),\n'
            '                              semanticLabel:\n'
            '                                  \'Delete ${_displayDate(row[\'date\'])} credit entry\',\n'
            '                            );\n'
            '                          }).toList(),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class ExpenseScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const ExpenseScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<ExpenseScreen> createState() => _ExpenseScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ExpenseScreenState extends State<ExpenseScreen> {\n'
            '  Future<void> _shareCurrentMonthExpenses() async {\n'
            '    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records =\n'
            '        _rows(widget.sync.state[\'expenseDB\']).where((Map<String, dynamic> row) {\n'
            '      return LedgerMath.inMonth(row, now.month, now.year);\n'
            '    }).toList()\n'
            '          ..sort(\n'
            '            (Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>\n'
            '                \'${b[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\'.compareTo(\'${a[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\'),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '    await _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '      \'Monthly Expenses - ${DateFormat(\'MMMM yyyy\').format(now)}\',\n'
            '      <String>[\'Date\', \'Category\', \'Amount\'],\n'
            '      records\n'
            '          .map(\n'
            '            (Map<String, dynamic> row) => <String>[\n'
            '              _displayDate(row[\'date\']),\n'
            '              _cleanKey(row[\'category\']).isEmpty\n'
            '                  ? \'Other\'\n'
            '                  : _cleanKey(row[\'category\']),\n'
            '              _plainMoney(-LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']).abs()),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          )\n'
            '          .toList(),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addExpense({String? fixedCategory}) async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController category = TextEditingController(\n'
            '      text: fixedCategory ?? \'\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final TextEditingController amount = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      _SheetFrame(\n'
            '        title: \'Add Expense\',\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: category,\n'
            '            readOnly: fixedCategory != null,\n'
            '            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Category\',\n'
            '              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.category_rounded),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: amount,\n'
            '            autofocus: fixedCategory != null,\n'
            '            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),\n'
            '            inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '              FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Amount\',\n'
            '              prefixText: \'₹ \',\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '          _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '            label: \'Save Expense\',\n'
            '            color: appleRed,\n'
            '            onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save != true || !mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      category.dispose();\n'
            '      amount.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final String entryCategory =\n'
            '        _cleanKey(category.text).isEmpty ? \'Other\' : _cleanKey(category.text);\n'
            '    final double entryAmount = double.tryParse(amount.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    category.dispose();\n'
            '    amount.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null || entryAmount <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a valid date and positive amount.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'exp\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'expenseDB/$id\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'id\': id,\n'
            '            \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '            \'category\': entryCategory,\n'
            '            \'amount\': entryAmount,\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'expense-entry-save\'),\n'
            '      \'Expense saved safely!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final LedgerProjection projection = widget.sync.currentProjection;\n'
            '    final List<ExpenseCategorySummary> groups = projection.expenseCategories;\n'
            '    final double total = projection.expenseMonthTotal;\n'
            '    final Color moduleColor = _expenseToneForTotal(total);\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Expenses\',\n'
            '          color: moduleColor,\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _CircleAction(\n'
            '              icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '              color: appleBlue,\n'
            '              semanticLabel: \'Share this month expenses\',\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_shareCurrentMonthExpenses()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'Add\',\n'
            '              color: semanticRed,\n'
            '              compact: true,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_addExpense()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: ListView(\n'
            '            key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'expense-scroll\'),\n'
            '            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              _AmountHero(\n'
            '                label: \'Month Expense\',\n'
            '                value: _money(total),\n'
            '                color: moduleColor,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '              const _SectionTitle(\'Categories\'),\n'
            '              if (groups.isEmpty)\n'
            '                const _EmptyState(premiumExpenseIcon, \'No expenses this month\')\n'
            '              else\n'
            '                ...groups.map(\n'
            '                  (ExpenseCategorySummary group) => _ListCard(\n'
            '                    title: group.category,\n'
            '                    subtitle: group.monthTotal > 0\n'
            '                        ? \'This month • Last ${_displayDate(group.lastDate)}\'\n'
            '                        : \'No expense this month • Last ${_displayDate(group.lastDate)}\',\n'
            '                    icon: premiumExpenseIcon,\n'
            '                    color: semanticRed,\n'
            '                    trailing: group.monthTotal > 0\n'
            '                        ? \'-${_money(group.monthTotal)}\'\n'
            '                        : \'—\',\n'
            '                    destinationBuilder: (_) => ExpenseDetailScreen(\n'
            '                      sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '                      category: group.category,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class ExpenseDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const ExpenseDetailScreen({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.category,\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final String category;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<ExpenseDetailScreen> createState() => _ExpenseDetailScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ExpenseDetailScreenState extends State<ExpenseDetailScreen> {\n'
            '  int _month = DateTime.now().month;\n'
            '  int _year = DateTime.now().year;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addExpense() async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController amount = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      _SheetFrame(\n'
            '        title: \'${widget.category} Expense\',\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: amount,\n'
            '            autofocus: true,\n'
            '            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),\n'
            '            inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '              FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Amount\',\n'
            '              prefixText: \'₹ \',\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '          _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '            label: \'Save Expense\',\n'
            '            color: appleRed,\n'
            '            onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save != true || !mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      amount.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final double entryAmount = double.tryParse(amount.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    amount.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null || entryAmount <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter a valid date and positive amount.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'exp\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'expenseDB/$id\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'id\': id,\n'
            '            \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '            \'category\': widget.category,\n'
            '            \'amount\': entryAmount,\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'expense-entry-save\'),\n'
            '      \'Expense saved safely!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final DateTime parsed = LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate)!;\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _month = parsed.month;\n'
            '        _year = parsed.year;\n'
            '      });\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteEntry(String id) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete expense?\',\n'
            '      \'This expense will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'expenseDB/$id\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'expense-entry-delete\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      \'Expense deleted!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteCategory(List<Map<String, dynamic>> allRecords) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete ${widget.category}?\',\n'
            '      \'Every expense in this category, including other months, will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> deletes = <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '      for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in allRecords)\n'
            '        \'expenseDB/${row[\'id\']}\': null,\n'
            '    };\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      if (deletes.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '        await widget.sync.writeBatch(\n'
            '          deletes,\n'
            '          reason: \'expense-category-delete\',\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '        animation: widget.sync,\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allRecords =\n'
            '              _rows(widget.sync.state[\'expenseDB\'])\n'
            '                  .where(\n'
            '                    (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                        _cleanKey(row[\'category\']).toLowerCase() ==\n'
            '                        widget.category.toLowerCase(),\n'
            '                  )\n'
            '                  .toList();\n'
            '          final List<DateTime> availablePeriods = LedgerMath.recordPeriods(\n'
            '            allRecords,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final DateTime? selectedPeriod = LedgerMath.resolveRecordPeriod(\n'
            '            availablePeriods,\n'
            '            month: _month,\n'
            '            year: _year,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final int selectedMonth = selectedPeriod?.month ?? _month;\n'
            '          final int selectedYear = selectedPeriod?.year ?? _year;\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = allRecords\n'
            '              .where(\n'
            '                (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                    LedgerMath.inMonth(row, selectedMonth, selectedYear),\n'
            '              )\n'
            '              .toList()\n'
            '            ..sort(\n'
            '              (Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>\n'
            '                  \'${b[\'date\']}\'.compareTo(\'${a[\'date\']}\'),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          final double total = records.fold<double>(\n'
            '            0,\n'
            '            (double sum, Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                sum + LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']).abs(),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          final Color detailColor = _expenseToneForTotal(total);\n'
            '          return Scaffold(\n'
            '            body: Column(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '                  leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '                  title: widget.category,\n'
            '                  color: detailColor,\n'
            '                  actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete expense category\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_deleteCategory(allRecords)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: ListView(\n'
            '                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                    padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      _MonthYearPicker(\n'
            '                        month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '                        year: selectedYear,\n'
            '                        availablePeriods: availablePeriods,\n'
            '                        onChanged: (int month, int year) => setState(() {\n'
            '                          _month = month;\n'
            '                          _year = year;\n'
            '                        }),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                      _AmountHero(\n'
            '                        label: \'Category Total\',\n'
            '                        value: \'-${_money(total)}\',\n'
            '                        color: detailColor,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '                      _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                        \'Expense Entries\',\n'
            '                        color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                        actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          _SoftShareButton(\n'
            '                            label: \'Share\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                            semanticLabel: \'Share this section as PDF\',\n'
            '                            compact: false,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                              _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '                                \'${widget.category} Expenses\',\n'
            '                                <String>[\'Date\', \'Amount\'],\n'
            '                                records\n'
            '                                    .map(\n'
            '                                      (Map<String, dynamic> row) => <String>[\n'
            '                                        _displayDate(row[\'date\']),\n'
            '                                        \'-${_plainMoney(row[\'amount\'])}\',\n'
            '                                      ],\n'
            '                                    )\n'
            '                                    .toList(),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                          _MiniAction(\n'
            '                            label: \'Add\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: semanticRed,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(_addExpense()),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      if (records.isEmpty)\n'
            '                        const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                          premiumExpenseIcon,\n'
            '                          \'No expense entries yet\',\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      else\n'
            '                        _LedgerTableCard(\n'
            '                          headers: const <String>[\'DATE\', \'AMOUNT\'],\n'
            '                          flexes: const <int>[42, 42],\n'
            '                          rows: records\n'
            '                              .map(\n'
            '                                (Map<String, dynamic> row) =>\n'
            '                                    _LedgerTableRowData(\n'
            '                                  cells: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                    _LedgerDateCell(\n'
            '                                      date: row[\'date\'],\n'
            '                                      color: semanticRed,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                    _LedgerAmountCell(\n'
            '                                      value: \'-${_money(row[\'amount\'])}\',\n'
            '                                      color: semanticRed,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ],\n'
            '                                  onDelete: () =>\n'
            '                                      unawaited(_deleteEntry(\'${row[\'id\']}\')),\n'
            '                                  semanticLabel:\n'
            '                                      \'Delete ${_displayDate(row[\'date\'])} expense entry\',\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              )\n'
            '                              .toList(),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'const int _diaryTitleMaxLength = 500;\n'
            'const int _diaryContentMaxLength = 20000;\n'
            '\n'
            'String _cleanDiaryContent(String value) => value\n'
            '    .replaceAll(\'\\r\\n\', \'\\n\')\n'
            '    .replaceAll(\'\\r\', \'\\n\')\n'
            '    .replaceAll(RegExp(r\'[\\u0000-\\u0008\\u000B\\u000C\\u000E-\\u001F\\u007F]\'), \'\')\n'
            '    .trim();\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DiaryEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _DiaryEditorSheet({required this.sync, this.existing});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final Map<String, dynamic>? existing;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_DiaryEditorSheet> createState() => _DiaryEditorSheetState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DiaryEditorSheetState extends State<_DiaryEditorSheet> {\n'
            '  late final TextEditingController _date;\n'
            '  late final TextEditingController _title;\n'
            '  late final TextEditingController _content;\n'
            '  late final String _entryId;\n'
            '  bool _saving = false;\n'
            '  String? _error;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _date = TextEditingController(\n'
            '      text: \'${widget.existing?[\'date\'] ?? _today()}\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    _title = TextEditingController(text: \'${widget.existing?[\'title\'] ?? \'\'}\');\n'
            '    _content = TextEditingController(\n'
            '      text: \'${widget.existing?[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    _entryId =\n'
            '        widget.existing == null ? _newId(\'dia\') : \'${widget.existing![\'id\']}\';\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    _date.dispose();\n'
            '    _title.dispose();\n'
            '    _content.dispose();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  String? _editConflict() {\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic>? original = widget.existing;\n'
            '    if (original == null) return null;\n'
            '    Map<String, dynamic>? current;\n'
            '    for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(\n'
            '      widget.sync.state[\'diaryDB\'],\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      if (\'${row[\'id\']}\' == _entryId) {\n'
            '        current = row;\n'
            '        break;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (current == null) {\n'
            '      return \'This page was deleted on another device. Your draft is still here.\';\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (\'${current[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\' != \'${original[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\' ||\n'
            '        \'${current[\'title\'] ?? \'\'}\' != \'${original[\'title\'] ?? \'\'}\' ||\n'
            '        \'${current[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\' != \'${original[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\') {\n'
            '      return \'This page changed on another device. Reopen it before saving; your draft is still here.\';\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return null;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _submit() async {\n'
            '    if (_saving) return;\n'
            '    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();\n'
            '    final String entryDate = _date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final DateTime? parsedDate = LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate);\n'
            '    final String entryTitle =\n'
            '        _title.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r\'\\s+\'), \' \').trim();\n'
            '    final String entryContent = _cleanDiaryContent(_content.text);\n'
            '    if (parsedDate == null || entryContent.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _error = \'Choose a valid date and write something before saving.\';\n'
            '      });\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String? conflict = _editConflict();\n'
            '    if (conflict != null) {\n'
            '      setState(() => _error = conflict);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _saving = true;\n'
            '      _error = null;\n'
