            '    });\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'diaryDB/$_entryId\',\n'
            '        <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '          \'id\': _entryId,\n'
            '          \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '          \'title\': entryTitle.isEmpty ? \'Untitled\' : entryTitle,\n'
            '          \'content\': entryContent,\n'
            '          \'updated\': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,\n'
            '        },\n'
            '        reason:\n'
            '            widget.existing == null ? \'diary-entry-save\' : \'diary-entry-update\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      HapticFeedback.successNotification();\n'
            '      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, parsedDate);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _saving = false;\n'
            '        _error = \'$error\';\n'
            '      });\n'
            '      HapticFeedback.errorNotification();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => _SheetFrame(\n'
            '        title: widget.existing == null ? \'New Diary Page\' : \'Edit Page\',\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          _DateField(controller: _date),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: _title,\n'
            '            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,\n'
            '            textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,\n'
            '            inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '              LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(_diaryTitleMaxLength),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Title\',\n'
            '              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.title_rounded),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: _content,\n'
            '            autofocus: widget.existing == null,\n'
            '            minLines: 7,\n'
            '            maxLines: 14,\n'
            '            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,\n'
            '            inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '              LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(_diaryContentMaxLength),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Write your diary…\',\n'
            '              alignLabelWithHint: true,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          if (_error != null) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            Semantics(\n'
            '              liveRegion: true,\n'
            '              child: Text(\n'
            '                _error!,\n'
            '                style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                  color: appleRed,\n'
            '                  fontSize: 12,\n'
            '                  height: 1.35,\n'
            '                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '          IgnorePointer(\n'
            '            ignoring: _saving,\n'
            '            child: _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: _saving ? \'Saving…\' : \'Save Page\',\n'
            '              color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '              icon: _saving ? Icons.sync_rounded : Icons.save_rounded,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_submit()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<DateTime?> _saveDiarySheet(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  LedgerSyncService sync, {\n'
            '  Map<String, dynamic>? existing,\n'
            '}) async {\n'
            '  final DateTime? savedDate = await _openSheet<DateTime>(\n'
            '    context,\n'
            '    _DiaryEditorSheet(sync: sync, existing: existing),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '  if (savedDate != null && context.mounted) _toast(context, \'Diary saved!\');\n'
            '  return savedDate;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class DiaryScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const DiaryScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<DiaryScreen> createState() => _DiaryScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DiaryScreenState extends State<DiaryScreen> {\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '  int _month = DateTime.now().month;\n'
            '  int _year = DateTime.now().year;\n'
            '  Object? _cachedDiarySource;\n'
            '  Object? _visibleDiarySource;\n'
            '  bool _hasDiaryCache = false;\n'
            '  bool _hasVisibleCache = false;\n'
            '  bool _visibleUsesPeriod = false;\n'
            '  int _visibleMonth = 0;\n'
            '  int _visibleYear = 0;\n'
            '  int _cachedDiaryPeriodVersion = -1;\n'
            '  String _visibleQuery = \'\';\n'
            '  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _allEntries = const <Map<String, dynamic>>[];\n'
            '  List<DateTime> _availablePeriods = const <DateTime>[];\n'
            '  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _visibleEntries = const <Map<String, dynamic>>[];\n'
            '  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _visibleNeedsDateEntries =\n'
            '      const <Map<String, dynamic>>[];\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _refreshDiaryCache() {\n'
            '    final Object? source = widget.sync.state[\'diaryDB\'];\n'
            '    final int periodVersion = widget.sync.diaryPeriodVersion;\n'
            '    final bool sourceChanged =\n'
            '        !_hasDiaryCache || !identical(source, _cachedDiarySource);\n'
            '    if (!sourceChanged && periodVersion == _cachedDiaryPeriodVersion) return;\n'
            '    if (sourceChanged) {\n'
            '      _cachedDiarySource = source;\n'
            '      _allEntries = _rows(source);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _availablePeriods = widget.sync.diaryAvailablePeriods;\n'
            '    _cachedDiaryPeriodVersion = periodVersion;\n'
            '    _hasDiaryCache = true;\n'
            '    _hasVisibleCache = false;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _filteredEntries({\n'
            '    required DateTime? selectedPeriod,\n'
            '    required int month,\n'
            '    required int year,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    final bool usePeriod = selectedPeriod != null;\n'
            '    if (_hasVisibleCache &&\n'
            '        identical(_visibleDiarySource, _cachedDiarySource) &&\n'
            '        _visibleUsesPeriod == usePeriod &&\n'
            '        _visibleMonth == month &&\n'
            '        _visibleYear == year &&\n'
            '        _visibleQuery == _query) {\n'
            '      return _visibleEntries;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final List<String> words = _query\n'
            '        .toLowerCase()\n'
            '        .split(RegExp(r\'\\s+\'))\n'
            '        .where((String word) => word.isNotEmpty)\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> dated = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> needsDate = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];\n'
            '    for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _allEntries) {\n'
            '      final String haystack = \'${row[\'title\'] ?? \'\'} ${row[\'content\'] ?? \'\'} \'\n'
            '              \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'} ${_displayDate(row[\'date\'])}\'\n'
            '          .toLowerCase();\n'
            '      if (!words.every(haystack.contains)) continue;\n'
            '      if (LedgerMath.strictDate(row[\'date\']) == null) {\n'
            '        needsDate.add(row);\n'
            '      } else if (!usePeriod || LedgerMath.inMonth(row, month, year)) {\n'
            '        dated.add(row);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    dated.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {\n'
            '      final int byDate =\n'
            '          (LedgerMath.date(b[\'date\'])?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? -1).compareTo(\n'
            '        LedgerMath.date(a[\'date\'])?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? -1,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return byDate != 0\n'
            '          ? byDate\n'
            '          : LedgerMath.number(b[\'updated\'])\n'
            '              .compareTo(LedgerMath.number(a[\'updated\']));\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    needsDate.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {\n'
            '      final int byUpdated = LedgerMath.number(b[\'updated\'])\n'
            '          .compareTo(LedgerMath.number(a[\'updated\']));\n'
            '      return byUpdated != 0\n'
            '          ? byUpdated\n'
            '          : \'${a[\'id\'] ?? \'\'}\'.compareTo(\'${b[\'id\'] ?? \'\'}\');\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    _visibleEntries = dated;\n'
            '    _visibleNeedsDateEntries = needsDate;\n'
            '    _visibleDiarySource = _cachedDiarySource;\n'
            '    _visibleUsesPeriod = usePeriod;\n'
            '    _visibleMonth = month;\n'
            '    _visibleYear = year;\n'
            '    _visibleQuery = _query;\n'
            '    _hasVisibleCache = true;\n'
            '    return _visibleEntries;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _createEntry() async {\n'
            '    final DateTime? savedDate = await _saveDiarySheet(context, widget.sync);\n'
            '    if (!mounted || savedDate == null) return;\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _month = savedDate.month;\n'
            '      _year = savedDate.year;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _selectPeriod(int month, int year) async {\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _month = month;\n'
            '      _year = year;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.ensureDiaryMonthLoaded(year, month);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _diaryEntryCard(Map<String, dynamic> entry, {bool needsDate = false}) {\n'
            '    final String preview =\n'
            '        \'${entry[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\'.replaceAll(RegExp(r\'\\s+\'), \' \').trim();\n'
            '    final String entryTitle = \'${entry[\'title\'] ?? \'Untitled\'}\';\n'
            '    final String dateLabel = needsDate\n'
            '        ? \'DATE NEEDS CORRECTION\'\n'
            '        : _displayDate(entry[\'date\']).toUpperCase();\n'
            '    return Padding(\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),\n'
            '      child: _FastRouteLauncher(\n'
            '        destinationBuilder: (_) => DiaryDetailScreen(\n'
            '          sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '          entryId: \'${entry[\'id\']}\',\n'
            '          onDateChanged: (DateTime date) {\n'
            '            if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '            setState(() {\n'
            '              _month = date.month;\n'
            '              _year = date.year;\n'
            '            });\n'
            '          },\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        sourceBuilder: (VoidCallback openRoute) => _Pressable(\n'
            '          semanticLabel: needsDate\n'
            '              ? \'$entryTitle, date needs correction\'\n'
            '              : \'$entryTitle, ${_displayDate(entry[\'date\'])}\',\n'
            '          onTap: openRoute,\n'
            '          animatePress: false,\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(23),\n'
            '          feedbackColor: diaryOrange,\n'
            '          child: _GlassCard(\n'
            '            borderRadius: 23,\n'
            '            accentColor: diaryOrange,\n'
            '            shadowColor: diaryOrange.withAlpha(72),\n'
            '            child: Column(\n'
            '              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                Row(\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      child: Text(\n'
            '                        entryTitle,\n'
            '                        maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                        style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                          color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                          fontSize: 20,\n'
            '                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: diaryOrange),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                if (preview.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    \'“${preview.length > 90 ? \'${preview.substring(0, 90)}…\' : preview}”\',\n'
            '                    maxLines: 2,\n'
            '                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                    style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                      color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                      fontSize: 14,\n'
            '                      fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,\n'
            '                      height: 1.35,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '                Row(\n'
            '                  children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    if (needsDate) ...<Widget>[\n'
            '                      const Icon(\n'
            '                        Icons.event_busy_rounded,\n'
            '                        color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                        size: 15,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(width: 6),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                    Expanded(\n'
            '                      child: Text(\n'
            '                        dateLabel,\n'
            '                        style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                          color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                          fontSize: 10,\n'
            '                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                          letterSpacing: .8,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    _refreshDiaryCache();\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> allEntries = _allEntries;\n'
            '    final List<DateTime> availablePeriods = _availablePeriods;\n'
            '    final DateTime? selectedPeriod = LedgerMath.resolveRecordPeriod(\n'
            '      availablePeriods,\n'
            '      month: _month,\n'
            '      year: _year,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final int selectedMonth = selectedPeriod?.month ?? _month;\n'
            '    final int selectedYear = selectedPeriod?.year ?? _year;\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> entries = _filteredEntries(\n'
            '      selectedPeriod: selectedPeriod,\n'
            '      month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '      year: selectedYear,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> needsDateEntries =\n'
            '        _visibleNeedsDateEntries;\n'
            '    final bool loading = widget.sync.isDiaryMonthLoading(\n'
            '      selectedYear,\n'
            '      selectedMonth,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final bool hasVisibleEntries =\n'
            '        entries.isNotEmpty || needsDateEntries.isNotEmpty;\n'
            '    final int contentItemCount = loading\n'
            '        ? 1\n'
            '        : hasVisibleEntries\n'
            '            ? entries.length +\n'
            '                (needsDateEntries.isEmpty ? 0 : needsDateEntries.length + 1)\n'
            '            : 1;\n'
            '    final String emptyMessage = allEntries.isEmpty\n'
            '        ? \'No diary pages yet\'\n'
            '        : _query.trim().isNotEmpty\n'
            '            ? \'No matching diary pages\'\n'
            '            : \'No diary pages found\';\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Personal Diary\',\n'
            '          color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'New\',\n'
            '              color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '              compact: true,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_createEntry()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: ListView.builder(\n'
            '            key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'diary-scroll\'),\n'
            '            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '            keyboardDismissBehavior: ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '            itemCount: contentItemCount + 2,\n'
            '            itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, int index) {\n'
            '              if (index == 0) {\n'
            '                return _MonthYearPicker(\n'
            '                  month: selectedMonth,\n'
            '                  year: selectedYear,\n'
            '                  availablePeriods: availablePeriods,\n'
            '                  color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                  onChanged: (int month, int year) =>\n'
            '                      unawaited(_selectPeriod(month, year)),\n'
            '                );\n'
            '              }\n'
            '              if (index == 1) {\n'
            '                return Padding(\n'
            '                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14, bottom: 16),\n'
            '                  child: _SearchBox(\n'
            '                    hint: \'Search diary…\',\n'
            '                    color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                    onChanged: (String value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                );\n'
            '              }\n'
            '              if (loading) {\n'
            '                return const Padding(\n'
            '                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 36),\n'
            '                  child: Center(\n'
            '                    child: CircularProgressIndicator.adaptive(\n'
            '                      valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(diaryOrange),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                );\n'
            '              }\n'
            '              if (!hasVisibleEntries) {\n'
            '                return _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.auto_stories_rounded,\n'
            '                  emptyMessage,\n'
            '                  color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                );\n'
            '              }\n'
            '              final int contentIndex = index - 2;\n'
            '              if (contentIndex < entries.length) {\n'
            '                return _diaryEntryCard(entries[contentIndex]);\n'
            '              }\n'
            '              final int needsDateIndex = contentIndex - entries.length;\n'
            '              if (needsDateIndex == 0) {\n'
            '                return Padding(\n'
            '                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4, bottom: 12),\n'
            '                  child: Semantics(\n'
            '                    header: true,\n'
            '                    child: const Row(\n'
            '                      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                        Icon(\n'
            '                          Icons.event_busy_rounded,\n'
            '                          color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                          size: 18,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                        SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                        Expanded(\n'
            '                          child: Text(\n'
            '                            \'PAGES NEEDING A VALID DATE\',\n'
            '                            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                              fontSize: 11,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                              letterSpacing: .8,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                );\n'
            '              }\n'
            '              return _diaryEntryCard(\n'
            '                needsDateEntries[needsDateIndex - 1],\n'
            '                needsDate: true,\n'
            '              );\n'
            '            },\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class DiaryDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const DiaryDetailScreen({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.entryId,\n'
            '    required this.onDateChanged,\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final String entryId;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<DateTime> onDateChanged;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<DiaryDetailScreen> createState() => _DiaryDetailScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DiaryDetailScreenState extends State<DiaryDetailScreen> {\n'
            '  bool _actionInFlight = false;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _edit(BuildContext context, Map<String, dynamic> entry) async {\n'
            '    if (_actionInFlight) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _actionInFlight = true);\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      final DateTime? savedDate = await _saveDiarySheet(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        widget.sync,\n'
            '        existing: entry,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (savedDate != null) widget.onDateChanged(savedDate);\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _actionInFlight = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _delete(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    if (_actionInFlight) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _actionInFlight = true);\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Delete diary page?\',\n'
            '        \'This page will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '      )) {\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!context.mounted) return;\n'
            '      await widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'diaryDB/${widget.entryId}\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'diary-entry-delete\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (context.mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _actionInFlight = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _share(BuildContext context, Map<String, dynamic> entry) async {\n'
            '    if (_actionInFlight) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _actionInFlight = true);\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '        \'${entry[\'title\'] ?? \'Diary\'}\',\n'
            '        <String>[\'Date\', \'Content\'],\n'
            '        <List<String>>[\n'
            '          <String>[_displayDate(entry[\'date\']), \'${entry[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\'],\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\n'
            '      if (context.mounted) {\n'
            '        _toast(\n'
            '          context,\n'
            '          \'Diary PDF sharing failed. Please try again.\',\n'
            '          error: true,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _actionInFlight = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '        animation: widget.sync,\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '          Map<String, dynamic>? entry;\n'
            '          for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(\n'
            '            widget.sync.state[\'diaryDB\'],\n'
            '          )) {\n'
            '            if (\'${row[\'id\']}\' == widget.entryId) {\n'
            '              entry = row;\n'
            '              break;\n'
            '            }\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          if (entry == null) {\n'
            '            return const Scaffold(\n'
            '              body: Center(\n'
            '                child: _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.auto_stories_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'Diary page no longer exists\',\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic> current = entry;\n'
            '          return Scaffold(\n'
            '            body: Column(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '                  leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '                  title: \'${current[\'title\'] ?? \'Untitled\'}\',\n'
            '                  color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                  actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _CircleAction(\n'
            '                      icon: Icons.edit_rounded,\n'
            '                      color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Edit diary page\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_edit(context, current)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    _CircleAction(\n'
            '                      icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '                      color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Share diary page\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_share(context, current)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete diary page\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_delete(context)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: SingleChildScrollView(\n'
            '                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                    padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '                    child: _GlassCard(\n'
            '                      borderColor: diaryOrange.withAlpha(65),\n'
            '                      shadowColor: diaryOrange.withAlpha(35),\n'
            '                      tintColor: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                      child: Column(\n'
            '                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          Text(\n'
            '                            \'${current[\'title\'] ?? \'Untitled\'}\',\n'
            '                            style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                              fontSize: 24,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                              letterSpacing: -.35,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(height: 10),\n'
            '                          Text(\n'
            '                            _displayDate(current[\'date\']).toUpperCase(),\n'
            '                            style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                              fontSize: 11,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                              letterSpacing: 1,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '                          SelectableText(\n'
            '                            \'${current[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '                            style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                              color: diaryOrange,\n'
            '                              fontSize: 17,\n'
            '                              height: 1.9,\n'
            '                              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _BusinessTone {\n'
            '  const _BusinessTone(this.color, this.label, this.badge, this.icon);\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Color color;\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '  final String badge;\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'const Map<String, _BusinessTone> _businessTones = <String, _BusinessTone>{\n'
            '  \'green\': _BusinessTone(\n'
            '    appleGreen,\n'
            '    \'INCOME (RECEIVED)\',\n'
            '    \'INCOME\',\n'
            '    Icons.south_west_rounded,\n'
            '  ),\n'
            '  \'red\': _BusinessTone(\n'
            '    semanticRed,\n'
            '    \'EXPENSE (SENT)\',\n'
            '    \'EXPENSE\',\n'
            '    Icons.north_east_rounded,\n'
            '  ),\n'
            '  \'blue\': _BusinessTone(\n'
            '    appleBlue,\n'
            '    \'BANK / OTHER\',\n'
            '    \'BANK / OTHER\',\n'
            '    Icons.account_balance_rounded,\n'
            '  ),\n'
            '  \'orange\': _BusinessTone(\n'
            '    appleOrange,\n'
            '    \'PENDING / UDHAR\',\n'
            '    \'PENDING\',\n'
            '    Icons.schedule_rounded,\n'
            '  ),\n'
            '};\n'
            '\n'
            'class BusinessScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const BusinessScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<BusinessScreen> createState() => _BusinessScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _BusinessScreenState extends State<BusinessScreen> {\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addProject() async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController name = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      _SheetFrame(\n'
            '        title: \'New Business Khata\',\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          TextField(\n'
            '            controller: name,\n'
            '            autofocus: true,\n'
            '            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,\n'
            '            decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '              labelText: \'Account name\',\n'
            '              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.business_center_rounded),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '          _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '            label: \'Create Khata\',\n'
            '            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '            onTap: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save != true || !mounted) {\n'
            '      name.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String project = _cleanKey(name.text);\n'
            '    name.dispose();\n'
            '    if (project.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Enter an account name.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(widget.sync.state[\'projectDB\']);\n'
            '    if (database.keys.any(\n'
            '      (String key) => key.toLowerCase() == project.toLowerCase(),\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Account already exists.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '          \'projectDB/$project\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'records\': <dynamic>[],\n'
            '            \'created\': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,\n'
            '            \'safeKeyCore\': true,\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'business-project-create\'),\n'
            '      \'Business account created!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteProject(String name) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete $name?\',\n'
            '      \'The account and every business record will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => widget.sync.write(\n'
            '        \'projectDB/$name\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'business-project-delete\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      \'Business account deleted!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(widget.sync.state[\'projectDB\']);\n'
            '    final Map<String, int> recordCounts =\n'
            '        widget.sync.currentProjection.businessRecordCounts;\n'
            '    final List<String> names = database.keys\n'
            '        .where(\n'
            '          (String name) => name.toLowerCase().contains(_query.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        .toList()\n'
            '      ..sort(\n'
            '        (String a, String b) => a.toLowerCase().compareTo(b.toLowerCase()),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: <Widget>[\n'
            '        _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '          title: \'Business Hub\',\n'
            '          color: appleBlue,\n'
            '          actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'New\',\n'
            '              color: appleBlue,\n'
            '              foregroundColor: appleBlue,\n'
            '              compact: true,\n'
            '              tonal: true,\n'
            '              onTap: () => unawaited(_addProject()),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: ListView(\n'
            '            key: const PageStorageKey<String>(\'business-scroll\'),\n'
            '            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '            padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              _SearchBox(\n'
            '                hint: \'Search account…\',\n'
            '                onChanged: (String value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '              if (names.isEmpty)\n'
            '                const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.business_center_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'No business khatas added yet\',\n'
            '                )\n'
            '              else\n'
            '                ...names.map((String name) {\n'
            '                  final int count = recordCounts[name]!;\n'
            '                  return _ListCard(\n'
            '                    title: name,\n'
            '                    subtitle: \'$count Records Logged\',\n'
            '                    icon: Icons.business_center_rounded,\n'
            '                    color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                    onDelete: () => unawaited(_deleteProject(name)),\n'
            '                    destinationBuilder: (_) => BusinessDetailScreen(\n'
            '                      sync: widget.sync,\n'
            '                      projectName: name,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class BusinessDetailScreen extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const BusinessDetailScreen({\n'
            '    required this.sync,\n'
            '    required this.projectName,\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '  final String projectName;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _addEntry(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController date = TextEditingController(text: _today());\n'
            '    final TextEditingController title = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    final TextEditingController amount = TextEditingController();\n'
            '    String tone = \'green\';\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      StatefulBuilder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext, StateSetter setSheetState) =>\n'
            '            _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'Business Entry\',\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            _DateField(controller: date),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: title,\n'
            '              textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Detail / title\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.notes_rounded),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: amount,\n'
            '              autofocus: true,\n'
            '              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(\n'
            '                decimal: true,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              inputFormatters: <TextInputFormatter>[\n'
            '                FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(RegExp(r\'[0-9.]\')),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Amount\',\n'
            '                prefixText: \'₹ \',\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 15),\n'
            '            Wrap(\n'
            '              spacing: 8,\n'
            '              runSpacing: 8,\n'
            '              children: _businessTones.entries\n'
            '                  .map(\n'
            '                    (MapEntry<String, _BusinessTone> entry) => ChoiceChip(\n'
            '                      selected: tone == entry.key,\n'
            '                      label: Text(entry.value.badge),\n'
            '                      avatar: Icon(\n'
            '                        entry.value.icon,\n'
            '                        size: 16,\n'
            '                        color: entry.value.color,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      selectedColor: entry.value.color.withAlpha(45),\n'
            '                      shape: const StadiumBorder(),\n'
            '                      showCheckmark: false,\n'
            '                      side: BorderSide(\n'
            '                        color: entry.value.color.withAlpha(70),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      onSelected: (_) {\n'
            '                        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '                        setSheetState(() => tone = entry.key);\n'
            '                      },\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  )\n'
            '                  .toList(),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'Save Entry\',\n'
            '              color: _businessTones[tone]!.color,\n'
            '              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, true),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save != true || !context.mounted) {\n'
            '      date.dispose();\n'
            '      title.dispose();\n'
            '      amount.dispose();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String entryDate = date.text.trim();\n'
            '    final String entryTitle =\n'
            '        title.text.trim().isEmpty ? \'Record\' : title.text.trim();\n'
            '    final double entryAmount = double.tryParse(amount.text) ?? 0;\n'
            '    date.dispose();\n'
            '    title.dispose();\n'
            '    amount.dispose();\n'
            '    if (LedgerMath.strictDate(entryDate) == null || entryAmount <= 0) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Enter details and a valid positive amount.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String id = _newId(\'prj\');\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => sync.write(\n'
            '          \'projectDB/$projectName/records/$id\',\n'
            '          <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'id\': id,\n'
            '            \'date\': entryDate,\n'
            '            \'title\': entryTitle,\n'
            '            \'amount\': entryAmount,\n'
            '            \'color\': tone,\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          reason: \'business-entry-save\'),\n'
            '      \'Business entry saved!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteEntry(BuildContext context, String id) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete record?\',\n'
            '      \'This business record will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!context.mounted) return;\n'
            '    await _runMutation(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      () => sync.write(\n'
            '        \'projectDB/$projectName/records/$id\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'business-entry-delete\',\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      \'Record deleted!\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _deleteProject(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    if (!await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Delete $projectName?\',\n'
            '      \'The complete business account will be permanently deleted.\',\n'
            '    )) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!context.mounted) return;\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await sync.write(\n'
            '        \'projectDB/$projectName\',\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '        reason: \'business-project-delete\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (context.mounted) _toast(context, \'$error\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) => AnimatedBuilder(\n'
            '        animation: sync,\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) {\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic> database = _map(sync.state[\'projectDB\']);\n'
            '          if (database[projectName] is! Map) {\n'
            '            return const Scaffold(\n'
            '              body: Center(\n'
            '                child: _EmptyState(\n'
            '                  Icons.business_center_rounded,\n'
            '                  \'Account no longer exists\',\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          final Map<String, dynamic> project = _map(database[projectName]);\n'
            '          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = _rows(project[\'records\'])\n'
            '            ..sort(\n'
            '              (Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>\n'
            '                  \'${b[\'date\']}\'.compareTo(\'${a[\'date\']}\'),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          final Map<String, double> totals = <String, double>{\n'
            '            for (final String key in _businessTones.keys) key: 0,\n'
            '          };\n'
            '          for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in records) {\n'
            '            final String key = _businessTones.containsKey(\'${row[\'color\']}\')\n'
            '                ? \'${row[\'color\']}\'\n'
            '                : \'blue\';\n'
            '            totals[key] =\n'
            '                (totals[key] ?? 0) + LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']).abs();\n'
            '          }\n'
            '          return Scaffold(\n'
            '            body: Column(\n'
            '              children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                _ScreenHeader(\n'
            '                  leading: const _BackCircle(),\n'
            '                  title: projectName,\n'
            '                  color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                  actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                    _CircleAction(\n'
            '                      icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_addEntry(context)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    _DeleteActionButton(\n'
            '                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6),\n'
            '                      semanticLabel: \'Delete business account\',\n'
            '                      onTap: () => unawaited(_deleteProject(context)),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: ListView(\n'
            '                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                    padding: UIConstants.screenPadding,\n'
            '                    children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                      if (totals.values.any((double value) => value > 0))\n'
            '                        GridView.count(\n'
            '                          crossAxisCount: 2,\n'
            '                          crossAxisSpacing: 11,\n'
            '                          mainAxisSpacing: 11,\n'
            '                          shrinkWrap: true,\n'
            '                          physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                          clipBehavior: Clip.none,\n'
            '                          childAspectRatio: 1.55,\n'
            '                          children: totals.entries\n'
            '                              .where(\n'
            '                            (MapEntry<String, double> item) => item.value > 0,\n'
            '                          )\n'
            '                              .map((MapEntry<String, double> item) {\n'
            '                            final _BusinessTone tone =\n'
            '                                _businessTones[item.key]!;\n'
            '                            return _GlassCard(\n'
            '                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),\n'
            '                              borderRadius: 19,\n'
            '                              borderColor: tone.color.withAlpha(60),\n'
            '                              shadowColor: tone.color.withAlpha(20),\n'
            '                              child: Column(\n'
            '                                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                                children: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                  Text(\n'
            '                                    tone.label,\n'
            '                                    maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                                    style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                                      color: tone.color,\n'
            '                                      fontSize: 9,\n'
            '                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                  const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '                                  Text(\n'
            '                                    _money(item.value),\n'
            '                                    style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                                      color: tone.color,\n'
            '                                      fontSize: 19,\n'
            '                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                                      fontFeatures: AppStyles.tabularFigures,\n'
            '                                    ),\n'
            '                                  ),\n'
            '                                ],\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            );\n'
            '                          }).toList(),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 24),\n'
            '                      _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                        \'All Entries\',\n'
            '                        color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                        actions: <Widget>[\n'
            '                          _SoftShareButton(\n'
            '                            label: \'Share\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.share_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                            semanticLabel: \'Share this section as PDF\',\n'
            '                            compact: false,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                              _ExportService.sharePdf(\n'
            '                                \'$projectName Business Khata\',\n'
            '                                <String>[\'Date\', \'Detail\', \'Type\', \'Amount\'],\n'
            '                                records.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) {\n'
            '                                  final String key = _businessTones\n'
            '                                          .containsKey(\'${row[\'color\']}\')\n'
            '                                      ? \'${row[\'color\']}\'\n'
            '                                      : \'blue\';\n'
            '                                  return <String>[\n'
            '                                    _displayDate(row[\'date\']),\n'
            '                                    \'${row[\'title\'] ?? \'Record\'}\',\n'
            '                                    _businessTones[key]!.badge,\n'
            '                                    _plainMoney(row[\'amount\']),\n'
            '                                  ];\n'
            '                                }).toList(),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                          _MiniAction(\n'
            '                            label: \'Entry\',\n'
            '                            icon: Icons.add_rounded,\n'
            '                            color: appleBlue,\n'
            '                            onTap: () => unawaited(_addEntry(context)),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      if (records.isEmpty)\n'
            '                        const _EmptyState(\n'
            '                          Icons.business_center_outlined,\n'
            '                          \'No records logged yet\',\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      else\n'
            '                        _LedgerTableCard(\n'
            '                          headers: const <String>[\'DATE\', \'DETAIL\', \'AMOUNT\'],\n'
            '                          flexes: const <int>[24, 36, 28],\n'
            '                          rows: records.map((Map<String, dynamic> row) {\n'
            '                            final String key =\n'
            '                                _businessTones.containsKey(\'${row[\'color\']}\')\n'
            '                                    ? \'${row[\'color\']}\'\n'
            '                                    : \'blue\';\n'
            '                            final _BusinessTone tone = _businessTones[key]!;\n'
            '                            return _LedgerTableRowData(\n'
            '                              cells: <Widget>[\n'
            '                                _LedgerDateCell(\n'
            '                                  date: row[\'date\'],\n'
            '                                  color: tone.color,\n'
            '                                  stacked: true,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                                _LedgerDetailCell(\n'
            '                                  title: \'${row[\'title\'] ?? \'Record\'}\',\n'
            '                                  badge: tone.badge,\n'
            '                                  color: tone.color,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                                _LedgerAmountCell(\n'
            '                                  value: _money(row[\'amount\']),\n'
            '                                  color: tone.color,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              ],\n'
            '                              onDelete: () => unawaited(\n'
            '                                  _deleteEntry(context, \'${row[\'id\']}\')),\n'
            '                              semanticLabel:\n'
            '                                  \'Delete ${row[\'title\'] ?? \'Record\'} business entry\',\n'
            '                            );\n'
            '                          }).toList(),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        },\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _AiMessage {\n'
            '  const _AiMessage(this.text, this.user);\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String text;\n'
            '  final bool user;\n'
            '}\n'

            '    this.protocol = \'\',\n'
            '    this.snapshotId = \'\',\n'
            '    this.stateFingerprint = \'\',\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String reply;\n'
            '  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> actions;\n'
            '  final String envelopeFingerprint;\n'
            '  final String protocol;\n'
            '  final String snapshotId;\n'
            '  final String stateFingerprint;\n'
            '}\n'
