            'class _AiBatchProgressCard extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _AiBatchProgressCard({\n'
            '    required this.job,\n'
            '    required this.secondsRemaining,\n'
            '    required this.writing,\n'
            '    required this.onCancel,\n'
            '    required this.onRetry,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final AiBatchJob job;\n'
            '  final int secondsRemaining;\n'
            '  final bool writing;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onCancel;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onRetry;\n'
            '\n'
            '  String get _countdown {\n'
            '    final int minutes = secondsRemaining ~/ 60;\n'
            '    final int seconds = secondsRemaining % 60;\n'
            '    return \'${minutes.toString().padLeft(2, \'0\')}:\'\n'
            '        \'${seconds.toString().padLeft(2, \'0\')}\';\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final bool dark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;\n'
            '    final String status = job.paused\n'
            '        ? \'Paused safely${job.lastError.isEmpty ? \'\' : \' • ${job.lastError}\'}\'\n'
            '        : writing\n'
            '            ? \'Saving next ${job.nextChunkSize}…\'\n'
            '            : \'Next ${job.nextChunkSize} in $_countdown\';\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 0, 12, 8),\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 10, 10),\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        color: dark ? appleBlue.withAlpha(25) : appleBlue.withAlpha(12),\n'
            '        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),\n'
            '        border: Border.all(color: appleBlue.withAlpha(dark ? 68 : 42)),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: Column(\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '        children: <Widget>[\n'
            '          Row(\n'
            '            children: <Widget>[\n'
            '              Icon(\n'
            '                job.paused ? Icons.pause_circle_rounded : Icons.shield_rounded,\n'
            '                color: job.paused ? appleOrange : appleBlue,\n'
            '                size: 21,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(width: 9),\n'
            '              Expanded(\n'
            '                child: Text(\n'
            '                  \'${job.completed} of ${job.actions.length} changes saved\',\n'
            '                  style: const TextStyle(\n'
            '                    fontSize: 13,\n'
            '                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              if (job.paused && !job.hasStateConflict)\n'
            '                TextButton(onPressed: onRetry, child: const Text(\'Retry\')),\n'
            '              TextButton(\n'
            '                onPressed: onCancel,\n'
            '                child: const Text(\'Cancel\', style: TextStyle(color: appleRed)),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            status,\n'
            '            maxLines: 2,\n'
            '            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '            style: TextStyle(\n'
            '              color: job.paused ? appleOrange : systemGray,\n'
            '              fontSize: 11,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '          ClipRRect(\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),\n'
            '            child: LinearProgressIndicator(\n'
            '              minHeight: 5,\n'
            '              value:\n'
            '                  job.actions.isEmpty ? 0 : job.completed / job.actions.length,\n'
            '              color: job.paused ? appleOrange : appleBlue,\n'
            '              backgroundColor: systemGray.withAlpha(30),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class AiHubScreen extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const AiHubScreen({required this.sync, super.key});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final LedgerSyncService sync;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<AiHubScreen> createState() => _AiHubScreenState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _AiHubScreenState extends State<AiHubScreen> with WidgetsBindingObserver {\n'
            '  static const FlutterSecureStorage _secureStorage = FlutterSecureStorage();\n'
            '  static const String _batchJobSetting = \'ai.batchJob.v1\';\n'
            '  static const String _completedFingerprintSetting =\n'
            '      \'ai.completedFingerprints.v1\';\n'
            '  static const String _externalSnapshotIdSetting = \'ai.externalSnapshotId.v1\';\n'
            '  static const String _externalFingerprintSetting =\n'
            '      \'ai.externalStateFingerprint.v1\';\n'
            '  final TextEditingController _input = TextEditingController();\n'
            '  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();\n'
            '  final List<_AiMessage> _messages = <_AiMessage>[\n'
            '    const _AiMessage(\n'
            '      \'Namaste! Main aapke Milk, Credit, Expense, Salary, Diary aur Business records ko samajhkar safe changes kar sakta hoon. Har change apply hone se pehle aapko preview milega.\',\n'
            '      false,\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '  ];\n'
            '  final List<_AiMessage> _geminiHistory = <_AiMessage>[];\n'
            '  String _apiKey = \'\';\n'
            '  String _model = \'gemini-2.5-flash\';\n'
            '  String _externalSnapshotId = \'\';\n'
            '  String _externalStateFingerprint = \'\';\n'
            '  String _externalOwnerUid = \'\';\n'
            '  List<String> _completedFingerprints = <String>[];\n'
            '  AiBatchJob? _batchJob;\n'
            '  Timer? _batchTimer;\n'
            '  Timer? _countdownTimer;\n'
            '  bool _busy = false;\n'
            '  bool _sharingExternal = false;\n'
            '  bool _batchWriting = false;\n'
            '  bool _appActive = true;\n'
            '\n'
            '  String get _currentOwnerUid => widget.sync.user?.uid.trim() ?? \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  String _scopedSetting(String base, String ownerUid) => \'$base.$ownerUid\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  List<String> _decodeFingerprintHistory(String? encoded) {\n'
            '    final String raw = encoded?.trim() ?? \'\';\n'
            '    if (raw.isEmpty) return <String>[];\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      final dynamic decoded = jsonDecode(raw);\n'
            '      if (decoded is List) {\n'
            '        return decoded\n'
            '            .map<String>((dynamic value) => \'$value\'.trim())\n'
            '            .where((String value) => value.isNotEmpty && value.length <= 128)\n'
            '            .toSet()\n'
            '            .take(50)\n'
            '            .toList(growable: false);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\n'
            '    return raw.length <= 128 ? <String>[raw] : <String>[];\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);\n'
            '    unawaited(_loadSettings());\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {\n'
            '    final String key = await _secureStorage.read(key: \'gemini.apiKey\') ?? \'\';\n'
            '    final String model =\n'
            '        widget.sync.readSetting(\'gemini.model\') ?? \'gemini-2.5-flash\';\n'
            '    final String ownerUid = _currentOwnerUid;\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? storedBatch = ownerUid.isEmpty\n'
            '        ? null\n'
            '        : AiBatchJob.tryDecode(\n'
            '            widget.sync.readSetting(_scopedSetting(_batchJobSetting, ownerUid)),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? batchJob =\n'
            '        storedBatch?.ownerUid == ownerUid ? storedBatch : null;\n'
            '    final String externalSnapshotId = ownerUid.isEmpty\n'
            '        ? \'\'\n'
            '        : widget.sync.readSetting(\n'
            '              _scopedSetting(_externalSnapshotIdSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '            ) ??\n'
            '            \'\';\n'
            '    final String externalStateFingerprint = ownerUid.isEmpty\n'
            '        ? \'\'\n'
            '        : widget.sync.readSetting(\n'
            '              _scopedSetting(_externalFingerprintSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '            ) ??\n'
            '            \'\';\n'
            '    final List<String> completedFingerprints = ownerUid.isEmpty\n'
            '        ? <String>[]\n'
            '        : _decodeFingerprintHistory(\n'
            '            widget.sync.readSetting(\n'
            '              _scopedSetting(_completedFingerprintSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _apiKey = key;\n'
            '        _model = model;\n'
            '        _batchJob = batchJob?.isComplete == true ? null : batchJob;\n'
            '        _externalSnapshotId = externalSnapshotId;\n'
            '        _externalStateFingerprint = externalStateFingerprint;\n'
            '        _externalOwnerUid = externalSnapshotId.isEmpty ? \'\' : ownerUid;\n'
            '        _completedFingerprints = completedFingerprints;\n'
            '      });\n'
            '      _armBatchTimers();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {\n'
            '    _appActive = state == AppLifecycleState.resumed;\n'
            '    if (_appActive) {\n'
            '      _armBatchTimers();\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      _batchTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '      _countdownTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);\n'
            '    _batchTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    _countdownTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    _input.dispose();\n'
            '    _scroll.dispose();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _configure() async {\n'
            '    final TextEditingController key = TextEditingController(text: _apiKey);\n'
            '    String model = _model;\n'
            '    bool obscure = true;\n'
            '    final bool? save = await _openSheet<bool>(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      StatefulBuilder(\n'
            '        builder: (BuildContext sheetContext, StateSetter setSheetState) =>\n'
            '            _SheetFrame(\n'
            '          title: \'Gemini AI Setup\',\n'
            '          beforeTitle: _ExternalAiConnectPrelude(\n'
            '            onTap: () => unawaited(_shareExternalAiPackage(sheetContext)),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          children: <Widget>[\n'
            '            TextField(\n'
            '              controller: key,\n'
            '              obscureText: obscure,\n'
            '              enableSuggestions: false,\n'
            '              autocorrect: false,\n'
            '              decoration: InputDecoration(\n'
            '                labelText: \'Gemini API key\',\n'
            '                prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.key_rounded),\n'
            '                suffixIcon: IconButton(\n'
            '                  onPressed: () {\n'
            '                    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '                    setSheetState(() => obscure = !obscure);\n'
            '                  },\n'
            '                  icon: Icon(\n'
            '                    obscure\n'
            '                        ? Icons.visibility_rounded\n'
            '                        : Icons.visibility_off_rounded,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            DropdownButtonFormField<String>(\n'
            '              initialValue: model,\n'
            '              decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: \'Model\'),\n'
            '              items: const <DropdownMenuItem<String>>[\n'
            '                DropdownMenuItem(\n'
            '                  value: \'gemini-2.5-flash\',\n'
            '                  child: Text(\'Gemini 2.5 Flash\'),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                DropdownMenuItem(\n'
            '                  value: \'gemini-2.0-flash\',\n'
            '                  child: Text(\'Gemini 2.0 Flash\'),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '              onChanged: (String? value) {\n'
            '                if (value != null) {\n'
            '                  HapticFeedback.selectionClick();\n'
            '                  setSheetState(() => model = value);\n'
            '                }\n'
            '              },\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            const Text(\n'
            '              \'The key is stored in Android secure storage and sent only to Google Gemini. It is never uploaded to Firebase.\',\n'
            '              style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                color: systemGray,\n'
            '                fontSize: 11.5,\n'
            '                height: 1.4,\n'
            '                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 20),\n'
            '            _PrimaryButton(\n'
            '              label: \'Save AI Setup\',\n'
            '              icon: Icons.lock_rounded,\n'
            '              color: const Color(0xFF8E62D9),\n'
            '              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, true),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (save == true && mounted) {\n'
            '      final String cleanKey = key.text.trim();\n'
            '      await _secureStorage.write(key: \'gemini.apiKey\', value: cleanKey);\n'
            '      await widget.sync.writeSetting(\'gemini.model\', model);\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        setState(() {\n'
            '          _apiKey = cleanKey;\n'
            '          _model = model;\n'
            '        });\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        _toast(context, \'AI setup saved securely.\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    key.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _shareExternalAiPackage(BuildContext sheetContext) async {\n'
            '    if (_sharingExternal) return;\n'
            '    if (_batchJob != null) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Finish or cancel the current AI batch before sharing a new snapshot.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String ownerUid = _currentOwnerUid;\n'
            '    if (ownerUid.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Please sign in before sharing ledger data.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final bool allowed = await _confirm(\n'
            '      sheetContext,\n'
            '      \'Share your full ledger?\',\n'
            '      \'A TXT package containing Milk, Credit, Expense, Salary, Diary and \'\n'
            '          \'Business data will be shared with the AI app you choose. API keys, \'\n'
            '          \'Firebase identity and sync metadata are never included.\',\n'
            '      dangerous: false,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (!allowed || !mounted) return;\n'
            '    if (_currentOwnerUid != ownerUid) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Account changed. Open the AI setup again.\', error: true);\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    setState(() => _sharingExternal = true);\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.ensureAllDiaryMonthsLoaded();\n'
            '      final AiBridgePackage package = AiBridgeProtocol.buildPackage(\n'
            '        state: widget.sync.state,\n'
            '        generatedAt: DateTime.now(),\n'
            '        snapshotId: _newId(\'aip\'),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: package.prompt));\n'
            '      await widget.sync.writeSetting(\n'
            '        _scopedSetting(_externalSnapshotIdSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '        package.snapshotId,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      await widget.sync.writeSetting(\n'
            '        _scopedSetting(_externalFingerprintSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '        package.stateFingerprint,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (sheetContext.mounted) Navigator.pop(sheetContext);\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _externalSnapshotId = package.snapshotId;\n'
            '        _externalStateFingerprint = package.stateFingerprint;\n'
            '        _externalOwnerUid = ownerUid;\n'
            '        _messages.add(\n'
            '          _AiMessage(\n'
            '            \'${package.recordCount} records ka complete TXT package ready hai. \'\n'
            '            \'Prompt clipboard mein copy ho gaya. Kisi AI ya Files app ko choose \'\n'
            '            \'karein; final JSON copy karke yahan Paste & Review karein.\',\n'
            '            false,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      });\n'
            '      _scrollToEnd();\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 120));\n'
            '      await SharePlus.instance.share(\n'
            '        ShareParams(\n'
            '          files: <XFile>[\n'
            '            XFile.fromData(\n'
            '              Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(package.fileContent)),\n'
            '              mimeType: \'text/plain\',\n'
            '              name: package.fileName,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '          text: package.prompt,\n'
            '          subject: \'Aarish Dairy Pro — Connect with Other AI\',\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        _toast(\n'
            '          context,\n'
            '          \'TXT ready and AI prompt copied. Choose an AI or Save to Files.\',\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        _toast(\n'
            '          context,\n'
            '          \'Could not open the share menu. Tap Connect with Other AI to retry.\',\n'
            '          error: true,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _sharingExternal = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _pasteExternalResponse() async {\n'
            '    if (_busy || _batchJob != null) return;\n'
            '    final ClipboardData? clipboard = await Clipboard.getData(\n'
            '      Clipboard.kTextPlain,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    final String response = clipboard?.text?.trim() ?? \'\';\n'
            '    if (response.isEmpty || !AiBridgeProtocol.looksLikeEnvelope(response)) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        _toast(context, \'Clipboard mein final AI JSON nahi mila.\', error: true);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _input.text = response;\n'
            '    await _send();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _clearExternalSnapshot() async {\n'
            '    final String ownerUid =\n'
            '        _externalOwnerUid.isNotEmpty ? _externalOwnerUid : _currentOwnerUid;\n'
            '    if (ownerUid.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.writeSetting(\n'
            '        _scopedSetting(_externalSnapshotIdSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      await widget.sync.writeSetting(\n'
            '        _scopedSetting(_externalFingerprintSetting, ownerUid),\n'
            '        null,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (mounted) {\n'
            '      setState(() {\n'
            '        _externalSnapshotId = \'\';\n'
            '        _externalStateFingerprint = \'\';\n'
            '        _externalOwnerUid = \'\';\n'
            '      });\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<bool> _verifyExternalEnvelope(_AiOutcome outcome) async {\n'
            '    if (_externalOwnerUid.isNotEmpty && _currentOwnerUid != _externalOwnerUid) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'This AI response belongs to a different signed-in account.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (outcome.protocol.isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '        outcome.protocol != AiBridgeProtocol.version) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'This AI response uses an unsupported protocol version.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (outcome.snapshotId.isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '        _externalSnapshotId.isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '        outcome.snapshotId != _externalSnapshotId) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'This response belongs to a different AI data package.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (outcome.stateFingerprint.isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '        _externalStateFingerprint.isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '        outcome.stateFingerprint != _externalStateFingerprint) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'The AI response does not match the shared ledger snapshot.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (outcome.protocol.isEmpty ||\n'
            '        outcome.snapshotId.isEmpty ||\n'
            '        outcome.stateFingerprint.isEmpty ||\n'
            '        _externalSnapshotId.isEmpty ||\n'
            '        _externalStateFingerprint.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return false;\n'
            '      return _confirm(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Unverified AI response\',\n'
            '        \'This JSON is not linked to the latest shared data package. Continue \'\n'
            '            \'only if you created and reviewed it yourself.\',\n'
            '        dangerous: false,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String currentFingerprint = AiBridgeProtocol.stateFingerprint(\n'
            '      widget.sync.state,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (_externalStateFingerprint.isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '        currentFingerprint != _externalStateFingerprint) {\n'
            '      if (!mounted) return false;\n'
            '      return _confirm(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Ledger changed after sharing\',\n'
            '        \'Your app data changed after the TXT package was created. Continue \'\n'
            '            \'only after carefully reviewing every proposed action.\',\n'
            '        dangerous: false,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return true;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _scrollToEnd() {\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\n'
            '      if (_scroll.hasClients) {\n'
            '        _scroll.animateTo(\n'
            '          _scroll.position.maxScrollExtent,\n'
            '          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 210),\n'
            '          curve: const Cubic(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _send() async {\n'
            '    final String prompt = _input.text.trim();\n'
            '    if (prompt.isEmpty || _busy) return;\n'
            '    if (_batchJob != null) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Finish or cancel the waiting AI batch before starting another one.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final bool localEnvelope = AiBridgeProtocol.looksLikeEnvelope(prompt);\n'
            '    if (!localEnvelope && prompt.length > 12000) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Please split this AI message into smaller parts.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _input.clear();\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _busy = true;\n'
            '      _messages.add(\n'
            '        _AiMessage(\n'
            '          localEnvelope ? \'External AI JSON pasted for review.\' : prompt,\n'
            '          true,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    _scrollToEnd();\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.ensureAllDiaryMonthsLoaded();\n'
            '      final _AiOutcome outcome;\n'
            '      if (localEnvelope) {\n'
            '        outcome = _GeminiLedgerClient.parseEnvelope(prompt);\n'
            '      } else {\n'
            '        if (_apiKey.isEmpty) {\n'
            '          await _configure();\n'
            '          if (_apiKey.isEmpty) {\n'
            '            throw const LedgerSyncException(\'Gemini API key is required.\');\n'
            '          }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        outcome = await _GeminiLedgerClient.generate(\n'
            '          apiKey: _apiKey,\n'
            '          model: _model,\n'
            '          userText: prompt,\n'
            '          state: widget.sync.state,\n'
            '          history: _geminiHistory,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (localEnvelope && outcome.actions.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '        if (_completedFingerprints.contains(outcome.envelopeFingerprint)) {\n'
            '          throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '            \'This exact AI response has already been completed.\',\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        final bool verified = await _verifyExternalEnvelope(outcome);\n'
            '        if (!verified) return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      final AiActionPlan plan = AiBridgeProtocol.validateAndNormalize(\n'
            '        rawActions: outcome.actions,\n'
            '        state: widget.sync.state,\n'
            '        newId: _newId,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      if (!localEnvelope) {\n'
            '        _rememberGeminiTurn(\n'
            '          prompt,\n'
            '          outcome.reply.isEmpty\n'
            '              ? plan.actions.isEmpty\n'
            '                  ? \'No ledger change was needed.\'\n'
            '                  : \'I proposed ${plan.actions.length} ledger change(s).\'\n'
            '              : outcome.reply,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      bool reviewCancelled = false;\n'
            '      if (plan.actions.isNotEmpty) {\n'
            '        if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '        final bool apply = await _confirmAiActions(plan);\n'
            '        if (apply && mounted) {\n'
            '          await _startAiBatch(\n'
            '            plan,\n'
            '            fingerprint:\n'
            '                localEnvelope ? outcome.envelopeFingerprint : _newId(\'aijob\'),\n'
            '            snapshotId: outcome.snapshotId,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          if (localEnvelope) await _clearExternalSnapshot();\n'
            '        } else {\n'
            '          reviewCancelled = true;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        final String? statusMessage = plan.actions.isEmpty\n'
            '            ? outcome.reply.isEmpty\n'
            '                ? \'Koi change zaroori nahi tha.\'\n'
            '                : outcome.reply\n'
            '            : reviewCancelled\n'
            '                ? \'Review cancelled — koi change apply nahi hua.\'\n'
            '                : _batchJob != null\n'
            '                    ? \'${plan.actions.length} changes approved hain. Safe \'\n'
            '                        \'25-record batches mein process ho rahe hain.\'\n'
            '                    : null;\n'
            '        if (statusMessage != null) {\n'
            '          setState(() => _messages.add(_AiMessage(statusMessage, false)));\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        setState(() {\n'
            '          _messages.add(\n'
            '            _AiMessage(\n'
            '              \'Error: ${error.toString().replaceFirst(\'Exception: \', \'\')}\',\n'
            '              false,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        });\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _busy = false);\n'
            '      _scrollToEnd();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _rememberGeminiTurn(String userText, String modelText) {\n'
            '    _geminiHistory\n'
            '      ..add(\n'
            '        _AiMessage(\n'
            '          userText.length <= 6000 ? userText : userText.substring(0, 6000),\n'
            '          true,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      )\n'
            '      ..add(\n'
            '        _AiMessage(\n'
            '          modelText.length <= 2000 ? modelText : modelText.substring(0, 2000),\n'
            '          false,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    if (_geminiHistory.length > 20) {\n'
            '      _geminiHistory.removeRange(0, _geminiHistory.length - 20);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _startAiBatch(\n'
            '    AiActionPlan plan, {\n'
            '    required String fingerprint,\n'
            '    required String snapshotId,\n'
            '  }) async {\n'
            '    final String ownerUid = _currentOwnerUid;\n'
            '    if (ownerUid.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'The signed-in account is no longer available.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String currentStateFingerprint = AiBridgeProtocol.stateFingerprint(\n'
            '      widget.sync.state,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (currentStateFingerprint != plan.sourceStateFingerprint) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'Review ke dauran ledger badal gaya. Naya response paste karke review karein.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final int now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob job = AiBatchJob(\n'
            '      id: _newId(\'batch\'),\n'
            '      ownerUid: ownerUid,\n'
            '      fingerprint: fingerprint,\n'
            '      expectedStateFingerprint: currentStateFingerprint,\n'
            '      actions: plan.actions,\n'
            '      nextIndex: 0,\n'
            '      nextRunAtMillis: now,\n'
            '      createdAtMillis: now,\n'
            '      snapshotId: snapshotId,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    await _persistBatchJob(job);\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _batchJob = job);\n'
            '    await _executeNextBatch();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _persistBatchJob(AiBatchJob? job, {String? ownerUid}) {\n'
            '    final String owner =\n'
            '        job?.ownerUid ?? ownerUid ?? _batchJob?.ownerUid ?? _currentOwnerUid;\n'
            '    if (owner.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      throw const AiBridgeException(\n'
            '        \'Cannot persist an AI batch without a signed-in account.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return widget.sync.writeSetting(\n'
            '      _scopedSetting(_batchJobSetting, owner),\n'
            '      job == null ? null : jsonEncode(job.toJson()),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _armBatchTimers() {\n'
            '    _batchTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    _countdownTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? job = _batchJob;\n'
            '    if (job == null || job.paused || !_appActive || job.isComplete) return;\n'
            '    final int remainingMillis =\n'
            '        job.nextRunAtMillis - DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\n'
            '    _batchTimer = Timer(\n'
            '      Duration(milliseconds: math.max(0, remainingMillis)),\n'
            '      () => unawaited(_executeNextBatch()),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (remainingMillis > 0) {\n'
            '      _countdownTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {\n'
            '        if (mounted) setState(() {});\n'
            '      });\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _executeNextBatch() async {\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? current = _batchJob;\n'
            '    if (current == null ||\n'
            '        current.paused ||\n'
            '        current.isComplete ||\n'
            '        _batchWriting ||\n'
            '        !_appActive) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (_currentOwnerUid != current.ownerUid) {\n'
            '      _batchTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '      _countdownTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        setState(() => _batchJob = null);\n'
            '        _toast(\n'
            '          context,\n'
            '          \'Account changed. This account\\\'s pending AI batch was not run.\',\n'
            '          error: true,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final int now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\n'
            '    if (current.nextRunAtMillis > now) {\n'
            '      _armBatchTimers();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final String currentStateFingerprint = AiBridgeProtocol.stateFingerprint(\n'
            '      widget.sync.state,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (currentStateFingerprint != current.expectedStateFingerprint) {\n'
            '      final AiBatchJob paused = current.copyWith(\n'
            '        paused: true,\n'
            '        lastError: \'Ledger changed after approval. Cancel and review again.\',\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      await _persistBatchJob(paused);\n'
            '      _batchJob = paused;\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        setState(() {});\n'
            '        _toast(\n'
            '          context,\n'
            '          \'AI batch paused because ledger data changed. Review again safely.\',\n'
            '          error: true,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _batchTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    _countdownTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    if (mounted) setState(() => _batchWriting = true);\n'
            '    final int candidate = current.nextIndex + AiBridgeProtocol.chunkSize;\n'
            '    final int end =\n'
            '        candidate < current.actions.length ? candidate : current.actions.length;\n'
            '    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> chunk = current.actions.sublist(\n'
            '      current.nextIndex,\n'
            '      end,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> writes = <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '      for (final Map<String, dynamic> action in chunk)\n'
            '        \'${action[\'path\']}\': action[\'data\'],\n'
            '    };\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.sync.writeBatch(writes, reason: \'ai-reviewed-batch\');\n'
            '      final int remaining = current.actions.length - end;\n'
            '      if (remaining == 0) {\n'
            '        await _persistBatchJob(null, ownerUid: current.ownerUid);\n'
            '        final List<String> completedFingerprints = <String>[\n'
            '          ..._completedFingerprints.where(\n'
            '            (String value) => value != current.fingerprint,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          current.fingerprint,\n'
            '        ];\n'
            '        if (completedFingerprints.length > 50) {\n'
            '          completedFingerprints.removeRange(\n'
            '            0,\n'
            '            completedFingerprints.length - 50,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        await widget.sync.writeSetting(\n'
            '          _scopedSetting(_completedFingerprintSetting, current.ownerUid),\n'
            '          jsonEncode(completedFingerprints),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        _batchJob = null;\n'
            '        _completedFingerprints = completedFingerprints;\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\n'
            '          setState(() {\n'
            '            _messages.add(\n'
            '              _AiMessage(\n'
            '                \'${current.actions.length} बदलाव सुरक्षित रूप से लागू हो गए।\',\n'
            '                false,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          });\n'
            '          HapticFeedback.successNotification();\n'
            '          _toast(\n'
            '            context,\n'
            '            \'${current.actions.length} बदलाव सुरक्षित रूप से सेव हो गए।\',\n'
            '          );\n'
            '          _scrollToEnd();\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      } else {\n'
            '        final AiBatchJob waiting = current.copyWith(\n'
            '          nextIndex: end,\n'
            '          expectedStateFingerprint: AiBridgeProtocol.stateFingerprint(\n'
            '            widget.sync.state,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          nextRunAtMillis: DateTime.now()\n'
            '              .add(AiBridgeProtocol.chunkCooldown)\n'
            '              .millisecondsSinceEpoch,\n'
            '          paused: false,\n'
            '          clearError: true,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        await _persistBatchJob(waiting);\n'
            '        _batchJob = waiting;\n'
            '        if (mounted) {\n'
            '          setState(() {});\n'
            '          _toast(\n'
            '            context,\n'
            '            \'${chunk.length} records saved. $remaining remaining — next 25 in 1 minute.\',\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        _armBatchTimers();\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } catch (error) {\n'
            '      final AiBatchJob paused = current.copyWith(\n'
            '        paused: true,\n'
            '        lastError: error.toString().replaceFirst(\'Exception: \', \'\'),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      await _persistBatchJob(paused);\n'
            '      _batchJob = paused;\n'
            '      if (mounted) {\n'
            '        setState(() {});\n'
            '        _toast(\n'
            '          context,\n'
            '          \'AI batch paused safely. Retry or cancel the remaining actions.\',\n'
            '          error: true,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _batchWriting = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _retryBatch() async {\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? job = _batchJob;\n'
            '    if (job == null || _batchWriting) return;\n'
            '    if (_currentOwnerUid != job.ownerUid) {\n'
            '      _toast(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        \'Account changed. This pending batch cannot run here.\',\n'
            '        error: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob retrying = job.copyWith(\n'
            '      paused: false,\n'
            '      nextRunAtMillis: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,\n'
            '      clearError: true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    await _persistBatchJob(retrying);\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _batchJob = retrying);\n'
            '    await _executeNextBatch();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _cancelRemainingBatch() async {\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? job = _batchJob;\n'
            '    if (job == null || _batchWriting) return;\n'
            '    final bool cancel = await _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'Cancel remaining changes?\',\n'
            '      \'${job.completed} change(s) are already saved. The remaining \'\n'
            '          \'${job.remaining} change(s) will not run.\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    if (!cancel) return;\n'
            '    _batchTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    _countdownTimer?.cancel();\n'
            '    await _persistBatchJob(null, ownerUid: job.ownerUid);\n'
            '    if (!mounted) return;\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _batchJob = null;\n'
            '      _messages.add(\n'
            '        _AiMessage(\'${job.remaining} remaining AI change(s) cancelled.\', false),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    _toast(context, \'Remaining AI changes cancelled.\');\n'
            '    _scrollToEnd();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  int get _batchSecondsRemaining {\n'
            '    final AiBatchJob? job = _batchJob;\n'
            '    if (job == null || job.paused) return 0;\n'
            '    final int milliseconds =\n'
            '        job.nextRunAtMillis - DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;\n'
            '    return milliseconds <= 0 ? 0 : (milliseconds / 1000).ceil();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<bool> _confirmAiActions(AiActionPlan plan) async {\n'
            '    final bool reduceMotion = AppMotion.reduce(context);\n'
            '    final List<String> summaryParts = <String>[\n'
            '      if (plan.createCount > 0) \'${plan.createCount} जुड़ेंगे\',\n'
            '      if (plan.updateCount > 0) \'${plan.updateCount} बदलेंगे\',\n'

            '    final bool? result = await showDialog<bool>(\n'

            '      requestFocus: true,\n'

            '    return _confirm(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      \'पूरे खाते हटाएँ?\',\n'

            '      dangerous: true,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'

            '                physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),\n'
            '                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 18),\n'

            '                  final _AiMessage message = _messages[index];\n'

            '                        horizontal: 15,\n'

            '                            ? const LinearGradient(\n'

            '                          ),\n'

            '                      ),\n'
            '                      child: Text(\n'
            '                        message.text,\n'
            '                        style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                          color: message.user ? Colors.white : null,\n'
            '                          fontSize: 14,\n'
            '                          height: 1.42,\n'
            '                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                },\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            if (_batchJob != null)\n'
            '              _AiBatchProgressCard(\n'
            '                job: _batchJob!,\n'
            '                secondsRemaining: _batchSecondsRemaining,\n'
            '                writing: _batchWriting,\n'
            '                onCancel: _batchWriting\n'
            '                    ? null\n'
            '                    : () => unawaited(_cancelRemainingBatch()),\n'
            '                onRetry: () => unawaited(_retryBatch()),\n'
            '              )\n'
            '            else if (_externalSnapshotId.isNotEmpty)\n'
            '              _ExternalAiReadyCard(\n'
            '                onPaste: () => unawaited(_pasteExternalResponse()),\n'
            '                onDismiss: () => unawaited(_clearExternalSnapshot()),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            SafeArea(\n'
            '              top: false,\n'
            '              child: Container(\n'
            '                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 9, 10, 10),\n'
            '                decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                  color: Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark\n'
            '                      ? const Color(0xFF111113)\n'

            '                    BoxShadow(color: Colors.black12, blurRadius: 18),\n'

            '                        onSubmitted: (_) => unawaited(_send()),\n'

            '                          hintText: \'Ask or paste AI JSON…\',\n'

            '                      onTap: _busy || _batchJob != null\n'
            '                          ? null\n'
            '                          : () => unawaited(_send()),\n'
            '                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(23),\n'
            '                      child: Container(\n'
            '                        width: 46,\n'
            '                        height: 46,\n'

            '                              Color(0xFF4285F4),\n'
            '                              Color(0xFF9B72CB)\n'
            '                            ],\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          shape: BoxShape.circle,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                        child: _busy\n'
            '                            ? const Padding(\n'
            '                                padding: EdgeInsets.all(13),\n'
            '                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(\n'
            '                                  color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                                  strokeWidth: 2,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              )\n'
            '                            : const Icon(\n'
            '                                Icons.arrow_upward_rounded,\n'
            '                                color: Colors.white,\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _GeminiLedgerClient {\n'
            '  _GeminiLedgerClient._();\n'
            '\n'
            '  static Future<_AiOutcome> generate({\n'
            '    required String apiKey,\n'
            '    required String model,\n'
            '    required String userText,\n'
            '    required Map<String, dynamic> state,\n'
            '    required List<_AiMessage> history,\n'
            '  }) async {\n'
            '    final Uri uri = Uri.parse(\n'
            '      \'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/$model:generateContent?key=${Uri.encodeQueryComponent(apiKey)}\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final String snapshot = jsonEncode(_compactState(state));\n'
            '    final String instruction = AiBridgeProtocol.directGeminiInstruction(\n'
            '      _today(),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final http.Response response = await http\n'
            '        .post(\n'
            '          uri,\n'
            '          headers: const <String, String>{\'Content-Type\': \'application/json\'},\n'
            '          body: jsonEncode(<String, dynamic>{\n'
            '            \'systemInstruction\': <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '              \'parts\': <Map<String, String>>[\n'
            '                <String, String>{\'text\': instruction},\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            },\n'
            '            \'contents\': <Map<String, dynamic>>[\n'
            '              for (final _AiMessage message in history)\n'
            '                <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '                  \'role\': message.user ? \'user\' : \'model\',\n'
            '                  \'parts\': <Map<String, String>>[\n'
            '                    <String, String>{\'text\': message.text},\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                },\n'
            '              <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '                \'role\': \'user\',\n'
            '                \'parts\': <Map<String, String>>[\n'
            '                  <String, String>{\n'
            '                    \'text\':\n'
            '                        \'USER REQUEST:\\n$userText\\n\\nCURRENT STATE JSON:\\n$snapshot\',\n'
            '                  },\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              },\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            \'generationConfig\': <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '              \'temperature\': 0.15,\n'
            '              \'maxOutputTokens\': model.startsWith(\'gemini-2.5\') ? 32768 : 8192,\n'
            '              \'responseMimeType\': \'application/json\',\n'
            '            },\n'
            '          }),\n'
            '        )\n'
            '        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 45));\n'
            '    if (response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) {\n'
            '      String detail = \'HTTP ${response.statusCode}\';\n'
            '      try {\n'
            '        final dynamic decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);\n'
            '        detail = \'${decoded[\'error\']?[\'message\'] ?? detail}\';\n'
            '      } catch (_) {}\n'
            '      throw LedgerSyncException(\'Gemini request failed: $detail\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final dynamic decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);\n'
            '    final dynamic candidates = decoded[\'candidates\'];\n'
            '    if (candidates is! List || candidates.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      throw const LedgerSyncException(\'Gemini returned no response.\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final dynamic parts = candidates.first[\'content\']?[\'parts\'];\n'
            '    if (parts is! List || parts.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      throw const LedgerSyncException(\'Gemini response was incomplete.\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return parseEnvelope(\'${parts.first[\'text\'] ?? \'\'}\');\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  static _AiOutcome parseEnvelope(String raw) {\n'
            '    final AiBridgeEnvelope envelope = AiBridgeProtocol.parseEnvelope(raw);\n'
            '    return _AiOutcome(\n'
            '      reply: envelope.reply,\n'
            '      actions: envelope.actions,\n'
            '      envelopeFingerprint: envelope.envelopeFingerprint,\n'
            '      protocol: envelope.protocol,\n'
            '      snapshotId: envelope.snapshotId,\n'
            '      stateFingerprint: envelope.stateFingerprint,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  static Map<String, dynamic> _compactState(Map<String, dynamic> state) {\n'
            '    final Map<String, dynamic> result = <String, dynamic>{};\n'
            '    for (final String root in <String>[\'udharDB\', \'expenseDB\', \'diaryDB\']) {\n'
            '      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = _rows(state[root]);\n'
            '      result[root] = rows.take(400).toList();\n'
            '      if (rows.length > 400) result[\'${root}Truncated\'] = rows.length - 400;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    for (final String root in <String>[\'milkDB\', \'salaryDB\', \'projectDB\']) {\n'
            '      final Map<String, dynamic> profiles = <String, dynamic>{};\n'
            '      for (final MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry in _map(state[root]).entries) {\n'
            '        final Map<String, dynamic> profile = _map(entry.value);\n'
            '        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> records = _rows(profile[\'records\']);\n'
            '        profiles[entry.key] = <String, dynamic>{\n'
            '          ...profile,\n'
            '          \'records\': records.take(120).toList(),\n'
            '          if (records.length > 120) \'truncatedRecords\': records.length - 120,\n'
            '        };\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      result[root] = profiles;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return result;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'String _plainMoney(dynamic value) {\n'
            '  final double number = LedgerMath.number(value);\n'
            '  final String sign = number < 0\n'
            '      ? \'-\'\n'
            '      : number > 0\n'
            '          ? \'+\'\n'
            '          : \'\';\n'
            '  return \'${sign}Rs ${NumberFormat(\'#,##,##0.##\', \'en_IN\').format(number.abs())}\';\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'enum _ExportFormat { pdf, csv, aiLedger }\n'
            '\n'
            'enum _ExportScope { all, milk, expenses, credit, salary, diary, business }\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ExportChoice {\n'
            '  const _ExportChoice(this.format, this.scope);\n'
            '\n'
            '  final _ExportFormat format;\n'
            '  final _ExportScope scope;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ExportScopeSpec {\n'
            '  const _ExportScopeSpec({\n'
            '    required this.scope,\n'
            '    required this.label,\n'

            '\n'
            'Future<void> _showExportCenter(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  LedgerSyncService sync,\n'
            ') async {\n'
            '  final _ExportChoice? choice = await _openSheet<_ExportChoice>(\n'
            '    context,\n'
            '    const _ExportCenterSheet(),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '  if (choice == null || !context.mounted) return;\n'
            '  try {\n'
            '    if (choice.scope == _ExportScope.all ||\n'
            '        choice.scope == _ExportScope.diary) {\n'
            '      await sync.ensureAllDiaryMonthsLoaded();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    await _ExportService.share(sync.state, choice);\n'
            '  } catch (_) {\n'
            '    if (context.mounted) {\n'
            '      _toast(context, \'Export failed. Please try again.\', error: true);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'

            '                )\n'
            '              : null,\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),\n'
            '          border: Border.all(\n'

            '          ),\n'
            '          boxShadow: selected ? palette.selectedShadows : const <BoxShadow>[],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        child: _ExportButtonContent(\n'
            '          label: label,\n'
            '          icon: icon,\n'
            '          textColor: selected ? palette.selectedText : palette.primaryText,\n'
            '          iconColor: selected ? palette.selectedIcon : palette.icon,\n'
            '          fontSize: 15.5,\n'
            '          iconSize: 20,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _scopePair(\n'

            '  }) {\n'

            '            colors: <Color>[palette.cardTop, palette.cardBottom],\n'

            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),\n'
            '          border: Border.all(color: palette.cardBorder),\n'
            '          boxShadow: palette.cardShadows,\n'
            '        ),\n'

            '          label: spec.label,\n'
            '          icon: spec.icon,\n'
            '          textColor: palette.primaryText,\n'
            '          iconColor: palette.icon,\n'
            '          fontSize: wide ? 19 : 16,\n'
            '          iconSize: wide ? 22 : 20,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  String _formatHint() => switch (_format) {\n'
            '        _ExportFormat.pdf =>\n'
            '          \'Premium PDF app ke current colors, borders, cards aur dark/light mode se banegi.\',\n'
            '        _ExportFormat.csv =>\n'
            '          \'CSV Backup clean spreadsheet-ready data ke saath banega.\',\n'
            '        _ExportFormat.aiLedger =>\n'
            '          \'AI Ledger AI-readable structured format me complete ledger banayega.\',\n'
            '      };\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ExportDataset {\n'
            '  const _ExportDataset({\n'
            '    required this.title,\n'
            '    required this.headers,\n'
            '    required this.rows,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String title;\n'
            '  final List<String> headers;\n'
            '  final List<List<String>> rows;\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _ExportService {\n'
            '  _ExportService._();\n'
            '\n'
            '  static List<String> _pdfCellChunks(String value, int maxCharacters) {\n'
            '    final String text = value.replaceAll(\'\\r\\n\', \'\\n\').replaceAll(\'\\r\', \'\\n\');\n'
            '    if (text.isEmpty) return const <String>[\'\'];\n'
            '    const int maxLinesPerRow = 32;\n'
            '    final List<String> chunks = <String>[];\n'
            '    int start = 0;\n'
            '    while (start < text.length) {\n'
            '      int end = math.min(start + maxCharacters, text.length);\n'
            '      bool limitedByLines = false;\n'
            '      int lines = 1;\n'
            '      for (int index = start; index < end; index++) {\n'
            '        if (text.codeUnitAt(index) == 0x0A && ++lines > maxLinesPerRow) {\n'
            '          end = index + 1;\n'
            '          limitedByLines = true;\n'
            '          break;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!limitedByLines && end < text.length) {\n'
            '        final int minimumBreak = start + (maxCharacters * 3 ~/ 5);\n'
            '        for (int index = end; index > minimumBreak; index--) {\n'
            '          final int unit = text.codeUnitAt(index - 1);\n'
            '          if (unit == 0x20 || unit == 0x09 || unit == 0x0A) {\n'
            '            end = index;\n'
            '            break;\n'
            '          }\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (end < text.length && end > start) {\n'
            '        final int previous = text.codeUnitAt(end - 1);\n'
            '        final int next = text.codeUnitAt(end);\n'
            '        if (previous >= 0xD800 &&\n'
            '            previous <= 0xDBFF &&\n'
            '            next >= 0xDC00 &&\n'
            '            next <= 0xDFFF) {\n'
            '          end--;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (end <= start) end = math.min(start + 1, text.length);\n'
            '      chunks.add(text.substring(start, end));\n'
            '      start = end;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return chunks;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  static List<List<String>> _pdfSafeRows(\n'
            '    List<String> headers,\n'
            '    List<List<String>> rows,\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    if (headers.isEmpty) return rows;\n'
            '    final int maxCharacters = (1400 ~/ headers.length).clamp(160, 700).toInt();\n'
            '    final List<List<String>> safeRows = <List<String>>[];\n'
            '    for (final List<String> row in rows) {\n'
            '      final List<List<String>> chunks = List<List<String>>.generate(\n'
            '        headers.length,\n'
            '        (int index) =>\n'
            '            _pdfCellChunks(index < row.length ? row[index] : \'\', maxCharacters),\n'
            '        growable: false,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      final int rowCount = chunks.fold<int>(\n'
            '        1,\n'
            '        (int count, List<String> cell) => math.max(count, cell.length),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      for (int chunkIndex = 0; chunkIndex < rowCount; chunkIndex++) {\n'
            '        safeRows.add(\n'
            '          chunks\n'
            '              .map(\n'
            '                (List<String> cell) =>\n'
            '                    chunkIndex < cell.length ? cell[chunkIndex] : \'\',\n'
            '              )\n'
            '              .toList(growable: false),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return safeRows;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  static Future<void> sharePdf(\n'
            '    String title,\n'
            '    List<String> headers,\n'
            '    List<List<String>> rows,\n'
            '  ) async {\n'
            '    final pw.Font pdfRegular = pw.Font.ttf(\n'
            '      await rootBundle.load(\'assets/fonts/NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf\'),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final pw.Font pdfBold = pw.Font.ttf(\n'
            '      await rootBundle.load(\'assets/fonts/NotoSansDevanagari-Bold.ttf\'),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final pw.Document document = pw.Document();\n'
            '    final List<List<String>> safeRows = _pdfSafeRows(headers, rows);\n'
            '    document.addPage(\n'
            '      pw.MultiPage(\n'
            '        pageFormat: PdfPageFormat.a4,\n'
            '        margin: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(28),\n'
            '        maxPages: 1000,\n'
            '        theme: pw.ThemeData.withFont(\n'
            '          base: pw.Font.helvetica(),\n'
            '          bold: pw.Font.helveticaBold(),\n'
            '          italic: pw.Font.helveticaOblique(),\n'
            '          boldItalic: pw.Font.helveticaBoldOblique(),\n'
            '          fontFallback: <pw.Font>[pdfRegular],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        build: (pw.Context context) => <pw.Widget>[\n'
            '          pw.Text(\n'
            '            title,\n'
            '            style: pw.TextStyle(\n'
            '              fontSize: 22,\n'
            '              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,\n'
            '              color: PdfColors.blue800,\n'
            '              fontFallback: <pw.Font>[pdfBold],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          pw.SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '          pw.Text(\n'
            '            \'Generated by Aarish Dairy Pro • ${DateFormat(\'dd MMM yyyy, hh:mm a\').format(DateTime.now())}\',\n'
            '            style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: PdfColors.grey700),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          pw.SizedBox(height: 18),\n'
            '          if (safeRows.isEmpty)\n'
            '            pw.Text(\'No records available.\')\n'
            '          else\n'
            '            pw.Table(\n'
            '              border: pw.TableBorder.all(color: PdfColors.grey300, width: .5),\n'
            '              children: <pw.TableRow>[\n'
            '                pw.TableRow(\n'
            '                  repeat: true,\n'
            '                  decoration: const pw.BoxDecoration(color: PdfColors.blue50),\n'
            '                  children: headers\n'
            '                      .map(\n'
            '                        (String header) => pw.Padding(\n'
            '                          padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(7),\n'
            '                          child: pw.Text(\n'
            '                            header,\n'
            '                            style: pw.TextStyle(\n'
            '                              fontSize: 9,\n'
            '                              fontWeight: pw.FontWeight.bold,\n'
            '                              fontFallback: <pw.Font>[pdfBold],\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      )\n'
            '                      .toList(),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                ...safeRows.map(\n'
            '                  (List<String> row) => pw.TableRow(\n'
            '                    children: List<pw.Widget>.generate(headers.length, (\n'
            '                      int index,\n'
            '                    ) {\n'
            '                      final String value = index < row.length ? row[index] : \'\';\n'
            '                      return pw.Padding(\n'
            '                        padding: const pw.EdgeInsets.all(7),\n'
            '                        child: pw.Text(\n'
            '                          value,\n'
            '                          style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8.5),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      );\n'
            '                    }),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        footer: (pw.Context context) => pw.Align(\n'
            '          alignment: pw.Alignment.centerRight,\n'
            '          child: pw.Text(\n'
            '            \'Page ${context.pageNumber} of ${context.pagesCount}\',\n'
            '            style: const pw.TextStyle(fontSize: 8, color: PdfColors.grey600),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final Uint8List bytes = await document.save();\n'
            '    await Printing.sharePdf(\n'
            '      bytes: bytes,\n'
            '      filename:\n'
            '          \'${_safeFilename(title)}_${DateFormat(\'yyyyMMdd\').format(DateTime.now())}.pdf\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  static Future<void> share(\n'
            '    Map<String, dynamic> state,\n'
            '    _ExportChoice choice,\n'
            '  ) async {\n'
            '    final _ExportDataset dataset = _buildDataset(state, choice.scope);\n'
            '    switch (choice.format) {\n'
            '      case _ExportFormat.pdf:\n'
            '        await sharePdf(dataset.title, dataset.headers, dataset.rows);\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      case _ExportFormat.csv:\n'
            '        await _shareCsv(dataset);\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      case _ExportFormat.aiLedger:\n'
            '        await _shareAiLedger(dataset);\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'

            '  static _ExportDataset _buildDataset(\n'
            '    Map<String, dynamic> state,\n'
            '    _ExportScope scope,\n'
            '  ) {\n'
            '    switch (scope) {\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.all:\n'
            '        return _allDataset(state);\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.milk:\n'
            '        return _milkDataset(state);\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.expenses:\n'
            '        return _expenseDataset(state);\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.credit:\n'
            '        return _creditDataset(state);\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.salary:\n'
            '        return _salaryDataset(state);\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.diary:\n'
            '        return _diaryDataset(state);\n'
            '      case _ExportScope.business:\n'
            '        return _businessDataset(state);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  static _ExportDataset _allDataset(Map<String, dynamic> state) {\n'
            '    final List<List<String>> rows = <List<String>>[];\n'
            '    for (final MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry in _map(\n'
            '      state[\'milkDB\'],\n'
            '    ).entries) {\n'
            '      final Map<String, dynamic> profile = _map(entry.value);\n'
            '      for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(profile[\'records\'])) {\n'
            '        final double quantity = LedgerMath.milkQuantity(row);\n'
            '        final String flow = LedgerMath.milkFlow(row, profile);\n'
            '        final double rate = LedgerMath.milkRate(row, profile);\n'
            '        final double signedAmount =\n'
            '            quantity * rate * (flow == \'taken\' ? -1 : 1);\n'
            '        rows.add(<String>[\n'
            '          \'Milk\',\n'
            '          entry.key,\n'
            '          \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '          \'Morning ${_decimal(LedgerMath.number(row[\'morning\']).abs())} KG; \'\n'
            '              \'Evening ${_decimal(LedgerMath.number(row[\'evening\']).abs())} KG\',\n'
            '          flow == \'taken\' ? \'Taken / To Pay\' : \'Given / To Receive\',\n'
            '          _decimal(signedAmount),\n'
            '          \'${_decimal(quantity)} KG @ Rs ${_decimal(rate)}\',\n'
            '        ]);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(state[\'udharDB\'])) {\n'
            '      final double signed = LedgerMath.creditSigned(row);\n'
            '      rows.add(<String>[\n'
            '        \'Credit\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'name\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'detail\'] ?? row[\'note\'] ?? row[\'description\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        signed >= 0 ? \'Given / To Receive\' : \'Taken / To Pay\',\n'
            '        _decimal(signed),\n'
            '        \'\',\n'
            '      ]);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(state[\'expenseDB\'])) {\n'
            '      rows.add(<String>[\n'
            '        \'Expense\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'category\'] ?? \'Other\'}\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'note\'] ?? row[\'description\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'Paid / Outflow\',\n'
            '        _decimal(-LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']).abs()),\n'
            '        \'\',\n'
            '      ]);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    for (final MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry in _map(\n'
            '      state[\'salaryDB\'],\n'
            '    ).entries) {\n'
            '      final Map<String, dynamic> profile = _map(entry.value);\n'
            '      final double sign = profile[\'type\'] == \'lene_wala\' ? 1 : -1;\n'
            '      for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(profile[\'records\'])) {\n'
            '        rows.add(<String>[\n'
            '          \'Salary\',\n'
            '          entry.key,\n'
            '          \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '          \'${profile[\'company\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '          sign > 0 ? \'Salary Taken / Inflow\' : \'Salary Given / Outflow\',\n'
            '          _decimal(sign * LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']).abs()),\n'
            '          \'\',\n'
            '        ]);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(state[\'diaryDB\'])) {\n'
            '      rows.add(<String>[\n'
            '        \'Diary\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'title\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'${row[\'content\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '        \'Informational\',\n'
            '        \'0\',\n'
            '        \'\',\n'
            '      ]);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    for (final MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry in _map(\n'
            '      state[\'projectDB\'],\n'
            '    ).entries) {\n'
            '      final Map<String, dynamic> project = _map(entry.value);\n'
            '      for (final Map<String, dynamic> row in _rows(project[\'records\'])) {\n'
            '        final String color = \'${row[\'color\'] ?? \'blue\'}\'.toLowerCase();\n'
            '        final double amount = LedgerMath.number(row[\'amount\']).abs();\n'
            '        final double signed = color == \'green\'\n'
            '            ? amount\n'
            '            : color == \'red\'\n'
            '                ? -amount\n'
            '                : 0;\n'
            '        rows.add(<String>[\n'
            '          \'Business\',\n'
            '          entry.key,\n'
            '          \'${row[\'date\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '          \'${row[\'title\'] ?? row[\'detail\'] ?? \'\'}\',\n'
            '          color == \'green\'\n'
            '              ? \'Receive / Inflow\'\n'
            '              : color == \'red\'\n'
            '                  ? \'Pay / Outflow\'\n'
            '                  : \'Neutral / Informational\',\n'
            '          _decimal(signed),\n'
            '          \'Original amount ${_decimal(amount)}; color $color\',\n'
            '        ]);\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return _ExportDataset(\n'
            '      title: \'All Data\',\n'
            '      headers: const <String>[\n'
            '        \'Module\',\n'
            '        \'Profile/Category\',\n'
            '        \'Date\',\n'
            '        \'Detail\',\n'
            '        \'Type\',\n'
            '        \'Signed Amount\',\n'
            '        \'Extra\',\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '      rows: rows,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'

            '      ..writeln(\'1. Positive signed amount = owner receives / money inflow.\')\n'

            '      ..writeln(\n'
            '        \'3. Zero signed amount = informational; do not count as finance.\',\n'

            '  static String _decimal(double value) {\n'
            '    if (!value.isFinite || value == 0) return \'0\';\n'
            '    if (value == value.roundToDouble()) return value.toInt().toString();\n'

            '      .replaceAll(RegExp(r\'[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+\'), \'_\')\n'
